```tsx
/**
 * Score-key bar panels (spec 4.2 "Score keys") and the Compare panel's grouped bars, ported
 * from the mockup's `barPanel` and `groupedBars`: horizontal bars from zero in run colours,
 * the value at the bar end, the best value green, CI whiskers on the primary key.
 */
import { type MouseEvent, type ReactElement } from "react";

import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { niceExtent, niceTicks, tickFormatter } from "../lib/ticks";
import { clip } from "./labels";
import { fmtValue } from "./Scale";
import { type TipRow, hideTip, showTip } from "./Tooltip";
import "./charts.css";

export interface BarRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  value: number | null;
  ci?: { lo: number; hi: number; method?: string } | null;
  best?: boolean;
}

export interface BarPanelProps {
  rows: readonly BarRow[];
  width: number;
  /** Score key or metric name, shown in the tooltip. */
  metric: string;
  format?: (v: number) => string;
  highlight?: string | null;
}

export const BAR_ROW_H = 24;
const isNum = (v: number | null | undefined): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);

/** A zero-based domain and its ticks over `vals`. */
function zeroDomain(vals: readonly number[]): { d0: number; d1: number; ticks: number[] } {
  if (vals.length === 0) return { d0: 0, d1: 1, ticks: niceTicks(0, 1, 4) };
  const [d0, d1] = niceExtent(Math.min(0, ...vals), Math.max(0, ...vals), 4);
  return { d0, d1, ticks: niceTicks(d0, d1, 4) };
}

export function BarPanel({ rows, width, metric, format = fmtValue, highlight = null }: BarPanelProps): ReactElement {
  const lch = Math.min(Math.max(6, ...rows.map((r) => r.name.length)), 22);
  const m = { l: Math.min(150, Math.round(lch * 6.4) + 10), r: 46, t: 4, b: 20 };
  const H = m.t + m.b + Math.max(1, rows.length) * BAR_ROW_H;
  const vals = rows.flatMap((r) => [r.value, r.ci?.lo, r.ci?.hi]).filter(isNum);
  const { d0, d1, ticks } = zeroDomain(vals);
  const tick = tickFormatter(ticks);
  const X = (v: number): number => m.l + ((v - d0) / (d1 - d0)) * Math.max(1, width - m.l - m.r);
  const tipRows = (r: BarRow): TipRow[] => [
    { color: r.color, value: isNum(r.value) ? format(r.value) : "not reported", name: metric },
    ...(r.ci ? [{ value: `${format(r.ci.lo)}–${format(r.ci.hi)}`, name: `95% CI${r.ci.method ? ` · ${r.ci.method}` : ""}` }] : []),
  ];
  return (
    <svg className="chart" width={width} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${H}`}>
      {ticks.map((v) => (
        <g key={v}>
          <line className="gl" x1={X(v)} x2={X(v)} y1={m.t} y2={H - m.b} />
          <text className="xt" x={X(v)} y={H - 6} textAnchor={v === d0 ? "start" : "middle"}>
            {tick(v)}
          </text>
        </g>
      ))}
      {rows.map((r, i) => {
        const cy = m.t + i * BAR_ROW_H + BAR_ROW_H / 2;
        const onMove = (e: MouseEvent<SVGGElement>) => showTip(e.clientX, e.clientY, r.name, tipRows(r));
        return (
          <g key={r.id} className={cx("row", highlight !== null && highlight !== r.id && "dim")} onMouseMove={onMove} onMouseLeave={hideTip}>
            <rect className="hit" x={0} y={cy - BAR_ROW_H / 2} width={width} height={BAR_ROW_H} />
            <text className="lbl" x={0} y={cy + 4}>
              {clip(r.name, lch)}
            </text>
            {isNum(r.value) ? (
              <>
                <rect
                  className="bar"
                  x={X(Math.min(0, r.value))}
                  y={cy - 7}
                  width={Math.max(2, Math.abs(X(r.value) - X(0)))}
                  height={14}
                  rx={2}
                  fill={r.color}
                />
                {r.ci ? (
                  <>
                    <line className="ci" x1={X(r.ci.lo)} x2={X(r.ci.hi)} y1={cy} y2={cy} />
                    <line className="ci" x1={X(r.ci.lo)} x2={X(r.ci.lo)} y1={cy - 4} y2={cy + 4} />
                    <line className="ci" x1={X(r.ci.hi)} x2={X(r.ci.hi)} y1={cy - 4} y2={cy + 4} />
                  </>
                ) : null}
                <text className={cx("val", r.best && "best")} x={Math.max(X(r.value), X(0), r.ci ? X(r.ci.hi) : 0) + 5} y={cy + 4}>
                  {format(r.value)}
                </text>
              </>
            ) : (
              <text className="none" x={m.l + 2} y={cy + 4}>
                not reported
              </text>
            )}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

export interface BarSeries {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
}

export interface GroupedBarsProps {
  /** Datasets, top to bottom. */
  categories: readonly string[];
  /** Runs, one bar each inside every category. */
  series: readonly BarSeries[];
  valueOf: (category: string, seriesId: string) => number | null;
  width: number;
  /** The best value of a category (drawn green), or null. */
  best?: (category: string) => number | null;
  format?: (v: number) => string;
}

export function GroupedBars({ categories, series, valueOf, width, best, format = fmtValue }: GroupedBarsProps): ReactElement {
  const barH = 12;
  const gap = 3;
  const catPad = 14;
  const m = { l: 118, r: 50, t: 4, b: 20 };
  const catH = Math.max(1, series.length) * (barH + gap) + catPad;
  const H = m.t + m.b + Math.max(1, categories.length) * catH;
  const vals = categories.flatMap((c) => series.map((s) => valueOf(c, s.id))).filter(isNum);
  const { d0, d1, ticks } = zeroDomain(vals);
  const tick = tickFormatter(ticks);
  const X = (v: number): number => m.l + ((v - d0) / (d1 - d0)) * Math.max(1, width - m.l - m.r);
  return (
    <svg className="chart" width={width} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${H}`}>
      {ticks.map((v) => (
        <g key={v}>
          <line className="gl" x1={X(v)} x2={X(v)} y1={m.t} y2={H - m.b} />
          <text className="xt" x={X(v)} y={H - 6} textAnchor={v === d0 ? "start" : "middle"}>
            {tick(v)}
          </text>
        </g>
      ))}
      {categories.map((c, ci) => {
        const y0 = m.t + ci * catH;
        const bestV = best?.(c) ?? null;
        return (
          <g key={c}>
            {ci > 0 ? <line className="sep" x1={0} x2={width - m.r} y1={y0 - 2} y2={y0 - 2} /> : null}
            <text className="cat" x={0} y={y0 + catH / 2 - catPad / 2 + 4}>
              {clip(c, 16)}
            </text>
            {series.map((s, si) => {
              const v = valueOf(c, s.id);
              const y = y0 + si * (barH + gap) + catPad / 2;
              const onMove = (e: MouseEvent<SVGGElement>) =>
                showTip(e.clientX, e.clientY, c, [{ color: s.color, value: isNum(v) ? format(v) : "—", name: s.name }]);
              return (
                <g key={s.id} className="row" onMouseMove={onMove} onMouseLeave={hideTip}>
                  <rect className="hit" x={m.l} y={y - 1} width={Math.max(0, width - m.l)} height={barH + 2} />
                  {isNum(v) ? (
                    <>
                      <rect
                        className="bar"
                        x={X(Math.min(0, v))}
                        y={y}
                        width={Math.max(2, Math.abs(X(v) - X(0)))}
                        height={barH}
                        rx={2}
                        fill={s.color}
                      />
                      <text className={cx("val", v === bestV && "best")} x={Math.max(X(v), X(0)) + 4} y={y + barH - 2}>
                        {format(v)}
                      </text>
                    </>
                  ) : null}
                </g>
              );
            })}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `ui/src/charts/ScatterPareto.tsx`**

```tsx
/**
 * Score vs cost (spec 4.2 "Scores", training kinds), ported from the mockup's
 * `scatterChart`: one dot per config with its interval, x from zero, and the Pareto front
 * (lowest cost for the best score) as a dashed step line.
 */
import { type MouseEvent, type ReactElement } from "react";

import { niceExtent, niceTicks, tickFormatter } from "../lib/ticks";
import { fmtValue } from "./Scale";
import { hideTip, showTip } from "./Tooltip";
import "./charts.css";

export interface ScatterPoint {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  yLo?: number | null;
  yHi?: number | null;
}

export interface ScatterParetoProps {
  points: readonly ScatterPoint[];
  width: number;
  height?: number;
  xName?: string;
  yName?: string;
  xFormat?: (v: number) => string;
  yFormat?: (v: number) => string;
  higherIsBetter?: boolean;
}

const M = { l: 44, r: 12, t: 10, b: 22 } as const;
const isNum = (v: number | null | undefined): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);

/** Points on the Pareto front, cheapest first. */
export function paretoFront(points: readonly ScatterPoint[], higherIsBetter = true): ScatterPoint[] {
  const better = (a: number, b: number): boolean => (higherIsBetter ? a > b : a < b);
  const sorted = points
    .filter((q) => isNum(q.x) && isNum(q.y))
    .sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x || (higherIsBetter ? b.y - a.y : a.y - b.y));
  const front: ScatterPoint[] = [];
  for (const q of sorted) {
    const last = front[front.length - 1];
    if (!last || better(q.y, last.y)) front.push(q);
  }
  return front;
}

export function ScatterPareto({
  points,
  width,
  height,
  xName = "x",
  yName = "y",
  xFormat = fmtValue,
  yFormat = fmtValue,
  higherIsBetter = true,
}: ScatterParetoProps): ReactElement {
  const pts = points.filter((q) => isNum(q.x) && isNum(q.y));
  const H = height ?? Math.max(150, 26 * pts.length + 28);
  if (pts.length === 0) {
    return (
      <svg className="chart" width={width} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${H}`} role="img" aria-label="No data">
        <text className="none" x={width / 2} y={H / 2} textAnchor="middle">
          no data
        </text>
      </svg>
    );
  }
  const [, x1] = niceExtent(0, Math.max(0, ...pts.map((q) => q.x)), 4);
  const lows = pts.map((q) => (isNum(q.yLo) ? q.yLo : q.y));
  const highs = pts.map((q) => (isNum(q.yHi) ? q.yHi : q.y));
  let y0 = Math.min(...lows);
  let y1 = Math.max(...highs);
  const pad = (y1 - y0) * 0.04 || Math.abs(y1) * 0.01 || 0.01;
  y0 -= pad;
  y1 += pad;
  const X = (v: number): number => M.l + (v / x1) * Math.max(1, width - M.l - M.r);
  const Y = (v: number): number => M.t + (1 - (v - y0) / (y1 - y0)) * Math.max(1, H - M.t - M.b);
  const yTicks = niceTicks(y0, y1, 5);
  const yTick = tickFormatter(yTicks);
  const xTicks = niceTicks(0, x1, 4);
  let front = "";
  paretoFront(pts, higherIsBetter).forEach((q, i) => {
    front += i === 0 ? `M${X(q.x)},${Y(q.y)}` : `H${X(q.x)}V${Y(q.y)}`;
  });
  return (
    <svg className="chart" width={width} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${H}`}>
      {yTicks.map((v) => (
        <g key={`y${v}`}>
          <line className="gl" x1={M.l} x2={width - M.r} y1={Y(v)} y2={Y(v)} />
          <text className="yt" x={M.l - 6} y={Y(v) + 3.5} textAnchor="end">
            {yTick(v)}
          </text>
        </g>
      ))}
      {xTicks.map((v) => (
        <g key={`x${v}`}>
          <line className="gl" x1={X(v)} x2={X(v)} y1={M.t} y2={H - M.b} />
          <text className="xt" x={X(v)} y={H - 6} textAnchor={v === 0 ? "start" : "middle"}>
            {xFormat(v)}
          </text>
        </g>
      ))}
      <line className="ax" x1={M.l} x2={width - M.r} y1={H - M.b} y2={H - M.b} />
      {front ? <path className="front" d={front} /> : null}
      {pts.map((q) => {
        const onMove = (e: MouseEvent<SVGGElement>) =>
          showTip(e.clientX, e.clientY, q.name, [
            { color: q.color, value: yFormat(q.y), name: yName },
            { value: xFormat(q.x), name: xName },
          ]);
        return (
          <g key={q.id} className="pt" onMouseMove={onMove} onMouseLeave={hideTip}>
            <line className="err" x1={X(q.x)} x2={X(q.x)} y1={Y(isNum(q.yLo) ? q.yLo : q.y)} y2={Y(isNum(q.yHi) ? q.yHi : q.y)} stroke={q.color} />
            <circle className="hit" cx={X(q.x)} cy={Y(q.y)} r={12} />
            <circle className="dot" cx={X(q.x)} cy={Y(q.y)} r={4.5} fill={q.color} />
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** — `ui/src/charts/ParallelCoords.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * Sweep parallel coordinates (spec 4.2 "Sweeps"), ported from the mockup's `parcoords`:
 * one line per finished run across its params and the score, coloured on a sequential ramp
 * by the score, axis labels above the lines with a halo, one tooltip per line.
 */
import { type ReactElement, useState } from "react";

import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { niceTicks, tickFormatter } from "../lib/ticks";
import { fmtValue } from "./Scale";
import { type TipRow, hideTip, showTip } from "./Tooltip";
import "./charts.css";

export interface PCAxis {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Categorical axis values, bottom to top; omit for a numeric axis. */
  values?: readonly string[];
}

export interface PCLine {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  values: Readonly<Record<string, string | number | null | undefined>>;
}

export interface ParallelCoordsProps {
  axes: readonly PCAxis[];
  lines: readonly PCLine[];
  width: number;
  height?: number;
  /** A numeric axis key; its value picks the line colour. */
  colorBy: string;
  /** Direction of `colorBy`: better values are darker and drawn last. */
  higherIsBetter?: boolean;
  format?: (v: number) => string;
  onOpen?: (id: string) => void;
}

/** Sequential blues from the mockup, low to high. */
export const SEQ_RAMP = ["#cde2fb", "#9ec5f4", "#6da7ec", "#3987e5", "#256abf", "#184f95"] as const;

/** The ramp colour for `t` in 0..1 (clamped). */
export function seqColor(t: number): string {
  const k = Math.min(SEQ_RAMP.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor((Number.isFinite(t) ? t : 0) * SEQ_RAMP.length)));
  return SEQ_RAMP[k] ?? SEQ_RAMP[0];
}

const M = { l: 44, r: 56, t: 24, b: 14 } as const;

interface NumAxis {
  lo: number;
  hi: number;
  ticks: number[];
}

export function ParallelCoords({
  axes,
  lines,
  width,
  height = 240,
  colorBy,
  higherIsBetter = true,
  format = fmtValue,
  onOpen,
}: ParallelCoordsProps): ReactElement {
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const n = axes.length;
  const ph = height - M.t - M.b;
  const AX = (i: number): number => M.l + (n <= 1 ? (width - M.l - M.r) / 2 : (i * (width - M.l - M.r)) / (n - 1));
  // only lines with a value on every axis are drawn; their values set the numeric ranges
  const complete = lines.filter((l) =>
    axes.every((a) => (a.values ? a.values.includes(String(l.values[a.key])) : Number.isFinite(Number(l.values[a.key])))),
  );
  const num = new Map<string, NumAxis>();
  for (const a of axes) {
    if (a.values) continue;
    const vs = complete.map((l) => Number(l.values[a.key])).filter(Number.isFinite);
    let lo = vs.length ? Math.min(...vs) : 0;
    let hi = vs.length ? Math.max(...vs) : 1;
    if (hi === lo) {
      const pad = Math.abs(hi) * 0.01 || 0.01;
      lo -= pad;
      hi += pad;
    }
    num.set(a.key, { lo, hi, ticks: niceTicks(lo, hi, 4) });
  }
  const yCat = (a: PCAxis, i: number): number => {
    const k = (a.values?.length ?? 1) - 1;
    return M.t + (k === 0 ? 0.5 : 1 - i / k) * ph;
  };
  const yNum = (axis: NumAxis, v: number): number => M.t + (1 - (v - axis.lo) / (axis.hi - axis.lo)) * ph;
  // spread lines that share a categorical value, in line order, 3 px apart
  const offset = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const a of axes) {
    if (!a.values) continue;
    const groups = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const l of complete) {
      const v = String(l.values[a.key]);
      groups.set(v, [...(groups.get(v) ?? []), l.id]);
    }
    for (const ids of groups.values()) {
      ids.forEach((id, k) => offset.set(`${a.key}\u0000${id}`, Math.max(-9, Math.min(9, (k - (ids.length - 1) / 2) * 3))));
    }
  }
  const color = num.get(colorBy);
  const colorOf = (l: PCLine): string => {
    const v = Number(l.values[colorBy]);
    if (!color || !Number.isFinite(v)) return "var(--c0)";
    const t = (v - color.lo) / (color.hi - color.lo);
    return seqColor(higherIsBetter ? t : 1 - t);
  };
  const yOf = (l: PCLine, a: PCAxis): number => {
    if (a.values) return yCat(a, a.values.indexOf(String(l.values[a.key]))) + (offset.get(`${a.key}\u0000${l.id}`) ?? 0);
    const axis = num.get(a.key);
    return axis ? yNum(axis, Number(l.values[a.key])) : M.t;
  };
  // worst first, best last (on top)
  const dir = higherIsBetter ? 1 : -1;
  const ordered = [...complete].sort((a, b) => dir * (Number(a.values[colorBy]) - Number(b.values[colorBy])));
  const tipRows = (l: PCLine): TipRow[] =>
    axes.map((a, i) => {
      const v = l.values[a.key];
      return {
        color: i === 0 ? colorOf(l) : undefined,
        value: typeof v === "number" ? format(v) : String(v ?? "—"),
        name: a.label,
      };
    });
  const r1 = (v: number): number => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
  return (
    <svg className="chart" width={width} height={height} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}>
      {axes.map((a, i) => (
        <line key={`ax-${a.key}`} className="ax" x1={AX(i)} x2={AX(i)} y1={M.t} y2={height - M.b} />
      ))}
      {ordered.map((l) => {
        const ys = axes.map((a) => yOf(l, a));
        let d = `M${r1(AX(0))},${r1(ys[0] ?? 0)}`;
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
          const mid = (AX(i - 1) + AX(i)) / 2;
          d += ` C${r1(mid)},${r1(ys[i - 1] ?? 0)} ${r1(mid)},${r1(ys[i] ?? 0)} ${r1(AX(i))},${r1(ys[i] ?? 0)}`;
        }
        return (
          <path
            key={l.id}
            className={cx("pc", hot === l.id && "on")}
            d={d}
            stroke={colorOf(l)}
            onMouseMove={(e) => {
              setHot(l.id);
              showTip(e.clientX, e.clientY, l.name, tipRows(l));
            }}
            onMouseLeave={() => {
              setHot(null);
              hideTip();
            }}
            onClick={onOpen ? () => onOpen(l.id) : undefined}
          />
        );
      })}
      {axes.map((a, i) => {
        const last = i === n - 1 && n > 1;
        const x = AX(i) + (last ? 6 : -6);
        const anchor = last ? "start" : "end";
        const axis = num.get(a.key);
        const fmt = axis ? tickFormatter(axis.ticks) : String;
        return (
          <g key={`lab-${a.key}`}>
            <text className="axis-t" x={AX(i)} y={12} textAnchor="middle">
              {a.label}
            </text>
            {a.values
              ? a.values.map((v, k) => (
                  <text key={v} className="halo" x={x} y={yCat(a, k) + 3.5} textAnchor={anchor}>
                    {v}
                  </text>
                ))
              : axis?.ticks.map((v) => (
                  <text key={v} className="halo" x={x} y={yNum(axis, v) + 3.5} textAnchor={anchor}>
                    {fmt(v)}
                  </text>
                ))}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

`ui/src/charts/Sparkline.tsx`:

```tsx
/** Best-over-time sparkline for the Home tasks table (spec 4.1), from the mockup's `spark`. */
import { type ReactElement } from "react";
import "./charts.css";

export interface SparklineProps {
  values: readonly number[];
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  /** Lower is better: the lowest value is drawn at the top. */
  lowerIsBetter?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name, e.g. "best top1 over 7 days". */
  label?: string;
}

/** `x,y` pairs for a polyline; best at the top, 2 px inset, equal values in the middle. */
export function sparkPoints(values: readonly number[], width: number, height: number, lowerIsBetter: boolean): string {
  const vs = values.filter(Number.isFinite);
  if (vs.length === 0) return "";
  const lo = Math.min(...vs);
  const hi = Math.max(...vs);
  const y = (v: number): number => {
    if (hi === lo) return height / 2;
    const t = lowerIsBetter ? (hi - v) / (hi - lo) : (v - lo) / (hi - lo);
    return height - 3 - t * (height - 6);
  };
  const r1 = (v: number): number => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
  if (vs.length === 1) return `2,${r1(y(vs[0] ?? 0))} ${width - 2},${r1(y(vs[0] ?? 0))}`;
  return vs.map((v, i) => `${r1((i / (vs.length - 1)) * (width - 4) + 2)},${r1(y(v))}`).join(" ");
}

export function Sparkline({ values, width = 90, height = 22, lowerIsBetter = false, label }: SparklineProps): ReactElement | null {
  const points = sparkPoints(values, width, height, lowerIsBetter);
  if (!points) return null;
  return (
    <svg className="spark" width={width} height={height} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} role="img" aria-label={label}>
      <polyline points={points} />
    </svg>
  );
}
```

```tsx
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "New run" }).className).toBe("btn primary sm");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "New run" }).querySelector("svg")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "More actions" }).className).toBe("btn ghost icon");
  });

  test("a disabled button does not fire", () => {
    const click = mock(() => {});
    render(<Button disabled onClick={click}>Stop</Button>);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Stop" }));
    expect(click).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe("Chip", () => {
  test("a toggle chip reports aria-pressed; a menu chip shows a chevron and no aria-pressed", () => {
    render(
      <>
        <Chip on onClick={() => {}}>3 superseded hidden</Chip>
        <Chip on={false}>Superseded shown</Chip>
        <Chip chevron title="Sort by">
          Sort <b>top1 ↓</b>
        </Chip>
      </>,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "3 superseded hidden" }).getAttribute("aria-pressed")).toBe("true");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "3 superseded hidden" }).className).toBe("chip on");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Superseded shown" }).getAttribute("aria-pressed")).toBe("false");
    const sort = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /Sort/ });
    expect(sort.getAttribute("aria-pressed")).toBeNull();
    expect(sort.querySelector(".chev svg")).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("Segmented", () => {
  test("a named group of pressed-state buttons; clicking picks the option", () => {
    function Harness() {
      const [v, setV] = useState<"config" | "run">("config");
      return (
        <Segmented
          label="Group"
          value={v}
          onChange={setV}
          options={[
            ["config", "By config"],
            ["run", "Each run"],
          ]}
        />
      );
    }
    render(<Harness />);
    const group = screen.getByRole("group", { name: "Group" });
    const pressed = () => [...group.querySelectorAll("button")].map((b) => b.getAttribute("aria-pressed"));
    expect(pressed()).toEqual(["true", "false"]);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Each run" }));
    expect(pressed()).toEqual(["false", "true"]);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Each run" }).className).toBe("on");
  });
});

describe("FilterField", () => {
  test("a search box: typing reports the text, Escape clears it", () => {
    function Harness() {
      const [q, setQ] = useState("");
      return (
        <>
          <FilterField value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="Filter  lr=3e-4 · tag:final" label="Filter runs" />
          <output>{q}</output>
        </>
      );
    }
    render(<Harness />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("search")).not.toBeNull();
    const input = screen.getByRole("searchbox", { name: "Filter runs" });
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "tag:final" } });
    expect(screen.getByRole("status").textContent).toBe("tag:final");
    fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: "Escape" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("status").textContent).toBe("");
  });
});
```

```css
/* v5 chrome (ported from docs/mockups/ui-v5). Buttons and tags are global (styles/base.css)
   because v4 modules use the same classes. */

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ icons, swatch, eye */
.ico { display: inline-block; flex: none; vertical-align: middle; }

.sw.off { background: transparent !important; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line-2); }
.eye { color: var(--ink-3); cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }
.eye:hover { background: var(--select); color: var(--ink); }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ chips, segments, field */
.chip {
  white-space: nowrap; flex: none; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2);

}
```

```tsx
/** The one stroke icon set of the v5 UI (paths from docs/mockups/ui-v5). */
import { type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import "./chrome.css";

export type IconName =
  | "home" | "hosts" | "queue" | "search" | "eye" | "eye-off" | "edit" | "more" | "expand" | "chevron" | "copy"
  | "folder" | "doc" | "box" | "agent" | "human" | "check" | "x" | "warn" | "spinner" | "plus";

  stroke: number;
  body: ReactNode;
}

};

export const ICON_NAMES = Object.keys(GLYPHS) as IconName[];

export interface IconProps {
  name: IconName;
  /** CSS px; defaults to the glyph's own box (10, 12, 14 or 16). */
  size?: number;
  /** Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function Icon({ name, size, label, className }: IconProps): ReactElement {
  const g = GLYPHS[name];
  const px = size ?? g.box;
  return (
    <svg
      className={cx("ico", className)}
      width={px}
      height={px}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${g.box} ${g.box}`}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={g.stroke}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : "true"}
      role={label ? "img" : undefined}
      aria-label={label}
    >
      {g.body}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** The v5 button (`.btn` in styles/base.css): default, primary or ghost; md or sm; optional icon. */
import { type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { Icon, type IconName } from "./Icon";

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: "default" | "primary" | "ghost";
  size?: "sm" | "md";
  icon?: IconName;
  /** Square icon button; give it an `aria-label`. */
  iconOnly?: boolean;
}

export function Button({ variant = "default", size = "md", icon, iconOnly = false, className, type = "button", children, ...rest }: ButtonProps): ReactElement {
  return (
    <button
      {...rest}
      type={type}
      className={cx("btn", variant !== "default" && variant, size === "sm" && "sm", iconOnly && "icon", className)}
    >
      {icon ? <Icon name={icon} /> : null}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

`ui/src/chrome/Chip.tsx`:

```tsx
/** A pill button: a toggle (`on` given, `aria-pressed`) or a menu opener (`chevron`). */
import { type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import "./chrome.css";

export interface ChipProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Toggle state; leave undefined for a chip that is not a toggle. */
  on?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
  chevron?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  size?: "sm";
  className?: string;
}

export function Chip({ children, on, onClick, chevron = false, title, size, className }: ChipProps): ReactElement {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={cx("chip", on && "on", size, className)}
      aria-pressed={on === undefined ? undefined : on}
      onClick={onClick}
      title={title}
    >
      {children}
      {chevron ? (
        <span className="chev">
          <Icon name="chevron" size={9} />
        </span>
      ) : null}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** A segmented control: one pressed option out of a few (`By config | Each run`). */
import { type ReactElement } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import "./chrome.css";

export interface SegmentedProps<T extends string> {
  options: readonly (readonly [value: T, label: string])[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
  /** Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Group". */
  label: string;
  size?: "sm";
}

export function Segmented<T extends string>({ options, value, onChange, label, size }: SegmentedProps<T>): ReactElement {
  return (
    <span className={cx("seg", size)} role="group" aria-label={label}>
      {options.map(([key, text]) => (
        <button key={key} type="button" className={key === value ? "on" : undefined} aria-pressed={key === value} onClick={() => onChange(key)}>
          {text}
        </button>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** The one filter field: search icon + input (runs sidebar, panel search, runs table). */
import { type ReactElement, type Ref } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import "./chrome.css";

export interface FilterFieldProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder: string;
  /** Accessible name; defaults to the placeholder. */
  label?: string;
  size?: "sm";
  className?: string;
  inputRef?: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
}

export function FilterField({ value, onChange, placeholder, label, size, className, inputRef }: FilterFieldProps): ReactElement {
  return (
    <div className={cx("field", size, className)} role="search">
      <Icon name="search" size={13} />
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="search"
        value={value}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        aria-label={label ?? placeholder}
        spellCheck={false}
        autoComplete="off"
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Escape" && value !== "") {
            e.preventDefault();
            onChange("");
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** — `ui/src/chrome/StatusIcon.tsx`:

```tsx
/** Run status: a glyph and a word, never colour alone (spec section 7). */
import { type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import type { RunStatus } from "../api/models";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import "./chrome.css";

export type StatusKind = RunStatus | "stale";

export const STATUS_WORD: Record<StatusKind, string> = {
  finished: "finished",
  running: "running",
  queued: "queued",
  failed: "failed",
  killed: "killed",
  lost: "lost",
  stale: "stale",
};

function Glyph({ status }: { status: StatusKind }): ReactElement {
  switch (status) {
    case "finished":
      return <Icon name="check" />;
    case "running":
      return <Icon name="spinner" />;
    case "failed":
      return <Icon name="x" />;
    case "lost":
      return <Icon name="warn" />;
    default:
      return (
        <svg className="ico" width={12} height={12} viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.4} strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
          {status === "queued" ? <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="4.2" strokeDasharray="2 2" /> : null}
          {status === "killed" ? <rect x="3.2" y="3.2" width="5.6" height="5.6" rx="1" /> : null}
          {status === "stale" ? (
            <>
              <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="4.4" />
              <path d="M6 3.6V6l1.7 1.1" />
            </>
          ) : null}
        </svg>
      );
  }
}

export interface StatusIconProps {
  status: StatusKind;
  /** Text after the glyph (default: the status word), e.g. "failed · exit 137". */
  label?: ReactNode;
  /** Glyph only; the word becomes its accessible name. */
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  title?: string;
}

export function StatusIcon({ status, label, iconOnly = false, title }: StatusIconProps): ReactElement {
  return (
    <span
      className={`st ${status}`}
      title={title}
      role={iconOnly ? "img" : undefined}
      aria-label={iconOnly ? STATUS_WORD[status] : undefined}
    >
      <Glyph status={status} />
      {iconOnly ? null : (label ?? STATUS_WORD[status])}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** Who launched a run: an agent or human glyph and the name (`agent:tuner` -> tuner). */
import { type ReactElement } from "react";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import "./chrome.css";

export function launcherKind(who: string): "agent" | "human" {
  return who.startsWith("agent") ? "agent" : "human";
}

export function launcherName(who: string): string {
  const i = who.indexOf(":");
  if (i < 0) return who;
  return who.slice(i + 1) || who.slice(0, i);
}

export function Launcher({ who }: { who: string }): ReactElement {
  return (
    <span className="st launcher" title={who}>
      <Icon name={launcherKind(who)} />
      <span className="ln">{launcherName(who)}</span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

`ui/src/chrome/Avatar.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * Project avatar (spec section 7): an 18 px rounded square with the initials in one of 8
 * muted hues, hashed from the project name, on a tint of the same hue. The hues never
 * compete with run identity colours.
 */
import { type CSSProperties, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import "./chrome.css";

export const AVATAR_HUES = ["#4f5fc0", "#1f8a7a", "#8a4fb0", "#bf6a2a", "#5a7386", "#b8407a", "#3a8a4e", "#8a6a48"] as const;

export function avatarHue(name: string): string {
  let h = 0;
  for (const ch of name) h = (h * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0;
  return AVATAR_HUES[h % AVATAR_HUES.length] ?? AVATAR_HUES[0];
}

export function initials(name: string): string {
  const out = name
    .split(/[-_ ]/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((w) => w[0] ?? "")
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();
  return out || "?";
}

export function Avatar({ name, size = "md" }: { name: string; size?: "md" | "sm" }): ReactElement {
  return (
    <span className={cx("av", size === "sm" && "sm")} style={{ "--av": avatarHue(name) } as CSSProperties} aria-hidden="true">
      {initials(name)}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** One calm block for "nothing here yet" and "loading" (mockup `.empty`). */
import { type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import "./chrome.css";

export interface EmptyCommand {
  /** "1", "2", "or". */
  n: string;
  cmd: string;
  what: string;
}

export interface EmptyStateProps {
  title?: string;
  body?: ReactNode;
  commands?: readonly EmptyCommand[];
  links?: readonly { label: string; href: string }[];
  loading?: boolean;
}

export function EmptyState({ title, body, commands = [], links = [], loading = false }: EmptyStateProps): ReactElement {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="empty" role="status">
        <div className="spin-lg" aria-hidden="true" />
        {body ? <p>{body}</p> : null}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="empty">
      {title ? <h2>{title}</h2> : null}
      {body ? <p>{body}</p> : null}
      {commands.length > 0 ? (
        <ol className="cmds">
          {commands.map((c) => (
            <li className="ecmd" key={c.cmd}>
              <span className="n">{c.n}</span>
              <code title={c.cmd}>{c.cmd}</code>
              <span className="what">{c.what}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      ) : null}
      {links.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="links">
          {links.map((l) => (
            <a key={l.href} href={l.href}>
              {l.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- Produces:

Pages pass `storageKey={`${project}/${task}`}` so state is per task.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** — `ui/src/chrome/Panel.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * Panel chrome (spec principle 5, section 6): a white card with a title, an optional unit
 * and aside, always-visible tools, and hover tools (Full screen, Edit, More). It replaces
 * the v4 lettered `Figure`; the section is a region named by the title.
 */
import { type CSSProperties, type ReactElement, type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import "./chrome.css";

export interface PanelMenuItem {
  label: string;
  onSelect: () => void;
}

export interface PanelProps {
  title: string;
  unit?: ReactNode;
  aside?: ReactNode;
  /** Controls that stay visible (e.g. a `Table | Bars` switch). */
  tools?: ReactNode;
  onEdit?: () => void;
  menu?: readonly PanelMenuItem[];
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

export function Panel({ title, unit, aside, tools, onEdit, menu, className, style, children }: PanelProps): ReactElement {
  const [full, setFull] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!full) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setFull(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [full]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;
    const onDown = (e: Event): void => {
      if (!menuRef.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setMenuOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
  }, [menuOpen]);

  const hasAside = aside !== undefined && aside !== null && aside !== false && aside !== "";
  return (
    <section className={cx("panel", full && "full", className)} style={style} aria-label={title}>
      <header className="panel-h">
        <h3 className="t" title={title}>
          {title}
        </h3>
        {unit ? <span className="u">{unit}</span> : null}
        <span className="sp" />
        {hasAside ? <span className="aside">{aside}</span> : null}
        {tools}
        <span className="pacts">
          <button
            type="button"
            title={full ? "Exit full screen" : "Full screen"}
            aria-label="Full screen"
            aria-pressed={full}
            onClick={() => setFull((f) => !f)}
          >
            <Icon name="expand" />
          </button>
          {onEdit ? (
            <button type="button" title="Edit panel" aria-label="Edit panel" onClick={onEdit}>
              <Icon name="edit" />
            </button>
          ) : null}
          {menu && menu.length > 0 ? (
            <span className="pmenu" ref={menuRef}>
              <button
                type="button"
                title="More"
                aria-label="More"
                aria-haspopup="menu"
                aria-expanded={menuOpen}
                onClick={() => setMenuOpen((o) => !o)}
              >
                <Icon name="more" />
              </button>
              {menuOpen ? (
                <ul
                  className="menu"
                  role="menu"
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Escape") {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      setMenuOpen(false);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  {menu.map((item) => (
                    <li key={item.label} role="none">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        role="menuitem"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setMenuOpen(false);
                          item.onSelect();
                        }}
                      >
                        {item.label}
                      </button>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </span>
      </header>
      <div className="panel-b">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

`ui/src/chrome/PanelSection.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * A collapsible section of equal-size panels (spec 4.2 "Sections"). Closed sections do not
 * render their panels, so a task with 50+ score keys stays fast. With `storageKey` the open
 * state is remembered per task in localStorage.
 */
import { type ReactElement, type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import "./chrome.css";

export interface PanelSectionProps {
  title: string;
  count?: ReactNode;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onAddPanel?: () => void;
  /** Usually `${project}/${task}`; the state lives at `hx-section:<storageKey>:<title>`. */
  storageKey?: string;
  /** Grid: `auto` (min 330 px), `fill` (auto-fit, min 380 px), `wide` (one column), `small` (min 300 px). */
  grid?: "auto" | "fill" | "wide" | "small";
  children?: ReactNode;
}

const keyOf = (storageKey: string, title: string): string => `hx-section:${storageKey}:${title}`;

function readOpen(key: string | null, fallback: boolean): boolean {
  if (key === null) return fallback;
  try {
    const v = localStorage.getItem(key);
    return v === "1" ? true : v === "0" ? false : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export function PanelSection({ title, count, defaultOpen = true, onAddPanel, storageKey, grid = "auto", children }: PanelSectionProps): ReactElement {
  const key = storageKey ? keyOf(storageKey, title) : null;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(() => readOpen(key, defaultOpen));
  const toggle = (): void => {
    const next = !open;
    setOpen(next);
    if (key === null) return;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, next ? "1" : "0");
    } catch {
      // storage disabled: the section still toggles for this page
    }
  };
  return (
    <section className={cx("sec", !open && "closed")} aria-label={title}>
      <div className="sec-h">
        <button type="button" className="sec-t" aria-expanded={open} onClick={toggle}>
          <span className="caret">
            <Icon name="chevron" size={10} />
          </span>
          <span>{title}</span>
          {count !== undefined && count !== null ? <span className="n">{count}</span> : null}
        </button>
        {onAddPanel ? (
          <button type="button" className="add" onClick={onAddPanel}>
            + Add panel
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {open ? <div className={cx("pgrid", grid !== "auto" && grid)}>{children}</div> : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** The task URL: `tab` is `charts|runs|sweeps|examples|view:<name>`; the rest is the run selection. */
export interface TaskSearch {
  tab?: string;
  /** v4 view name (old Task page); the v5 page uses `tab=view:<name>`. */
  view?: string;
  sweep?: string;
  q?: string;
  group?: string;
  sort?: string;
  hide?: string;
  sup?: string;
}

export interface RunSearch {
  tab?: string;
  log?: string;
  example?: string;
}

/** The view the old Task page shows: `?view=`, else `?tab=view:<name>`. */
export function legacyView(search: TaskSearch): string | undefined {
  if (search.view) return search.view;
  return search.tab?.startsWith("view:") ? search.tab.slice(5) || undefined : undefined;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `ui/src/shell/NavTree.tsx`**

```tsx
/**
 * Left navigation (spec section 3): Home, Hosts and Queue with counts, then a project ->
 * task tree with run counts and a spinner on tasks that have running runs.
 */
import { Link, useRouterState } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { type ReactElement, useMemo } from "react";

import type { RunRecord, TaskSummary } from "../api/models";
import { useHosts, useOverview, useTasks } from "../api/queries";
import { Avatar } from "../chrome/Avatar";
import { Icon } from "../chrome/Icon";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import "./shell.css";

export interface NavTask {
  task: string;
  runs: number;
  running: number;
}

export interface NavProject {
  project: string;
  tasks: NavTask[];
}

const key = (project: string, task: string): string => `${project}\u0000${task}`;

/** Projects and their tasks, by name, with run counts and running runs. */
export function buildTree(tasks: readonly TaskSummary[], active: readonly RunRecord[]): NavProject[] {
  const running = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const r of active) {
    if (r.status !== "running" || !r.task) continue;
    const k = key(r.project, r.task);
    running.set(k, (running.get(k) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const byProject = new Map<string, NavTask[]>();
  for (const t of tasks) {
    const list = byProject.get(t.project) ?? [];
    list.push({ task: t.name, runs: t.n_runs, running: running.get(key(t.project, t.name)) ?? 0 });
    byProject.set(t.project, list);
  }
  return [...byProject.entries()]
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .map(([project, list]) => ({ project, tasks: list.sort((a, b) => a.task.localeCompare(b.task)) }));
}

const decode = (s: string): string => {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(s);
  } catch {
    return s;
  }
};

/** True on `/t/<project>/<task>` and its sub-pages. */
export function isTaskPath(pathname: string, project: string, task: string): boolean {
  const parts = pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).map(decode);
  return parts[0] === "t" && parts[1] === project && parts[2] === task;
}

export function NavTree(): ReactElement {
  const tasks = useTasks();
  const overview = useOverview();
  const hosts = useHosts();
  const pathname = useRouterState({ select: (s) => s.location.pathname });
  const tree = useMemo(() => buildTree(tasks.data ?? [], overview.data?.running ?? []), [tasks.data, overview.data]);
  const queued = overview.data?.counts.queued;
  const current = (on: boolean) => (on ? ("page" as const) : undefined);
  return (
    <nav className="nav-tree" aria-label="Navigation">
      <div className="nav-sec">
        <Link className={cx("item", pathname === "/" && "on")} to="/" aria-current={current(pathname === "/")}>
          <Icon name="home" />
          Home
        </Link>
        <Link className={cx("item", pathname === "/hosts" && "on")} to="/hosts" aria-current={current(pathname === "/hosts")}>
          <Icon name="hosts" />
          Hosts
          {hosts.data ? <span className="count">{hosts.data.length}</span> : null}
        </Link>
        <Link className={cx("item", pathname === "/queue" && "on")} to="/queue" aria-current={current(pathname === "/queue")}>
          <Icon name="queue" />
          Queue
          {queued !== undefined ? <span className="count">{queued}</span> : null}
        </Link>
      </div>
      <div className="nav-h">Projects</div>
      <div className="nav-sec grow">
        {tree.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="nav-empty">{tasks.isPending ? "Loading…" : "No projects yet"}</p>
        ) : (
          tree.map((p) => (
            <div key={p.project}>
              <div className="item proj" title={p.project}>
                <Avatar name={p.project} />
                <span className="pn">{p.project}</span>
              </div>
              {p.tasks.map((t) => {
                const on = isTaskPath(pathname, p.project, t.task);
                return (
                  <Link
                    key={t.task}
                    className={cx("item task", on && "on")}
                    to="/t/$project/$task"
                    params={{ project: p.project, task: t.task }}
                    aria-current={current(on)}
                    title={`${p.project} / ${t.task}`}
                  >
                    {t.running > 0 ? <StatusIcon status="running" iconOnly title={`${t.running} running`} /> : null}
                    <span className="tn">{t.task}</span>
                    <span className="count">{t.runs}</span>
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * Top bar (spec section 3): breadcrumb from the route, the command palette button (⌘K),
 * the live-updates indicator and `New run` (the existing Launch dialog).
 */
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useRouterState } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { type ReactElement, useState } from "react";

import { api } from "../api/client";
import { useStreamStatus } from "../api/events";
import type { RunDetail } from "../api/models";
import { queryKeys, useProjects } from "../api/queries";
import { shortId } from "../charts/valueFormat";
import { Button } from "../chrome/Button";
import { Icon } from "../chrome/Icon";
import { LaunchDialog } from "../launch/LaunchDialog";
import { AppLink, hrefs, useNavigateHref } from "../pages/components/links";
import "./shell.css";

export interface Crumb {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}

export interface RunCrumb {
  project: string;
  task: string | null;
  name: string;
}

const decode = (s: string): string => {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(s);
  } catch {
    return s;
  }
};
const segments = (pathname: string): string[] => pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).map(decode);

/** The breadcrumb of a pathname; `run` is the open run's project, task and name once loaded. */
export function crumbsFor(pathname: string, run?: RunCrumb | null): Crumb[] {
  const p = segments(pathname);
  if (p.length === 0) return [{ label: "Home" }];
  switch (p[0]) {
    case "t": {
      const project = p[1] ?? "";
      const task = p[2] ?? "";
      const out: Crumb[] = [{ label: project }, { label: task, href: hrefs.task(project, task) }];
      if (p[3] === "edit" && p[4]) out.push({ label: p[4] === "new" ? "new view" : `edit ${p[4]}` });
      return out;
    }
    case "r":
      if (!run) return [{ label: shortId(p[1] ?? "") }];
      return [
        { label: run.project },
        ...(run.task ? [{ label: run.task, href: hrefs.task(run.project, run.task) }] : []),
        { label: run.name },
      ];
    case "x":
      return [{ label: "Examples" }, { label: `${shortId(p[1] ?? "")} vs ${shortId(p[2] ?? "")}` }];
    case "s":
      return [{ label: p[1] ?? "" }, { label: `sweep ${p[2] ?? ""}` }];
    case "hosts":
      return [{ label: "Hosts" }];
    case "queue":
      return [{ label: "Queue" }];
    default:
      return [{ label: "Not found" }];
  }
}

/** "⌘K" on Apple platforms, "Ctrl K" elsewhere. */
export function paletteShortcut(platform: string = navigator.platform): string {
  return /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(platform) ? "⌘K" : "Ctrl K";
}

function LiveDot(): ReactElement {
  const status = useStreamStatus();
  const word = status === "ready" ? "live" : status === "offline" ? "offline" : "connecting";
  const name = status === "ready" ? "on" : status === "offline" ? "off" : "reconnecting";
  const title =
    status === "ready"
      ? "Live updates on"
      : status === "offline"
        ? "Live updates are off: data is not live, reload to reconnect"
        : "Reconnecting live updates: data is not live yet";
  return (
    <span className={`live ${word}`} role="status" aria-label={`Live updates ${name}`} title={title}>
      <i aria-hidden="true" />
      {word}
    </span>
  );
}

interface LaunchTarget {
  project: string;
  task: string | null;
  repo: string;
}

export interface TopBarProps {
  onSearch: () => void;
  navOpen: boolean;
  onToggleNav: () => void;
}

export function TopBar({ onSearch, navOpen, onToggleNav }: TopBarProps): ReactElement {
  const pathname = useRouterState({ select: (s) => s.location.pathname });
  const parts = segments(pathname);
  const runId = parts[0] === "r" ? (parts[1] ?? null) : null;
  // the run page reads the same key, so this adds no request
  const run = useQuery<RunDetail>({
    queryKey: queryKeys.run(runId ?? ""),
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => api.run(runId ?? "", signal),
    enabled: runId !== null,
  });
  const record = runId !== null ? run.data?.record : undefined;
  const crumbs = crumbsFor(
    pathname,
    record ? { project: record.project, task: record.task, name: record.name ?? shortId(record.run_id) } : null,
  );

  const projects = useProjects();
  const navigate = useNavigateHref();
  const [launching, setLaunching] = useState(false);
  const routeProject = parts[0] === "t" || parts[0] === "s" ? parts[1] : record?.project;
  const routeTask = parts[0] === "t" ? (parts[2] ?? null) : (record?.task ?? null);
  const info = routeProject ? projects.data?.find((p) => p.project === routeProject) : projects.data?.[0];
  const target: LaunchTarget | null = info ? { project: info.project, task: routeProject ? routeTask : null, repo: info.repo } : null;

  return (
    <header className="top">
      {navOpen ? null : (
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" iconOnly icon="queue" aria-label="Show navigation" title="Show navigation (⌘.)" onClick={onToggleNav} />
      )}
      <nav className="crumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
        {crumbs.map((c, i) => {
          const last = i === crumbs.length - 1;
          return (
            <span key={`${i}-${c.label}`} style={{ display: "contents" }}>
              {i > 0 ? (
                <span className="sep" aria-hidden="true">
                  /
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {last ? <b aria-current="page">{c.label}</b> : c.href ? <AppLink href={c.href}>{c.label}</AppLink> : <span>{c.label}</span>}
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
      <span className="sp" />
      <button className="search" id="findBtn" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={onSearch}>
        <Icon name="search" size={13} />
        <span>Search runs, tasks, paths</span>
        <kbd>{paletteShortcut()}</kbd>
      </button>
      <LiveDot />
      <Button
        variant="primary"
        icon="plus"
        disabled={target === null}
        title={target ? `New run in ${target.project}${target.task ? ` / ${target.task}` : ""}` : "No project yet: run hx init"}
        onClick={() => setLaunching(true)}
      >
        New run
      </Button>
      {launching && target ? (
        <LaunchDialog
          project={target.project}
          task={target.task}
          repo={target.repo}
          onClose={() => setLaunching(false)}
          onLaunched={(records) => {
            setLaunching(false);
            const first = records[0];
            if (first) navigate(hrefs.run(first.run_id));
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </header>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * The v5 frame (spec section 3): 216 px nav (brand, NavTree, hub version, theme), the top
 * bar, the routed page; the command palette and the one chart tooltip are mounted here.
 * ⌘. / Ctrl+. hides or shows the nav (kept in localStorage).
 */
import { Link, Outlet } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { type ReactElement, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { useStreamStatus } from "../api/events";
import { useHubEnvironment } from "../api/queries";
import { TooltipHost } from "../charts/Tooltip";
import { cx } from "../lib/cx";
import { CommandPalette } from "./CommandPalette";
import { NavTree } from "./NavTree";
import { ThemeToggle } from "./ThemeToggle";
import { TopBar } from "./TopBar";
import "./shell.css";

export const NAV_KEY = "hx-nav";

function readNavOpen(): boolean {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(NAV_KEY) !== "0";
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

function Brand(): ReactElement {
  return (
    <Link className="brand" to="/" aria-label="Hypothex, home">
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" aria-hidden="true">
        <rect x="1" y="9" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="currentColor" opacity=".35" />
        <rect x="5.5" y="5" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="currentColor" opacity=".6" />
        <rect x="10" y="1" width="3" height="16" rx="1" fill="currentColor" />
        <circle cx="15.5" cy="3" r="1.8" fill="var(--c3)" />
      </svg>
      Hypothex
    </Link>
  );
}

function HubVersion(): ReactElement {
  const env = useHubEnvironment();
  const status = useStreamStatus();
  const version = env.data?.hx_version;
  return (
    <span className={cx("hub", status === "ready" && "live")} title="Hub version">
      <i aria-hidden="true" />
      {typeof version === "string" ? `hub · v${version}` : "hub"}
    </span>
  );
}

export function AppShell(): ReactElement {
  const [paletteOpen, setPaletteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(readNavOpen);
  const toggleNav = useCallback(() => setNavOpen((open) => !open), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(NAV_KEY, navOpen ? "1" : "0");
    } catch {
      // storage disabled: the nav still toggles for this page
    }
  }, [navOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === ".") {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleNav();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [toggleNav]);

  return (
    <div className={cx("app", !navOpen && "nav-off")}>
      {navOpen ? (
        <aside className="nav">
          <Brand />
          <NavTree />
          <div className="nav-foot">
            <HubVersion />
            <ThemeToggle />
          </div>
        </aside>
      ) : null}
      <div className="main">
        <TopBar onSearch={() => setPaletteOpen(true)} navOpen={navOpen} onToggleNav={toggleNav} />
        <main className="app-page">
          <Outlet />
        </main>
      </div>
      <CommandPalette open={paletteOpen} onOpenChange={setPaletteOpen} />
      <TooltipHost />
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Replace `ui/src/pages/components/PanelGrid.tsx`**

```tsx
/** Lay out panel results in v5 panel chrome on the min-330 px grid, via the panel registry. */
import { type CSSProperties, type ComponentType, createContext, useContext } from "react";
import { Panel } from "../../chrome/Panel";
import { PANELS, PanelBoundary, PanelError } from "../../panels";
import { useInAppLinks } from "./links";
import type { RunStatus } from "../../api/models";
import type { PanelResult, PanelSpec } from "./types";

interface PanelContextProps { selectedItemId?: string; currentGroupId?: string; runStatus?: RunStatus; }
export type PanelComponent = ComponentType<{ result: PanelResult } & PanelContextProps>;
export type PanelRegistry = Partial<Record<string, PanelComponent>>;

// The registry's props allow a missing `meta`; API results always carry one, so widen
// the registry's type once here.
export const PanelRegistryContext = createContext<PanelRegistry>(PANELS as unknown as PanelRegistry);

/**
 * Render one panel result with its registered component.
 *
 * A panel whose query failed on the server (`meta.error`, with `rows: []`) shows that
 * reason instead of the panel's empty state. Unknown types and panels that throw show
 * the registry's error box, so one bad panel never blanks the page.
 */
export function PanelBody({ result, ...context }: { result: PanelResult } & PanelContextProps) {
  const registry = useContext(PanelRegistryContext);
  const onLinks = useInAppLinks();
  const failed = result.meta.error;
  if (typeof failed === "string") return <PanelError message={failed} />;
  const Component = registry[result.type];
  if (!Component) return <PanelError message={`Unknown panel type: ${result.type}`} />;
  // Panels render plain <a href> run links; route plain clicks on them in-app.
  return (
    <div className="panel-links" style={{ display: "contents" }} onClick={onLinks}>
      <PanelBoundary>
        <Component result={result} {...context} />
      </PanelBoundary>
    </div>
  );
}

/** A grid span in 1..12; missing means full width. */
export function clampSpan(span?: number): number {
  if (span === undefined || !Number.isFinite(span)) return 12;
  return Math.min(12, Math.max(1, Math.round(span)));
}

/** A full-width view panel (span 12, or no span) takes the whole row; any other span one cell. */
export function panelGridStyle(span?: number): CSSProperties | undefined {
  return clampSpan(span) === 12 ? { gridColumn: "1 / -1" } : undefined;
}

function warnings(result: PanelResult): string[] {
  const raw = result.meta.warnings;
  return Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.filter((w): w is string => typeof w === "string") : [];
}

export interface PanelGridProps extends PanelContextProps {
  results: PanelResult[];
  specs?: PanelSpec[];
}

export function PanelGrid({ results, specs, ...context }: PanelGridProps) {
  return (
    <div className="pgrid panel-grid">
      {results.map((result, i) => {
        const spec = specs?.[i];
        const warn = warnings(result);
        return (
          <Panel
            key={`${i}-${result.type}`}
            title={result.title || spec?.title || result.type}
            aside={warn.length ? <span title={warn.join("\n")}>⚠ {warn.length}</span> : undefined}
            style={panelGridStyle(spec?.layout?.span)}
          >
            <PanelBody result={result} {...context} />
          </Panel>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** A run log tail (opened from failures and the Where list via `?log=<stream>`). */
import { useRunLogs } from "../../api/queries";
import { Panel } from "../../chrome/Panel";
import { fmtBytes } from "./format";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "./links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "./QueryState";
import type { LogStream } from "./types";

export function LogView({ runId, stream }: { runId: string; stream: LogStream }) {
  const log = useRunLogs(runId, stream);
  return (
    <Panel title={stream} aside={log.data ? fmtBytes(log.data.size) : undefined}>
      {log.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={log.error} />
      ) : log.data ? (
        <pre className="log">{log.data.text.trimEnd() || "empty"}</pre>
      ) : (
        <Loading />
      )}
      <AppLink className="btn link" href={hrefs.run(runId)}>
        close
      </AppLink>
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export interface TraceSectionProps {
  runId: string;
  example?: string;
  title: string;
}

export function TraceSection({ runId, example, title }: TraceSectionProps) {
  const list = useRunTraces(runId);
  const traces = list.data ?? [];
  const chosen = example ? String(example) : pickExample(traces);
  const trace = useRunTrace(runId, chosen);
  return (
    <Panel title={chosen ? `${title} · ${chosen}` : title} aside={list.data ? `${traces.length} traced` : undefined}>
      {list.error ? <ErrorBox error={list.error} /> : null}
      {traces.length > 0 ? (
        <nav className="trace-pick" aria-label="Traced examples">
          {traces.map((t) => (
            <AppLink
              key={t.example_id}
              href={hrefs.run(runId, { example: t.example_id })}
              aria-current={t.example_id === chosen ? "true" : undefined}
              className={t.failed ? "failed" : undefined}
              title={`${t.turns} turns${t.failed ? ", failed" : ""}`}
            >
              {t.example_id}
            </AppLink>
          ))}
        </nav>
      ) : list.data ? (
        <p className="small">no traces</p>
      ) : null}
      {trace.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={trace.error} />
      ) : trace.data ? (
        <PanelBody result={trace.data} />
      ) : chosen ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : null}
    </Panel>
  );
}

export interface KindPanelsProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  runId: string;
  specs: PanelSpec[];
  example?: string;
  currentGroupId?: string;
  runStatus?: RunStatus;
}

export function KindPanels({ project, task, runId, specs, example, currentGroupId, runStatus }: KindPanelsProps) {
  // `specs` is memoized by the caller, so `regular` and `results` keep their identity across renders
  const { regular, trace } = useMemo(() => splitRunView(specs), [specs]);
  const traceList = useRunTraces(runId, trace !== null);
  const chosen = example ? String(example) : pickExample(traceList.data ?? []);
  const traceFirst = specs[0]?.type === "trace";
  // A current-target grid must never briefly render every target while selection loads.
  const waitingForTarget = trace !== null && regular.some((p) => p.type === "grid") && chosen === null;
  const trajectory = trace ? <TraceSection runId={runId} example={chosen ?? undefined} title={trace.title || "Trajectory"} /> : null;
  const panels = useViewQuery(
    project,
    task,
    regular.length > 0 ? { view: { title: "run", panels: regular.map((p) => scopeToRun(p, runId)) } } : null,
  );
  const results = useMemo(
    () => panels.data?.panels.map((result, i) => withoutSweeps(result, regular[i])),
    [panels.data, regular],
  );
  if (specs.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <>
      {traceFirst ? trajectory : null}
      {panels.error ? <ErrorBox error={panels.error} /> : null}
      {regular.length > 0 && results && !waitingForTarget ? (
        <PanelGrid results={results} specs={regular} selectedItemId={chosen ?? undefined} currentGroupId={currentGroupId} runStatus={runStatus} />
      ) : waitingForTarget && traceList.data ? (
        <p className="small">No traced example available for comparison</p>
      ) : regular.length > 0 && !panels.error && !traceList.error ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : null}
      {traceFirst ? null : trajectory}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** 0 -> "a", 25 -> "z", 26 -> "aa": the editor's names for panels on the layout ruler. */
export function panelLetter(index: number): string {
  let n = index;
  let out = "";
  do {
    out = String.fromCharCode(97 + (n % 26)) + out;
    n = Math.floor(n / 26) - 1;
  } while (n >= 0);
  return out;
}
```

## Contract conflicts and open questions (for the plan owner)

1. **Rename body.** The contract says `NameBody {name: str | None}`. Every other run write (`TagBody`, `NoteBody`, `FlagBody` in `src/hypothex/api/app.py`) subclasses `ActionBody` (`command_id`, `created_by`) for idempotent retries and the event's author, and `api.renameRun` sends `{command_id, created_by, name}` through the shared `action()` helper. Recommendation: `class NameBody(ActionBody): name: str | None = None`. If the backend keeps the bare body, pydantic ignores the extra fields (no `extra="forbid"` in `app.py`), so nothing breaks either way.
2. **Selection URL keys.** Spec section 6 says `?filter=&group=&sort=&hide=`; the contract says `?q=&group=&sort=&hide=&sup=`. This part follows the contract (`TaskSearch.q`, `sup`).
3. **Nav run counts.** `TaskSummary.n_runs` (`GET /api/v1/tasks`) counts **finished** runs only (`core/queries.py:407`); the mockup's "39" reads like all runs. The nav shows `n_runs` as is. If all runs are wanted, change `n_runs` server-side (one count query) rather than reading `taskRuns` per task in the nav.
4. **Run crumb name.** `RunDetail` has no derived name, so the top bar shows `record.name ?? shortId(run_id)`. If the Run part adds `derived_name` to `RunDetail`, switch `TopBar` to it (one line in `TopBar.tsx`).
5. **`/s/$project/$id` redirect** needs the sweep's task (`GET /sweeps/{project}/{id}` → `spec.task`); left to the Task part's Sweeps task (`beforeLoad` + `redirect`).
6. **`value_format`** is untyped in the contract; `TaskRuns.value_format: string | null` here (the leaderboard's is `string | undefined`).
7. **`TaskRun.params`** is `Record<string, string>` like `RunRecord.params`; the filter `String()`s values, so numeric params from the server still match.
8. **v4 panels keep their own series palette** (`--cat-1..5`, pinned by `test/panels/VegaLite.test.tsx`) and colour by series index, not identity. Re-colouring `panels/*` by identity is outside "rendered inside `chrome/Panel`" and belongs to whichever part ports them.
9. **View editor letters.** The editor's layout preview names panels a, b, c against the YAML (`editor/Preview.tsx`, ruler label "c: span 7, row 2"); `panelLetter` moved there in F17 instead of being deleted. The Task part's "view editor restyled with the new chrome" decides whether letters stay.
10. **`layout.row`** of view panels is no longer applied by `PanelGrid` (auto-fill grid; span 12 = full row, smaller spans = one cell). The editor preview still shows the 12-column layout.

# Part 3 — Task page

## Part 3 — Task page (`ui/src/task/*`, T1–T7)

Summary (5 lines):
1. T1–T2 build the run list that drives the page: URL state (`useRunSelection`, `?q=&group=&sort=&hide=&sup=`), identities, and the `RunsSidebar` (filter, group, sort, superseded, eye, rename, hover highlight).
2. T3 replaces `pages/Task.tsx` with `task/TaskPage.tsx`: header + facts line, `Re-evaluate all`, `+ New run`, tabs via `?tab=`, custom view tabs (`ViewTab`), the kind's preset panels and extras (`KindSection`), Examples tab; old page and its test deleted.
3. T4 fills the Charts tab: toolbar (panel search, smoothing, x axis, seeds, `+ Panel`, `Save as view`), Scores, Step metrics (from `views/query` curves, `group_by: group`), Score keys.
4. T5 adds the Compare panel (table default, Bars switch, keep-one chips, `compare` view panel + registry entry); T6 the Runs tab (full table, column chooser, bulk Compare/Tag/Archive/Rename).
5. T7 adds the Sweeps tab (list, header actions, parallel coordinates, mean-per-cell table, what matters, best cell), `/s/$project/$id` redirect, and deletes `pages/Sweep.tsx`.

| Old (v4 Task page / Sweep page) | v5 home | Task |

Requests to other parts (this part works without them; the feature they unlock is noted):
- B3: `TaskRun.commit: str | None` (Runs tab Commit column; the UI type gets `commit?: string | null` in T1, so the column is empty until the server sends it).
- B (views/query `compare`): rows one per group and key; `meta.render` and `meta.higher_is_better` (T5's registry panel reads them; table and higher-is-better otherwise).
- B (curves rows): `t: float | None` from `MetricPoint.t` (T4's "wall time" / "relative time" x axes stay disabled until a row has `t`).
- F6: `LineSeries.group?: string` matched by `highlight` (so "each seed" lines of a hovered config highlight together; until then T4 turns hover highlight off in that mode).

## Global Constraints

- UI: Bun, React 19, TanStack Router + Query, plain CSS, d3 for math only; tests `bun test` with Testing Library + happy-dom (`ui/test/setup.ts`), files under `ui/test/task/`.
- Every task ends with `cd ui && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test` green; the app builds after every task.
- Commits: conventional, no `Co-Authored-By` line, no mention of AI tools.
- Test data uses synthetic names only (`toy-proj`, `test-a`, `model-x`, `db v3`); never the owner's real project, dataset or person names.
- Colour is identity only: `colorFor(id, visibleIdentities(...))`; a 9th visible identity is `var(--c0)`.
- No generated headline sentences, no lettered figures, no explanatory prose on the page (tooltips explain).
- Tabular figures in tables; Geist Mono for ids, paths and commits.

## Review Focus

1. A task with no runs (new task, or all archived): sidebar says "No runs yet", Charts sends no `views/query` for step metrics, Compare does not render, Runs tab shows an empty state (tests in T2, T4, T6).
2. More than 8 visible identities: the 9th and later rows and chart marks are neutral grey, never a reused colour (test in T2).
3. Score keys missing for some runs, or a key set where only one dataset exists: the Compare table shows `—`, no best is marked from a single value, and Compare is hidden below two datasets (tests in T5).
4. Stale or hand-edited URLs: unknown `?tab=`, a `?sort=` key that no longer exists, `?hide=` ids that are gone: the page renders Charts / sorts by creation / ignores the ids (tests in T1, T3).
5. A rename the server rejects (422: over 80 chars or a newline) shows the server's message on the row and keeps the old name (test in T2).

```ts
 * `makeTaskRuns()`: training task `toy-proj/toy-task`, primary `top1/value` (higher is
 * better), four configs:
 *   g-a "lr 3e-4 · beam 10"  a1 0.912, a2 0.910 (tag final), a3 running   best
 *   g-b "lr 1e-4 · beam 10"  b1 0.899, b2 0.897 (host dgx)                outside noise, p 0.01
 *   g-c "lr 1e-3 · beam 1"   c1 failed (exit 1), c2 queued                 unscored
 *   g-d "baseline"           d1 0.905, seed null, human:sam, superseded    inside noise, p 0.24
 * `makeEvalTaskRuns()`: eval task, keys `reported/<test-a..test-e>.<model-x|model-y>.<top1|top10>`,
 * one run per `db v1..v3` (v3 best), `key_parts` `["dataset", "model", "metric"]`; run v1
 * lacks `reported/test-e.model-y.top1`.
 */

import { RUN_RF, RUN_SVM } from "../pages/fixtures";

    name: "lr 3e-4 · beam 10",

    seed: 1,
    status: "finished",
    end_reason: null,
    exit_code: 0,
    created_by: "agent:tuner",
    created_at: "2026-10-03T09:00:00Z",
    started_at: "2026-10-03T09:00:05Z",

const stats = (mean: number, std: number, n: number): Stats => ({

export const DATASETS = ["test-a", "test-b", "test-c", "test-d", "test-e"] as const;
export const MODELS = ["model-x", "model-y"] as const;
export const METRICS = ["top1", "top10"] as const;
export const EVAL_PRIMARY = "reported/test-a.model-x.top10";

/** `0.4 + 0.1·db − 0.05·dataset − 0.03·model + 0.3·(metric is top10)`, three decimals. */
export function evalValue(db: number, d: number, m: number, t: number): number {
  return Number((0.4 + 0.1 * db - 0.05 * d - 0.03 * m + 0.3 * t).toFixed(3));
}

export function makeEvalTaskRuns(): TaskRuns {
  const keys = DATASETS.flatMap((d) => MODELS.flatMap((m) => METRICS.map((t) => `reported/${d}.${m}.${t}`)));
  const runs = ["v1", "v2", "v3"].map((db, i) => {
    const scores: Record<string, number> = {};
    DATASETS.forEach((d, di) => MODELS.forEach((m, mi) => METRICS.forEach((t, ti) => {
      scores[`reported/${d}.${m}.${t}`] = evalValue(i, di, mi, ti);
    })));
    if (db === "v1") delete scores["reported/test-e.model-y.top1"];
    return makeTaskRun({
      run_id: `run-${db}`,
      group_id: `g-${db}`,
      seed: null,
      name: `db ${db}`,
      derived_name: `db ${db}`,
      params: { db },
      created_at: `2026-10-0${i + 1}T09:00:00Z`,
      scores,
      primary: scores[EVAL_PRIMARY] ?? null,
      gpu_hours: null,
    });
  });
  const groups = runs.map((run) =>
    makeTaskGroup({
      group_id: run.group_id,
      name: run.derived_name,
      run_ids: [run.run_id],
      primary: stats(run.primary ?? 0, 0, 1),
      scores: run.scores,
      seed_values: [run.primary ?? 0],
      is_best: run.run_id === "run-v3",
      within_noise_of_best: run.run_id === "run-v3",
    }),
  );
  return {
    project: PROJECT,
    task: TASK,
    kind: "generic",
    primary: EVAL_PRIMARY,
    higher_is_better: true,
    unit: "",
    value_format: "fraction",
    varying_keys: ["db"],
    metric_names: [],
    score_keys: keys,
    key_parts: ["dataset", "model", "metric"],
    runs,
    groups,
  };
}

/** `toy-classifier/toy-test` (the leaderboard of `test/pages/fixtures.ts` `makeBoard()`). */

/** The resolved preset view (`GET .../views/overview`) for a kind. */
export function presetDoc(kind: "generic" | "training" | "system_bench" | "agent_iteration" = "generic"): ViewDocument {
  const info: ViewInfo = { name: "overview", title: "Overview", origin: "preset", path: null, kind };
  const panels: ViewDocument["view"]["panels"] =
    kind === "training"
      ? [
          { type: "stat_strip", title: "Summary", layout: { span: 12, row: 1 } },
          { type: "leaderboard", title: "Configs", noise: ["seed", "test_set"], layout: { span: 12, row: 2 } },
          { type: "curves", title: "Curves", data: { metrics: ["train/loss"], group_by: "group" }, layout: { span: 12, row: 3 } },
          { type: "table", title: "Runs", data: { source: "runs", fields: ["run_id"] }, layout: { span: 8, row: 4 } },
          { type: "curves", title: "Checkpoints", data: { metrics: ["val/top1"], group_by: "run" }, layout: { span: 12, row: 5 } },
        ]
      : [
          { type: "stat_strip", title: "Summary", layout: { span: 12, row: 1 } },
          { type: "leaderboard", title: "Leaderboard", noise: ["seed", "test_set"], layout: { span: 12, row: 2 } },
        ];
  return { info, text: "title: overview\n", view: { title: "overview", panels } };
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/task/useSearchState.ts
/**
 * The page URL's search string as React state, with or without a router.
 *
 * Under the app's TanStack router it reads and writes the router's history, so links,
 * the back button and the router see every change; in tests and embeds without a router it
 * uses `window.history`. Writes replace the history entry unless `push` is set (tab
 * switches push, filter typing replaces).
 */
import { useRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useCallback, useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

export type SearchPatch = Record<string, string | null | undefined>;
export type SetSearch = (patch: SearchPatch, opts?: { push?: boolean }) => void;

interface HistoryLike {
  location: { pathname: string; search: string; hash: string };
  push: (href: string) => void;
  replace: (href: string) => void;
  subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void;
}

const windowListeners = new Set<() => void>();
const notifyWindow = (): void => {
  for (const listener of windowListeners) listener();
};

const windowHistory: HistoryLike = {
  get location() {
    return window.location;
  },
  push: (href) => {
    window.history.pushState(null, "", href);
    notifyWindow();
  },
  replace: (href) => {
    window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, "", href);
    notifyWindow();
  },
  subscribe: (listener) => {
    windowListeners.add(listener);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", listener);
    return () => {
      windowListeners.delete(listener);
      window.removeEventListener("popstate", listener);
    };
  },
};

/** `search` with `patch` applied: `null`, `undefined` or `""` removes a key; other keys keep their order. */
export function applySearch(search: string, patch: SearchPatch): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(patch)) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") params.delete(key);
    else params.set(key, value);
  }
  const out = params.toString();
  return out ? `?${out}` : "";
}

/** The current search params and a setter that patches them in place. */
export function useSearchState(): [URLSearchParams, SetSearch] {
  const router = useRouter({ warn: false }) as unknown as { history: HistoryLike } | null | undefined;
  const history = router?.history ?? windowHistory;
  const search = useSyncExternalStore(history.subscribe, () => history.location.search, () => "");
  const params = useMemo(() => new URLSearchParams(search), [search]);
  const set = useCallback<SetSearch>(
    (patch, opts = {}) => {
      const { pathname, search: current, hash } = history.location;
      const next = `${pathname}${applySearch(current, patch)}${hash}`;
      if (opts.push) history.push(next);
      else history.replace(next);
    },
    [history],
  );
  return [params, set];
}
```
