```ts
// ui/src/task/useRunSelection.ts
/**
 * Run-list state for one task, in the URL so a view is shareable (spec 4.2, §6):
 * `?q=` filter text, `?group=run` (each run instead of by config), `?sort=<key>:<dir>`,
 * `?hide=<id>,<id>` hidden identities, `?sup=1` (show runs tagged `superseded`). Defaults
 * stay out of the URL.
 *
 * An identity is a config group (By config) or a run (Each run). It gets one colour in
 * every panel: `colorFor(id, visibleIdentities(selection, data))`.
 */
import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import type { TaskGroup, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { parseFilter } from "../lib/runFilter";
import { type SearchPatch, useSearchState } from "./useSearchState";

export type SortDir = "asc" | "desc";
export type GroupMode = "config" | "run";

export interface Selection {
  filter: string;
  group: GroupMode;
  sort: { key: string; dir: SortDir };
  hidden: string[];
  showSuperseded: boolean;
}

export interface SelectionDefaults {
  /** Direction of the default primary sort: best first (`desc` when higher is better). */
  sortDir: SortDir;
}

export const SORT_PRIMARY = "primary";
export const SORT_CREATED = "created";
export const SUPERSEDED_TAG = "superseded";

/** One row of the run list: a config group or a single run. */
export interface Identity {
  id: string;
  kind: "group" | "run";
  /** Display name (a run: base name and ` · seed N` unless renamed). */
  name: string;
  /** Name without the seed: what a rename edits. */
  baseName: string;
  runs: TaskRun[];
  /** The config group (for a run: the group it belongs to). */
  group: TaskGroup | null;
  /** Primary value: group mean over seeds, or the run's own value. */
  value: number | null;
  /** Seed standard deviation of a group with more than one scored seed. */
  sd: number | null;
  hidden: boolean;
}

/** Short label of a score key: `top1/value` → `top1`, `reported/test-a.model-x.top10` → `test-a.model-x.top10`. */
export function keyLabel(key: string): string {
  const cut = key.indexOf("/");
  if (cut < 0) return key;
  const rest = key.slice(cut + 1);
  return rest === "value" || rest === "" ? key.slice(0, cut) : rest;
}

/** The run's explicit name when renamed, else its derived name. */
export function runBaseName(run: TaskRun): string {
  return (run.renamed ? run.name : null) ?? run.derived_name;
}

/** What a run row shows: a renamed run's name, else the derived name with ` · seed N`. */
export function runLabel(run: TaskRun): string {
  const base = runBaseName(run);
  return run.renamed || run.seed === null ? base : `${base} · seed ${run.seed}`;
}

/** The most recently created run. */
export function latestRun(runs: readonly TaskRun[]): TaskRun | undefined {
  return runs.reduce<TaskRun | undefined>((a, r) => (a === undefined || r.created_at > a.created_at ? r : a), undefined);
}

const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);

/** A score of an identity: the group's mean for a group, the run's value for a run. */
export function scoreOf(item: Identity, key: string): number | null {
  if (item.kind === "group" && item.group) return item.group.scores[key] ?? null;
  const values = item.runs.map((r) => r.scores[key]).filter(finite);
  return values.length ? values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length : null;
}

/** Every run of the identity is tagged `superseded`. */
export function isSuperseded(item: Identity): boolean {
  return item.runs.every((r) => r.tags.includes(SUPERSEDED_TAG));
}

/** All identities of a task, unsorted, unfiltered, none hidden. */
export function identities(data: TaskRuns, group: GroupMode): Identity[] {
  const groupOf = new Map(data.groups.map((g) => [g.group_id, g]));
  if (group === "run") {
    return data.runs.map(
      (run): Identity => ({
        id: run.run_id,
        kind: "run",
        name: runLabel(run),
        baseName: runBaseName(run),
        runs: [run],
        group: groupOf.get(run.group_id) ?? null,
        value: run.primary,
        sd: null,
        hidden: false,
      }),
    );
  }
  const byId = new Map(data.runs.map((r) => [r.run_id, r]));
  const covered = new Set<string>();
  const out: Identity[] = [];
  for (const g of data.groups) {
    const runs = g.run_ids.map((id) => byId.get(id)).filter((r): r is TaskRun => r !== undefined);
    if (runs.length === 0) continue;
    for (const r of runs) covered.add(r.run_id);
    out.push({
      id: g.group_id,
      kind: "group",
      name: g.name,
      baseName: g.name,
      runs,
      group: g,
      value: g.primary?.mean ?? null,
      sd: g.primary && g.primary.n > 1 ? g.primary.std : null,
      hidden: false,
    });
  }
  // runs the server listed in no group: one identity per group id, never dropped
  const orphans = new Map<string, TaskRun[]>();
  for (const r of data.runs) if (!covered.has(r.run_id)) orphans.set(r.group_id, [...(orphans.get(r.group_id) ?? []), r]);
  for (const [id, runs] of orphans) {
    const name = runBaseName(runs[0] as TaskRun);
    out.push({ id, kind: "group", name, baseName: name, runs, group: null, value: null, sd: null, hidden: false });
  }
  return out;
}

function sortValue(item: Identity, key: string): number | string | null {
  if (key === SORT_PRIMARY) return item.value;
  if (key === SORT_CREATED) return latestRun(item.runs)?.created_at ?? null;
  return scoreOf(item, key);
}

/** Missing values last in either direction; ties: newest first, then id. */
export function compareIdentities(a: Identity, b: Identity, sort: Selection["sort"]): number {
  const va = sortValue(a, sort.key);
  const vb = sortValue(b, sort.key);
  if (va === null || vb === null) {
    if (va !== vb) return va === null ? 1 : -1;
  } else {
    const d = typeof va === "number" && typeof vb === "number" ? va - vb : String(va).localeCompare(String(vb));
    if (d !== 0) return sort.dir === "asc" ? d : -d;
  }
  const ca = latestRun(a.runs)?.created_at ?? "";
  const cb = latestRun(b.runs)?.created_at ?? "";
  return cb.localeCompare(ca) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
}

/** The run list in display order: filtered, superseded removed unless shown, sorted, `hidden` set. */
export function listIdentities(sel: Selection, data: TaskRuns): Identity[] {
  const matches = sel.filter.trim() === "" ? () => true : parseFilter(sel.filter);
  const hidden = new Set(sel.hidden);
  return identities(data, sel.group)
    .filter((i) => sel.showSuperseded || !isSuperseded(i))
    .filter((i) => i.runs.some((r) => matches(r)))
    .sort((a, b) => compareIdentities(a, b, sel.sort))
    .map((i) => ({ ...i, hidden: hidden.has(i.id) }));
}

/** Ids drawn in the panels, in list order: the colour order of `colorFor`. */
export function visibleIdentities(sel: Selection, data: TaskRuns): string[] {
  return listIdentities(sel, data)
    .filter((i) => !i.hidden)
    .map((i) => i.id);
}

export function parseSelection(params: URLSearchParams, defaults: SelectionDefaults): Selection {
  const sort = params.get("sort") ?? "";
  const cut = sort.lastIndexOf(":");
  const key = cut > 0 ? sort.slice(0, cut) : "";
  const dir = sort.slice(cut + 1);
  return {
    filter: params.get("q") ?? "",
    group: params.get("group") === "run" ? "run" : "config",
    sort: key !== "" && (dir === "asc" || dir === "desc") ? { key, dir } : { key: SORT_PRIMARY, dir: defaults.sortDir },
    hidden: (params.get("hide") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
    showSuperseded: params.get("sup") === "1",
  };
}

/** URL keys for a patch; values equal to the defaults are removals. */
export function selectionSearch(patch: Partial<Selection>, defaults: SelectionDefaults): SearchPatch {
  const out: SearchPatch = {};
  if (patch.filter !== undefined) out.q = patch.filter.trim() === "" ? null : patch.filter;
  if (patch.group !== undefined) out.group = patch.group === "run" ? "run" : null;
  if (patch.sort !== undefined) {
    const isDefault = patch.sort.key === SORT_PRIMARY && patch.sort.dir === defaults.sortDir;
    out.sort = isDefault ? null : `${patch.sort.key}:${patch.sort.dir}`;
  }
  if (patch.hidden !== undefined) out.hide = patch.hidden.length ? [...new Set(patch.hidden)].join(",") : null;
  if (patch.showSuperseded !== undefined) out.sup = patch.showSuperseded ? "1" : null;
  return out;
}

/** The selection of the page URL and a patcher (replaces the history entry). */
export function useRunSelection(
  defaults: Partial<SelectionDefaults> = {},
): [Selection, (patch: Partial<Selection>) => void] {
  const [params, setSearch] = useSearchState();
  const sortDir = defaults.sortDir ?? "desc";
  const selection = useMemo(() => parseSelection(params, { sortDir }), [params, sortDir]);
  const update = useCallback(
    (patch: Partial<Selection>) => setSearch(selectionSearch(patch, { sortDir })),
    [setSearch, sortDir],
  );
  return [selection, update];
}
```

  ```ts
  export function RunsSidebar(props: RunsSidebarProps): ReactElement;
  ```
  DOM contract: `<aside aria-label="Runs">`; `role="list" aria-label="Run list"` of `role="listitem"` rows; each row's name is an `<a href="/r/<latest run>">` (click/Enter opens via `onOpen`); eye `<button aria-pressed={visible} data-identity={id}>` named `Hide <name>` / `Show <name>`; pencil `Rename <name>`; double-click on the row (outside the name link) also renames.

```tsx
function Harness({ data, opened, patches }: { data: TaskRuns; opened: string[]; patches: Partial<Selection>[] }) {

  return (

      data={data}

  test("hover and focus put the identity in the highlight store", () => {
    setup();
```

```ts
// ui/src/task/highlight.ts
/**
 * The identity hovered or focused in the runs sidebar. Every chart of the page reads it
 * (`useHighlight()`) and passes it as `highlight`, so that identity's marks stand out.
 */
import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

let current: string | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

export function setHighlight(id: string | null): void {
  if (id === current) return;
  current = id;
  for (const listener of listeners) listener();
}

export function getHighlight(): string | null {
  return current;
}

const subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
};

export function useHighlight(): string | null {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getHighlight, () => null);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement `RunsSidebar.tsx`**

```tsx
// ui/src/task/RunsSidebar.tsx
/**
 * The task's run list (spec 4.2 "Runs sidebar"): filter, Group (By config | Each run),
 * Sort, the superseded chip, `N/M shown`, and one row per identity: colour swatch, name
 * (rename with the pencil or a double click on the row), sub-line, primary value and the
 * eye. The list drives every panel: its state is in the URL (`useRunSelection`), hover
 * goes to the highlight store.
 */
import { type MouseEvent, type ReactElement, useState } from "react";
import type { RunStatus, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { useRenameRun } from "../api/queries";
import { Chip } from "../chrome/Chip";
import { EmptyState } from "../chrome/EmptyState";
import { FilterField } from "../chrome/FilterField";
import { Icon } from "../chrome/Icon";
import { Launcher } from "../chrome/Launcher";
import { Segmented } from "../chrome/Segmented";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { colorFor } from "../lib/color";
import { fmtClock, fmtScore } from "../pages/components/format";
import { hrefs, isPlainClick } from "../pages/components/links";
import { setHighlight } from "./highlight";
import {
  type Identity,
  type Selection,
  type SortDir,
  SORT_CREATED,
  SORT_PRIMARY,
  identities,
  isSuperseded,
  keyLabel,
  latestRun,
  listIdentities,
} from "./useRunSelection";

export interface RunsSidebarProps {
  data: TaskRuns;
  selection: Selection;
  onChange: (patch: Partial<Selection>) => void;
  /** Open a run page; a group opens its latest run. */
  onOpen: (runId: string) => void;
}

const GROUPS = [
  ["config", "By config"],
  ["run", "Each run"],
] as const;

export function RunsSidebar({ data, selection, onChange, onOpen }: RunsSidebarProps): ReactElement {
  const all = identities(data, selection.group);
  const listed = listIdentities(selection, data);
  const visible = listed.filter((i) => !i.hidden).map((i) => i.id);
  const superseded = all.filter(isSuperseded).length;
  const toggle = (id: string): void =>
    onChange({
      hidden: selection.hidden.includes(id) ? selection.hidden.filter((h) => h !== id) : [...selection.hidden, id],
    });
  return (
    <aside className="runs" aria-label="Runs">
      <div className="runs-tools">
        <FilterField
          value={selection.filter}
          onChange={(filter) => onChange({ filter })}
          placeholder="Filter  lr=3e-4 · tag:final · status:running"
          label="Filter runs"
        />
        <div className="row">
          <Segmented label="Group" options={GROUPS} value={selection.group} onChange={(group) => onChange({ group })} />
          <SortChip
            data={data}
            sort={selection.sort}
            defaultDir={data.higher_is_better ? "desc" : "asc"}
            onSort={(sort) => onChange({ sort })}
          />
          {superseded > 0 ? (
            <Chip
              on={!selection.showSuperseded}
              title="Runs tagged superseded are hidden by default"
              onClick={() => onChange({ showSuperseded: !selection.showSuperseded })}
            >
              {selection.showSuperseded ? "Superseded shown" : `${superseded} superseded hidden`}
            </Chip>
          ) : null}
          <span className="count">{`${visible.length}/${all.length} shown`}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="runs-head" aria-hidden="true">
        <span />
        <span>{selection.group === "config" ? "Config · seeds" : "Run"}</span>
        <span className="num">{keyLabel(data.primary)}</span>
        <span />
      </div>
      <div className="runs-list" role="list" aria-label="Run list">
        {listed.map((item) => (
          <SidebarRow
            key={item.id}
            item={item}
            color={colorFor(item.id, visible)}
            onToggle={() => toggle(item.id)}
            onOpen={onOpen}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      {all.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No runs yet" /> : listed.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="No runs match" /> : null}
    </aside>
  );
}

interface SortChipProps {
  data: TaskRuns;
  sort: Selection["sort"];
  defaultDir: SortDir;
  onSort: (sort: Selection["sort"]) => void;
}

function SortChip({ data, sort, defaultDir, onSort }: SortChipProps): ReactElement {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const keys = [SORT_PRIMARY, ...data.score_keys.filter((k) => k !== data.primary), SORT_CREATED];
  const label = (key: string): string =>
    key === SORT_PRIMARY ? keyLabel(data.primary) : key === SORT_CREATED ? "created" : keyLabel(key);
  const arrow = (dir: SortDir): string => (dir === "desc" ? "↓" : "↑");
  const pick = (key: string): void => {
    setOpen(false);
    onSort(
      key === sort.key
        ? { key, dir: sort.dir === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc" }
        : { key, dir: key === SORT_PRIMARY ? defaultDir : "desc" },
    );
  };
  return (
    <span className="popover-anchor">
      <button type="button" className="chip" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open} title="Sort by" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
        Sort <b>{`${label(sort.key)} ${arrow(sort.dir)}`}</b>
        <span className="chev">
          <Icon name="chevron" size={9} />
        </span>
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <div
          className="popover"
          role="menu"
          aria-label="Sort by"
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          {keys.map((key) => (
            <button key={key} type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked={key === sort.key} onClick={() => pick(key)}>
              {key === sort.key ? `${label(key)} ${arrow(sort.dir)}` : label(key)}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

interface RowProps {
  item: Identity;
  color: string;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onOpen: (runId: string) => void;
}

const stop = (e: MouseEvent): void => e.stopPropagation();

function SidebarRow({ item, color, onToggle, onOpen }: RowProps): ReactElement {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const rename = useRenameRun();
  const latest = latestRun(item.runs);
  const best = item.kind === "group" && item.group?.is_best === true;
  const startRename = (e: MouseEvent): void => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setError(null);
    setEditing(true);
  };
  const save = async (text: string): Promise<void> => {
    setEditing(false);
    const name = text.trim() === "" ? null : text.trim();
    if (name === item.baseName) return;
    try {
      // a config's name is its most recently renamed run's: rename every run of it
      for (const run of item.runs) await rename.mutateAsync({ runId: run.run_id, name });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    }
  };
  const open = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>): void => {
    if (!latest || !isPlainClick(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    onOpen(latest.run_id);
  };
  return (
    <div
      role="listitem"
      className={`rrow${item.hidden ? " off" : ""}${best ? " best" : ""}`}
      onMouseEnter={() => setHighlight(item.id)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setHighlight(null)}
      onFocus={() => setHighlight(item.id)}
      onBlur={() => setHighlight(null)}
      onDoubleClick={startRename}
    >
      <span className="sw" style={item.hidden ? undefined : { background: color }} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="rname">
        <div className="t">
          {editing ? (
            <input
              className="rename"
              aria-label="Run name"
              defaultValue={item.baseName}
              maxLength={80}
              autoFocus
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (e.key === "Enter") void save(e.currentTarget.value);
                if (e.key === "Escape") setEditing(false);
              }}
              onBlur={() => setEditing(false)}
              onClick={stop}
              onDoubleClick={stop}
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <a href={latest ? hrefs.run(latest.run_id) : undefined} title={item.name} onClick={open} onDoubleClick={stop}>
                {item.name}
              </a>
              <button type="button" className="pen" aria-label={`Rename ${item.name}`} title="Rename" onClick={startRename} onDoubleClick={stop}>
                <Icon name="edit" />
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <SubLine item={item} latest={latest} />
        {error ? (
          <span role="alert" className="err">
            {error}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <div className="rval">
        {fmtScore(item.value)}
        {item.kind === "group" ? (
          <small>{item.sd !== null ? `± ${fmtScore(item.sd)}` : item.value !== null ? "1 seed" : ""}</small>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="eye"
        data-identity={item.id}
        aria-pressed={!item.hidden}
        aria-label={`${item.hidden ? "Show" : "Hide"} ${item.name}`}
        title={item.hidden ? "Show in all panels" : "Hide in all panels"}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onToggle();
        }}
        onDoubleClick={stop}
      >
        <Icon name={item.hidden ? "eye-off" : "eye"} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function SubLine({ item, latest }: { item: Identity; latest: TaskRun | undefined }): ReactElement {
  const count = (statuses: readonly RunStatus[]): number => item.runs.filter((r) => statuses.includes(r.status)).length;
  const live = count(["running"]);
  const queued = count(["queued"]);
  const failed = count(["failed", "lost"]);
  const final = item.runs.some((r) => r.tags.includes("final"));
  const tally = (n: number, status: RunStatus, word: string): ReactElement | null =>
    n > 0 ? <StatusIcon status={status} label={String(n)} title={`${n} ${word}`} /> : null;
  return (
    <span className="s">
      {latest ? <Launcher who={latest.created_by} /> : null}
      {item.kind === "group" ? (
        <>
          <span>{`${item.runs.length} seed${item.runs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}</span>
          {tally(live, "running", "running")}
          {tally(queued, "queued", "queued")}
          {tally(failed, "failed", "failed")}
        </>
      ) : latest ? (
        <>
          <StatusIcon status={latest.status} iconOnly title={latest.status} />
          <span>{fmtClock(latest.created_at)}</span>
        </>
      ) : null}
      {final ? <span className="final">final</span> : null}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```css
/* ui/src/task/task.css — task page (spec 4.2), mockup docs/mockups/ui-v5/index.html */
.ws { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 0; flex: 1; }
.runs { background: var(--panel); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
.runs-tools { padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.runs-tools .row { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.runs-tools .count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.runs-head, .rrow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) 72px 22px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.runs-head { padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.runs-head .num { text-align: right; }
.runs-list { overflow: auto; flex: 1; }
.rrow { padding: 7px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid); position: relative; }
.rrow:hover, .rrow:focus-within { background: var(--hover); }
.rrow.off .rname, .rrow.off .rval { color: var(--ink-3); }
```

```ts
// ui/src/task/facts.ts
/** Pure helpers of the task page: the tab named by `?tab=`, the facts line, the not-found rule. */
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import type { Leaderboard, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { keyLabel, latestRun } from "./useRunSelection";

export type TaskTab = { kind: "charts" | "runs" | "sweeps" | "examples" } | { kind: "view"; name: string };

const PLAIN: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["runs", "sweeps", "examples"]);

/** `?tab=runs|sweeps|examples|view:<name>`; a legacy `?view=<name>` (not `overview`) opens that view. */
export function parseTab(params: URLSearchParams): TaskTab {
  const tab = params.get("tab") ?? "";
  if (tab.startsWith("view:") && tab.length > 5) return { kind: "view", name: tab.slice(5) };
  if (PLAIN.has(tab)) return { kind: tab as "runs" | "sweeps" | "examples" };
  const legacy = params.get("view");
  if (tab === "" && legacy && legacy !== "overview") return { kind: "view", name: legacy };
  return { kind: "charts" };
}

/** The `?tab=` value of a tab; null for Charts (the default). */
export function tabParam(tab: TaskTab): string | null {
  if (tab.kind === "charts") return null;
  return tab.kind === "view" ? `view:${tab.name}` : tab.kind;
}

export function sameTab(a: TaskTab, b: TaskTab): boolean {
  return tabParam(a) === tabParam(b);
}

export interface TaskFacts {
  primary: string;
  direction: "↑" | "↓";
  /** The best config's mean, its best-scored run (else latest) and its name. */
  best: { value: number; runId: string; name: string } | null;
  runs: number;
  configs: number;
  running: number;
  queued: number;
}

export function taskFacts(data: TaskRuns): TaskFacts {
  const best = data.groups.find((g) => g.is_best && g.primary !== null);
  const members = best ? data.runs.filter((r) => best.run_ids.includes(r.run_id)) : [];
  const sign = data.higher_is_better ? 1 : -1;
  const top =
    members
      .filter((r) => r.primary !== null)
      .reduce<TaskRun | undefined>(
        (a, r) => (a === undefined || sign * ((r.primary as number) - (a.primary as number)) > 0 ? r : a),
        undefined,
      ) ?? latestRun(members);
  return {
    primary: keyLabel(data.primary),
    direction: data.higher_is_better ? "↑" : "↓",
    best: best?.primary && top ? { value: best.primary.mean, runId: top.run_id, name: best.name } : null,
    runs: data.runs.length,
    configs: data.groups.length,
    running: data.runs.filter((r) => r.status === "running").length,
    queued: data.runs.filter((r) => r.status === "queued").length,
  };
}

/** Leaderboard backlog shown in the facts line: runs that need re-evaluation, unscored runs. */
export function boardWarnings(board: Leaderboard): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  if (board.needs_reeval.length > 0) out.push(`${board.needs_reeval.length} need re-eval`);
  if (board.unscored.length > 0) out.push(`${board.unscored.length} unscored`);
  return out;
}

/** `accuracy v1, macro_f1 v1`: the primary fact's tooltip. */
export function metricVersions(board: Leaderboard): string {
  return Object.entries(board.metric_versions)
    .map(([metric, version]) => `${metric} ${version}`)
    .join(", ");
}

/** A 404 (unknown project), or the server's 400 `ConfigError` for an unknown task in a known project. */
export function isGone(e: Error | null): boolean {
  return (
    e instanceof ApiError &&
    (e.status === 404 || (e.status === 400 && e.type === "ConfigError" && /^unknown task\b/.test(e.message)))
  );
}

/** The first not-found among the task's own reads. */
export function notFound(...errors: (Error | null)[]): Error | null {
  return errors.find(isGone) ?? null;
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/task/viewOverrides.ts
/**
 * The custom-view toolbar's overrides (the v4 Metric select and Seeds checkbox): a primary
 * metric for leaderboard, stat_strip and curves panels, and seed dots on leaderboard panels.
 * Other panels keep their authored axes.
 */
import type { Leaderboard, PanelSpec, ViewSpec } from "../api/models";

export interface ViewOverrides {
  primary?: string;
  seeds?: boolean;
}

/** The primary, then every recorded `metric/key` whose metric has a version. */
export function metricOptions(board: Leaderboard): string[] {
  return [...new Set([board.primary, ...board.rows.flatMap((row) => Object.keys(row.scores))])].filter(
    (ref) => /^[^/@]+\/[^/@]+$/.test(ref) && (ref.split("/")[0] ?? "") in board.metric_versions,
  );
}

export function leaderboardPanels(view: ViewSpec): PanelSpec[] {
  return view.panels?.filter((p) => p.type === "leaderboard") ?? [];
}

/** Seed dots as authored: on unless a leaderboard panel's `noise` leaves `seed` out. */
export function authoredSeeds(view: ViewSpec): boolean {
  return leaderboardPanels(view).every((p) => (p.noise ?? ["seed", "test_set"]).includes("seed"));
}

const PRIMARY_PANELS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["leaderboard", "stat_strip", "curves"]);

export function applyOverrides(view: ViewSpec, { primary, seeds }: ViewOverrides): ViewSpec {
  return {
    ...view,
    panels: view.panels?.map((panel) => {
      const withPrimary = primary !== undefined && PRIMARY_PANELS.has(panel.type);
      const noise: ("seed" | "test_set")[] | undefined =
        panel.type === "leaderboard" && seeds !== undefined
          ? [...(panel.noise ?? ["seed", "test_set"]).filter((v) => v !== "seed"), ...(seeds ? (["seed"] as const) : [])]
          : undefined;
      return {
        ...panel,
        ...(withPrimary ? { data: { ...panel.data, primary } } : {}),
        ...(noise ? { noise } : {}),
      };
    }),
  };
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/ViewPanels.tsx
/**
 * Server panel results in panel chrome: the foundation's `PanelGrid` (each result in a
 * `chrome/Panel`, span 12 = full row). For training, agent_eval, agent_iteration and
 * system_bench tasks a bare `/r/<id>` link inside a panel opens that run inline
 * (`onSelectRun`), as on the v4 page; every other link navigates.
 */
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import type { PanelResult, PanelSpec, TaskKind } from "../api/models";
import { NavigateContext, useNavigateHref } from "../pages/components/links";
import { PanelGrid } from "../pages/components/PanelGrid";

export const INLINE_RUN_KINDS: ReadonlySet<TaskKind> = new Set<TaskKind>(["training", "agent_eval", "agent_iteration", "system_bench"]);

/** The run id of a bare `/r/<id>` link (no query, no hash), else null. */
export function inlineRunId(href: string): string | null {
  const match = /^\/r\/([^/?#]+)$/.exec(href);
  if (!match) return null;
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(match[1] as string);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export interface ViewPanelsProps {
  results: readonly PanelResult[];
  specs?: readonly PanelSpec[];
  kind?: TaskKind;
  onSelectRun?: (runId: string) => void;
}

export function ViewPanels({ results, specs, kind, onSelectRun }: ViewPanelsProps): ReactElement {
  const navigate = useNavigateHref();
  const select = (href: string): void => {
    const id = kind !== undefined && onSelectRun && INLINE_RUN_KINDS.has(kind) ? inlineRunId(href) : null;
    if (id !== null && onSelectRun) onSelectRun(id);
    else navigate(href);
  };
  return (
    <NavigateContext.Provider value={select}>
      <PanelGrid results={[...results]} specs={specs ? [...specs] : undefined} />
    </NavigateContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/ViewTab.tsx
/**
 * A saved (non-preset) view as a task tab (`?tab=view:<name>`): its panels in panel
 * chrome, with the v4 toolbar: Metric (primary override), Seeds / Repeats (leaderboard
 * seed dots), panel count and Edit. While the next query loads, the previous panels are
 * not drawn under the new specs.
 */
import { type ReactElement, useState } from "react";
import type { Leaderboard, ViewInfo } from "../api/models";
import { useView, useViewQuery } from "../api/queries";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { SelectedRun } from "../pages/components/SelectedRun";
import { applyOverrides, authoredSeeds, leaderboardPanels, metricOptions } from "./viewOverrides";
import { ViewPanels } from "./ViewPanels";

export interface ViewTabProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  name: string;
  board: Leaderboard | undefined;
  info: ViewInfo | undefined;
}

export function ViewTab({ project, task, name, board, info }: ViewTabProps): ReactElement {
  const [primary, setPrimary] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [seeds, setSeeds] = useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined);
  const [selectedRun, setSelectedRun] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const detail = useView(project, task, name);
  const view = detail.data?.view;
  const customized = primary !== undefined || seeds !== undefined;
  const effective = view ? applyOverrides(view, { primary, seeds }) : undefined;
  const panels = useViewQuery(project, task, customized ? (effective ? { view: effective } : null) : { name });
  const origin = (info ?? detail.data?.info)?.origin;
  const error = detail.error ?? panels.error;
  const ready = panels.data !== undefined && !panels.isPlaceholderData && !detail.isPending;
  const authored = view ? authoredSeeds(view) : true;
  const seedWord = board?.kind === "system_bench" ? "Repeats" : "Seeds";
  const count = view?.panels?.length ?? 0;
  return (
    <div className="view-tab panels">
      <div className="ptools">
        {board ? (
          <label>
            Metric
            <select
              className="ctl"
              aria-label="Metric"
              value={primary ?? board.primary}
              title="Ranking metric and primary summaries; authored plot axes remain unchanged"
              onChange={(e) => setPrimary(e.target.value === board.primary ? undefined : e.target.value)}
            >
              {metricOptions(board).map((ref) => (
                <option key={ref} value={ref} title={`${ref} @ ${board.metric_versions[ref.split("/")[0] ?? ""]}`}>
                  {ref}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        ) : null}
        {view && leaderboardPanels(view).length > 0 ? (
          <label title="Show individual seed or repeat dots on leaderboard plots">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label={seedWord}
              checked={seeds ?? authored}
              onChange={(e) => setSeeds(e.target.checked === authored ? undefined : e.target.checked)}
            />
            {seedWord}
          </label>
        ) : null}
        <span className="sp" />
        {view ? <span className="muted">{`${count} panel${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}</span> : null}
        {origin !== undefined && origin !== "preset" ? (
          <AppLink className="btn sm" href={hrefs.edit(project, task, name)}>
            Edit
          </AppLink>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={error} />
      ) : ready && panels.data ? (
        <ViewPanels
          results={panels.data.panels}
          specs={customized ? effective?.panels : view?.panels}
          kind={board?.kind}
          onSelectRun={setSelectedRun}
        />
      ) : (
        <Loading />
      )}
      {selectedRun ? <SelectedRun runId={selectedRun} onClose={() => setSelectedRun(null)} /> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/KindSection.tsx
/**
 * The task kind's preset panels and extras, one collapsible section of the Charts tab
 * (spec 4.2 "The task kind's preset panels ... render in the same panel chrome"). The
 * preset's leaderboard and per-config curves are left out: the Scores and Step metrics
 * sections draw them. Extras keep their v4 behaviour: training run and checkpoint tables,
 * iteration example changes, benchmark raw samples scoped to the inline-selected run.
 * The section uses the one-column grid: the preset panels bring their own `PanelGrid`.
 */
import { type ReactElement, type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import type { Leaderboard, PanelSpec, TaskKind, ViewSpec } from "../api/models";
import { useView, useViewQuery } from "../api/queries";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { PanelSection } from "../chrome/PanelSection";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { SelectedRun } from "../pages/components/SelectedRun";
import { AgentIterationFlips, SystemRawSamples } from "../pages/components/TaskInsights";
import { TrainingCheckpoints, TrainingRuns } from "../pages/components/TrainingDetails";
import { ViewPanels } from "./ViewPanels";

export const KIND_TITLE: Record<TaskKind, string> = {
  generic: "Summary",
  training: "Training",
  agent_eval: "Agent eval",
  agent_iteration: "Iterations",
  system_bench: "Benchmark",
};

/** Preset panels this section draws: all but leaderboards and `group_by: group` curves. */
export function presetPanels(view: ViewSpec): PanelSpec[] {
  return (view.panels ?? []).filter(
    (p) => p.type !== "leaderboard" && !(p.type === "curves" && (p.data?.group_by ?? "group") === "group"),
  );
}

export interface KindSectionProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  kind: TaskKind;
  board: Leaderboard | undefined;
}

export function KindSection({ project, task, kind, board }: KindSectionProps): ReactElement {
  const [selectedRun, setSelectedRun] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const preset = useView(project, task, "overview");
  const panels = preset.data ? presetPanels(preset.data.view) : [];
  const body = preset.data && panels.length > 0 ? { view: { ...preset.data.view, panels } } : null;
  const results = useViewQuery(project, task, body);
  const select = (runId: string): void => setSelectedRun(runId);
  const extras: { title: string; node: ReactNode }[] =
    kind === "training"
      ? [
          { title: "Training runs", node: <TrainingRuns project={project} task={task} onSelectRun={select} /> },
          { title: "Checkpoint metrics", node: <TrainingCheckpoints project={project} task={task} onSelectRun={select} /> },
        ]
      : kind === "agent_iteration"
        ? [{ title: "Example changes", node: <AgentIterationFlips project={project} task={task} board={board} /> }]
        : kind === "system_bench"
          ? [{ title: "Raw samples", node: <SystemRawSamples project={project} task={task} selectedRunId={selectedRun ?? undefined} /> }]
          : [];
  return (
    <PanelSection title={KIND_TITLE[kind]} count={panels.length + extras.length} storageKey={`${project}/${task}`} grid="wide">
      {preset.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={preset.error} />
      ) : results.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={results.error} />
      ) : body === null ? null : results.data && !results.isPlaceholderData ? (
        <ViewPanels results={results.data.panels} specs={panels} kind={kind} onSelectRun={select} />
      ) : (
        <Loading />
      )}
      {extras.map((x) => (
        <Panel key={x.title} title={x.title}>
          {x.node}
        </Panel>
      ))}
      {selectedRun ? <SelectedRun runId={selectedRun} onClose={() => setSelectedRun(null)} /> : null}
    </PanelSection>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/ExamplesTab.tsx
/**
 * Examples tab: the existing Examples screen for two visible configs (latest finished run
 * of each), A = runner-up, B = best in list order by default; two selects change them.
 */
import { type ReactElement, useState } from "react";
import type { Leaderboard, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { EmptyState } from "../chrome/EmptyState";
import { ExamplesPage } from "../pages/Examples";
import { primaryMetricName } from "../pages/components/format";
import { type Selection, latestRun, listIdentities } from "./useRunSelection";

export function examplesCandidates(selection: Selection, data: TaskRuns): { id: string; name: string; runId: string }[] {
  return listIdentities(selection, data)
    .filter((i) => !i.hidden)
    .flatMap((i) => {
      const run = latestRun(i.runs.filter((r) => r.status === "finished"));
      return run ? [{ id: i.id, name: i.name, runId: run.run_id }] : [];
    });
}

export interface ExamplesTabProps {
  data: TaskRuns;
  board: Leaderboard | undefined;
  selection: Selection;
}

export function ExamplesTab({ data, board, selection }: ExamplesTabProps): ReactElement {
  const items = examplesCandidates(selection, data);
  const [a, setA] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [b, setB] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const runA = a ?? items[1]?.runId ?? null;
  const runB = b ?? items[0]?.runId ?? null;
  if (items.length < 2 || runA === null || runB === null) return <EmptyState title="Needs two finished runs" />;
  const metric = primaryMetricName(data.primary);
  const version = board?.metric_versions[metric];
  const pick = (label: string, value: string, set: (v: string) => void): ReactElement => (
    <label>
      {label}
      <select className="ctl" aria-label={`Run ${label}`} value={value} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value)}>
        {items.map((i) => (
          <option key={i.id} value={i.runId}>
            {i.name}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </label>
  );
  return (
    <div className="examples-tab panels">
      <div className="ptools">
        {pick("A", runA, setA)}
        {pick("B", runB, setB)}
      </div>
      <ExamplesPage key={`${runA}/${runB}`} a={runA} b={runB} metric={version ? `${metric}@${version}` : metric} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/NewRun.tsx
/**
 * "+ New run" (spec 8A.8): the Launch dialog prefilled from the best config's latest run
 * (its command template, params and vars, and the next unused seeds of that config). What
 * it opened with is kept until the dialog closes: a refetch (each launch invalidates runs)
 * or a failed refetch must not swap the dialog for a spinner or an error.
 */
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Fragment, type ReactElement, useRef } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { RunRecord } from "../api/models";
import { queryKeys, useAllRuns, useTask } from "../api/queries";
import { type LaunchDefaults, launchDefaults } from "../launch/draft";
import { LaunchDialog } from "../launch/LaunchDialog";
import { shortId } from "../pages/components/format";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { OpeningDialog } from "../pages/components/OpeningDialog";

export interface LaunchedRuns {
  host: string;
  records: RunRecord[];
}

export interface NewRunProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  templateRunId: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onLaunched: (records: RunRecord[], host: string) => void;
}

interface Opened {
  repo: string;
  defaults: LaunchDefaults;
}

/**
 * Loads the repo path, the template run and every run of the task, archived included (an
 * older or archived run may hold a seed), then shows the dialog.
 */
export function NewRun({ project, task, templateRunId, onClose, onLaunched }: NewRunProps): ReactElement {
  const detail = useTask(project, task);
  const runs = useAllRuns({ project, task, archived: true });
  const template = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.run(templateRunId ?? ""),
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => api.run(templateRunId ?? "", signal),
    enabled: templateRunId !== null,
  });
  const opened = useRef<Opened | null>(null);
  if (opened.current === null) {
    // A failed runs read would propose seeds that already exist; a failed template read
    // would open a blank dialog without saying so. Both stop here instead.
    const error = detail.error ?? runs.error ?? template.error;
    if (error) {
      return (
        <OpeningDialog
          title="New run"
          error={error}
          onClose={onClose}
          onRetry={() => {
            void detail.refetch();
            void runs.refetch();
            if (templateRunId !== null) void template.refetch();
          }}
        />
      );
    }
    // a refetch in flight too: a cached list may predate runs started since (by anyone)
    if (detail.data === undefined || runs.data === undefined || runs.isFetching || (templateRunId !== null && template.isPending)) {
      return <OpeningDialog title="New run" onClose={onClose} />;
    }
    opened.current = {
      repo: detail.data.repo,
      defaults: launchDefaults(template.data?.record ?? null, runs.data.runs, runs.data.complete),
    };
  }
  const { repo, defaults } = opened.current;
  return (
    <LaunchDialog
      project={project}
      task={task}
      repo={repo}
      initial={defaults.draft}
      templateEnvironment={defaults.templateEnvironment}
      carry={defaults.carry}
      seedsNote={defaults.seedsNote}
      onClose={onClose}
      onLaunched={onLaunched}
    />
  );
}

/** `Launched 3 on gpu1, 2 queued: f2c8 93e7 c2b9`, each id a link to its run. */
export function LaunchedLine({ launched }: { launched: LaunchedRuns }): ReactElement {
  const queued = launched.records.filter((r) => r.status === "queued").length;
  return (
    <p className="small launched" role="status">
      Launched {launched.records.length} on {launched.host}
      {queued > 0 ? `, ${queued} queued` : ""}:{" "}
      {launched.records.map((r, i) => (
        <Fragment key={r.run_id}>
          {i > 0 ? " " : ""}
          <AppLink href={hrefs.run(r.run_id)}>{shortId(r.run_id)}</AppLink>
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/TaskPage.tsx
/**
 * Task page (spec 4.2): header (name, kind tag, one facts line, Re-evaluate all,
 * + New run) and tabs Charts · Runs · Sweeps · Examples · saved views · + View, chosen
 * by `?tab=`. The run selection (`useRunSelection`) lives in the URL and every tab shares it.
 */
import { Fragment, type MouseEvent, type ReactElement, type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { EvalReport, Leaderboard } from "../api/models";
import { RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES, useLeaderboard, useProjectSweeps, useTask, useTaskRuns, useViews } from "../api/queries";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { fmtScore } from "../pages/components/format";
import { AppLink, hrefs, isPlainClick, useNavigateHref } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { ReevalSummary } from "../pages/components/ReevalSummary";
import { paramsText, sweepHref } from "../pages/components/SweepModel";
import { useAction } from "../pages/components/useAction";
import { ChartsTab } from "./ChartsTab";
import { ExamplesTab } from "./ExamplesTab";
import { type TaskFacts, type TaskTab, boardWarnings, metricVersions, notFound, parseTab, sameTab, tabParam, taskFacts } from "./facts";
import { LaunchedLine, type LaunchedRuns, NewRun } from "./NewRun";
import { useRunSelection } from "./useRunSelection";
import { applySearch, useSearchState } from "./useSearchState";
import { ViewTab } from "./ViewTab";
import "./task.css";

export interface TaskPageProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
}

/** Task-local state (dialogs, reports) resets when project or task changes. */
export function TaskPage(props: TaskPageProps): ReactElement {
  return <TaskPageScope key={JSON.stringify([props.project, props.task])} {...props} />;
}

function TaskPageScope({ project, task }: TaskPageProps): ReactElement {
  const [params, setSearch] = useSearchState();
  const tab = parseTab(params);
  const runs = useTaskRuns(project, task);
  const board = useLeaderboard(project, task);
  const views = useViews(project, task);
  const detail = useTask(project, task);
  const data = runs.data;
  const [selection, setSelection] = useRunSelection({ sortDir: data?.higher_is_better === false ? "asc" : "desc" });
  const navigate = useNavigateHref();
  const [reevalReport, setReevalReport] = useState<EvalReport | null>(null);
  const reeval = useAction({
    send: (_: void, opts) => api.reevalTask(project, task, {}, opts),
    invalidate: RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES,
    onSuccess: setReevalReport,
  });
  // the template run at the click (`undefined`: closed); the leaderboard keeps changing
  const [launching, setLaunching] = useState<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
  const [launched, setLaunched] = useState<LaunchedRuns | null>(null);

  const gone = notFound(runs.error, board.error, views.error);
  if (gone) {
    return (
      <div className="task-page">
        <header className="task-head">
          <p className="crumb">
            <AppLink href={hrefs.overview()}>All projects</AppLink>
          </p>
          <h1>Not found</h1>
        </header>
        <ErrorBox error={gone} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const go = (next: TaskTab): void => setSearch({ tab: tabParam(next), view: null }, { push: true });
  const hrefFor = (next: TaskTab): string =>
    `${hrefs.task(project, task)}${applySearch(params.toString(), { tab: tabParam(next), view: null })}`;
  const openRun = (runId: string): void => navigate(hrefs.run(runId));
  const custom = (views.data ?? []).filter((v) => v.origin !== "preset");
  const tabs: { tab: TaskTab; label: ReactNode; title?: string }[] = [
    { tab: { kind: "charts" }, label: "Charts" },
    { tab: { kind: "examples" }, label: "Examples" },
    ...custom.map((v) => ({ tab: { kind: "view", name: v.name } as TaskTab, label: v.title || v.name, title: v.path ?? `${v.origin} view` })),
  ];

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (tab.kind === "view") {
    body = (
      <ViewTab
        key={tab.name}
        project={project}
        task={task}
        name={tab.name}
        board={board.data}
        info={views.data?.find((v) => v.name === tab.name)}
      />
    );
  } else if (!data) {
    body = runs.isPending ? <Loading /> : null;
  } else if (tab.kind === "examples") {
    body = <ExamplesTab data={data} board={board.data} selection={selection} />;
  } else {
    body = (
      <ChartsTab
        project={project}
        task={task}
        data={data}
        board={board.data}
        selection={selection}
        onSelection={setSelection}
        onOpenRun={openRun}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="task-page">
      <header className="task-head">
        <div className="title-row">
          <h1>{task}</h1>
          {data ? (
            <span className="tag" title="task kind">
              {data.kind}
            </span>
          ) : null}
          <span className="sp" />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn sm"
            disabled={reeval.pending}
            title="Re-score every run's saved predictions with the current metric versions"
            onClick={() => {
              setReevalReport(null);
              reeval.run();
            }}
          >
            Re-evaluate all
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn sm primary"
            disabled={board.isPending || board.isError}
            title="Launch runs of this task on any host"
            onClick={() => setLaunching(board.data?.rows[0]?.latest_run_id ?? null)}
          >
            + New run
          </button>
        </div>
        {data ? <Facts facts={taskFacts(data)} board={board.data} dataset={detail.data?.dataset?.name} /> : null}
        <div className="tabs-row">
          <div className="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Task">
            {tabs.map(({ tab: t, label, title }) => (
              <TabLink key={tabParam(t) ?? "charts"} href={hrefFor(t)} selected={sameTab(t, tab)} title={title} onGo={() => go(t)}>
                {label}
              </TabLink>
            ))}
          </div>
          <AppLink className="tab-add" href={hrefs.edit(project, task, "new")} title="New view">
            + View
          </AppLink>
        </div>
      </header>
      {runs.error ? <ErrorBox error={runs.error} /> : null}
      {board.error ? <ErrorBox error={board.error} /> : null}
      {views.error ? <ErrorBox error={views.error} /> : null}
      {reeval.error ? <ErrorBox error={reeval.error} /> : null}
      {reevalReport ? <ReevalSummary report={reevalReport} /> : null}
      {launched ? <LaunchedLine launched={launched} /> : null}
      <SweepsLine project={project} />
      <div className="task-body">{body}</div>
      {launching !== undefined ? (
        <NewRun
          project={project}
          task={task}
          templateRunId={launching}
          onClose={() => setLaunching(undefined)}
          onLaunched={(records, host) => {
            setLaunching(undefined);
            setLaunched({ host, records });
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

interface TabLinkProps {
  href: string;
  selected: boolean;
  title?: string;
  onGo: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}

function TabLink({ href, selected, title, onGo, children }: TabLinkProps): ReactElement {
  return (
    <a
      role="tab"
      aria-selected={selected}
      className={selected ? "on" : undefined}
      href={href}
      title={title}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        if (!isPlainClick(e)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        onGo();
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

function Facts({ facts, board, dataset }: { facts: TaskFacts; board: Leaderboard | undefined; dataset: string | undefined }): ReactElement {
  return (
    <p className="facts">
      {board?.metric_drift?.length ? (
        <span role="img" aria-label="Metric source drift" title={`Different stored metric source hashes: ${board.metric_drift.join(", ")}`}>
          ⚠
        </span>
      ) : null}
      <span title={board ? metricVersions(board) : undefined}>
        Primary <b>{facts.primary}</b> {facts.direction}
      </span>
      {facts.best ? (
        <span>
          Best <b className="ok">{fmtScore(facts.best.value)}</b>{" "}
          <AppLink href={hrefs.run(facts.best.runId)} title="Open the best run">
            {facts.best.name}
          </AppLink>
        </span>
      ) : null}
      <span>
        <b>{facts.runs}</b> runs · <b>{facts.configs}</b> configs
      </span>
      {facts.running > 0 ? (
        <StatusIcon status="running" label={`${facts.running} running`} />
      ) : null}
      {facts.queued > 0 ? (
        <StatusIcon status="queued" label={`${facts.queued} queued`} />
      ) : null}
      {dataset ? <span>{dataset}</span> : null}
      {board ? boardWarnings(board).map((text) => <span key={text} className="warn">{text}</span>) : null}
    </p>
  );
}

/**
 * The project's sweeps with their best config, each linking its sweep. Nothing while there
 * are none, or when the list fails. Replaced by the Sweeps tab in T7.
 */
function SweepsLine({ project }: { project: string }): ReactElement | null {
  const sweeps = useProjectSweeps(project);
  const items = sweeps.data ?? [];
  if (items.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <p className="small sweeps" aria-label="Sweeps" title={`Sweeps of project ${project}`}>
      sweeps:{" "}
      {items.map((s, i) => (
        <Fragment key={s.id}>
          {i > 0 ? " · " : ""}
          <AppLink href={sweepHref(project, s.id)} title={`${s.n_runs} runs, created ${s.created_at}`}>
            {s.id}
          </AppLink>
          {` ×${s.n_runs}`}
          {s.best && s.best.mean !== null ? ` ${paramsText(s.best.params, Object.keys(s.best.params))} ${fmtScore(s.best.mean)}` : ""}
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```ts
// ui/test/task/stepMetrics.test.ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { type CurvePoint, curveSeries, hasTime, matchesSearch, metricSections, stepCurvesBody, xOf } from "../../src/task/stepMetrics";
import { listIdentities, parseSelection } from "../../src/task/useRunSelection";
import { makeTaskRuns } from "./fixtures";

const sel = parseSelection(new URLSearchParams(), { sortDir: "desc" });
const colorOf = (id: string) => `color-${id}`;
const pt = (run_id: string, step: number, value: number, t?: number, name = "loss"): CurvePoint => ({
  run_id,
  group_id: "g",
  seed: 1,
  name,
  step,
  value,
  ...(t === undefined ? {} : { t }),
});
const POINTS: CurvePoint[] = [pt("run-a1", 0, 2, 100), pt("run-a1", 10, 1, 160), pt("run-a2", 0, 4), pt("run-a2", 5, 3), pt("run-a2", 10, 2), pt("run-a1", 10, 9, 160, "acc"), pt("run-b1", 5, Number.NaN)];

describe("sections and search", () => {
  test("one section per first `/` prefix, first-seen order; names without a prefix go to metrics", () => {
    expect(metricSections(["train/loss", "val/loss", "lr", "train/acc", "sys/gpu"])).toEqual([
      { title: "train", metrics: ["train/loss", "train/acc"] },
      { title: "val", metrics: ["val/loss"] },
      { title: "metrics", metrics: ["lr"] },
      { title: "sys", metrics: ["sys/gpu"] },
    ]);
  });

  test("panel search is a case-insensitive substring; empty matches all", () => {
    expect(matchesSearch("val/Loss", "LOSS")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesSearch("val/top1", " loss ")).toBe(false);
    expect(matchesSearch("anything", "  ")).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the curves query chunks at 100 metrics and needs both metrics and runs", () => {
    const names = Array.from({ length: 150 }, (_, i) => `m/${i}`);
    const body = stepCurvesBody(names, ["r1"]);
    expect(body?.view?.panels?.map((p) => p.data?.metrics?.length)).toEqual([100, 50]);
    expect(body?.view?.panels?.[0]?.data).toMatchObject({ group_by: "group", max_points: 300, filter: { run_id: ["r1"] } });
    expect(stepCurvesBody(names, [])).toBeNull();
    expect(stepCurvesBody([], ["r1"])).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("series", () => {
  const groups = listIdentities(sel, makeTaskRuns());

  test("mean over seeds on the union of steps, interpolating each seed", () => {
    const [a] = curveSeries(POINTS, "loss", groups, colorOf, "mean", "step");
    expect(a).toEqual({ id: "g-a", name: "lr 3e-4 · beam 10", color: "color-g-a", points: [[0, 3], [5, 2.25], [10, 1.5]], running: false, failed: false });
  });

  test("mean + band adds faint min and max lines where two or more seeds have a value", () => {
    const series = curveSeries(POINTS, "loss", groups, colorOf, "band", "step");
    expect(series.map((s) => [s.id, s.points, s.faint ?? false])).toEqual([
      ["g-a", [[0, 3], [5, 2.25], [10, 1.5]], false],
      ["g-a:min", [[0, 2], [5, 1.5], [10, 1]], true],
      ["g-a:max", [[0, 4], [5, 3], [10, 2]], true],
    ]);
  });

  test("each seed: one line per run in the identity's colour; configs without points draw nothing", () => {
    const series = curveSeries(POINTS, "loss", groups, colorOf, "each", "step");
    expect(series.map((s) => [s.id, s.name, s.color])).toEqual([
      ["g-a:run-a1", "lr 3e-4 · beam 10 · seed 1", "color-g-a"],
      ["g-a:run-a2", "lr 3e-4 · beam 10 · seed 2", "color-g-a"],
    ]);
  });

  test("each run identity draws its own line; NaN values are skipped", () => {
    const runs = listIdentities({ ...sel, group: "run" }, makeTaskRuns());
    const series = curveSeries(POINTS, "loss", runs, colorOf, "mean", "step");
    expect(series.map((s) => s.id)).toEqual(["run-a1", "run-a2"]);
    expect(series[0]?.name).toBe("lr 3e-4 · beam 10 · seed 1");
  });

  test("wall and relative time use t and drop points without it", () => {
    expect(xOf(pt("r", 3, 1, 50), "wall", 40)).toBe(50);
    expect(xOf(pt("r", 3, 1, 50), "relative", 40)).toBe(10);
    expect(xOf(pt("r", 3, 1), "wall", undefined)).toBeNull();
    expect(xOf(pt("r", 3, 1), "step", undefined)).toBe(3);
    const runs = listIdentities({ ...sel, group: "run" }, makeTaskRuns());
    const series = curveSeries(POINTS, "loss", runs, colorOf, "mean", "relative");
    expect(series.map((s) => [s.id, s.points])).toEqual([["run-a1", [[0, 2], [60, 1]]]]);
    expect(hasTime(POINTS)).toBe(true);
    expect(hasTime([pt("r", 1, 1)])).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `stepMetrics.ts` and `saveView.ts`**

```ts
// ui/src/task/stepMetrics.ts
/**
 * Step metrics of the Charts tab (spec 4.2): sections by the first `/` prefix, the
 * `views/query` body that reads the visible runs' histories (curves panels, `group_by:
 * group`, at most 100 metrics per panel), and the series one LineChart draws.
 *
 * Seeds: `mean` is the mean over a config's runs on the union of their steps (each run
 * linearly interpolated inside its own step range, so runs thinned at different steps
 * still average); `band` adds the min..max over runs as a faint area (`LineSeries.band`); `each` draws
 * every run in the identity's colour. Series ids are unique (`LineChart` keys by id); the
 * identity's main line has the identity id, so the sidebar hover highlights it.
 */
import type { PanelSpec, TaskRun, ViewQueryBody } from "../api/models";
import type { LineSeries } from "../charts/LineChart";
import type { Identity } from "./useRunSelection";

export type SeedsMode = "mean" | "band" | "each";
export type XMode = "step" | "wall" | "relative";
export const X_LABEL: Record<XMode, string> = { step: "step", wall: "wall time", relative: "relative time" };
export const CURVE_POINTS = 300;
export const METRICS_PER_PANEL = 100;

/** A `curves` row; `t` (wall-clock seconds) when the server sends it. */
export interface CurvePoint {
  run_id: string;
  group_id: string;
  seed: number | null;
  name: string;
  step: number;
  value: number;
  t?: number | null;
}

export interface MetricSection {
  title: string;
  metrics: string[];
}

export function metricSections(names: readonly string[]): MetricSection[] {
  const out = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const name of names) {
    const cut = name.indexOf("/");
    const title = cut > 0 ? name.slice(0, cut) : "metrics";
    out.set(title, [...(out.get(title) ?? []), name]);
  }
  return [...out].map(([title, metrics]) => ({ title, metrics }));
}

export function matchesSearch(title: string, query: string): boolean {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  return q === "" || title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
}

export function stepCurvesBody(names: readonly string[], runIds: readonly string[]): ViewQueryBody | null {
  if (names.length === 0 || runIds.length === 0) return null;
  const panels: PanelSpec[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i += METRICS_PER_PANEL) {
    panels.push({
      type: "curves",
      title: `step metrics ${panels.length + 1}`,
      data: {
        metrics: names.slice(i, i + METRICS_PER_PANEL),
        group_by: "group",
        max_points: CURVE_POINTS,
        filter: { run_id: [...runIds] },
      },
    });
  }
  return { view: { title: "Step metrics", panels } };
}

export function xOf(p: CurvePoint, mode: XMode, start: number | undefined): number | null {
  if (mode === "step") return p.step;
  if (typeof p.t !== "number") return null;
  if (mode === "wall") return p.t;
  return start === undefined ? null : p.t - start;
}

export function hasTime(points: readonly CurvePoint[]): boolean {
  return points.some((p) => typeof p.t === "number");
}

/** Linear interpolation inside the run's own range; null outside it. `list` is sorted by x. */
function valueAt(list: readonly [number, number][], x: number): number | null {
  const first = list[0];
  const last = list[list.length - 1];
  if (!first || !last || x < first[0] || x > last[0]) return null;
  let lo = 0;
  let hi = list.length - 1;
  while (hi - lo > 1) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
    if ((list[mid] as [number, number])[0] <= x) lo = mid;
    else hi = mid;
  }
  const [x0, y0] = list[lo] as [number, number];
  const [x1, y1] = list[hi] as [number, number];
  if (x === x0 || x1 === x0) return y0;
  if (x === x1) return y1;
  return y0 + ((y1 - y0) * (x - x0)) / (x1 - x0);
}

export function curveSeries(
  points: readonly CurvePoint[],
  metric: string,
  items: readonly Identity[],
  colorOf: (id: string) => string,
  seeds: SeedsMode,
  x: XMode,
): LineSeries[] {
  const start = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const p of points) if (typeof p.t === "number") start.set(p.run_id, Math.min(start.get(p.run_id) ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, p.t));
  const byRun = new Map<string, [number, number][]>();
  for (const p of points) {
    if (p.name !== metric || !Number.isFinite(p.value)) continue;
    const xv = xOf(p, x, start.get(p.run_id));
    if (xv === null) continue;
    byRun.set(p.run_id, [...(byRun.get(p.run_id) ?? []), [xv, p.value]]);
  }
  for (const list of byRun.values()) list.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
  const out: LineSeries[] = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    const color = colorOf(item.id);
    const own = item.runs.filter((r) => byRun.has(r.run_id));
    if (own.length === 0) continue;
    if (item.kind === "run" || own.length === 1) {
      const run = own[0] as TaskRun;
      out.push({ id: item.id, name: item.name, color, points: byRun.get(run.run_id) ?? [], running: run.status === "running", failed: run.status === "failed" });
      continue;
    }
    if (seeds === "each") {
      // one id per line (LineChart keys series by id); groupId lets the sidebar hover highlight all seeds
      for (const run of own) {
        out.push({
          id: `${item.id}:${run.run_id}`,
          groupId: item.id,
          name: `${item.name} · seed ${run.seed ?? "?"}`,
          color,
          points: byRun.get(run.run_id) ?? [],
          running: run.status === "running",
          failed: run.status === "failed",
        });
      }
      continue;
    }
    const xs = [...new Set(own.flatMap((r) => (byRun.get(r.run_id) ?? []).map((p) => p[0])))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const mean: [number, number][] = [];
    const lo: [number, number][] = [];
    const hi: [number, number][] = [];
    for (const xv of xs) {
      const vs = own.map((r) => valueAt(byRun.get(r.run_id) ?? [], xv)).filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
      if (vs.length === 0) continue;
      mean.push([xv, vs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vs.length]);
      if (vs.length > 1) {
        lo.push([xv, Math.min(...vs)]);
        hi.push([xv, Math.max(...vs)]);
      }
    }
    const band: [number, number, number][] | undefined =
      seeds === "band" && lo.length > 0 ? lo.map(([x, l], i) => [x, l, (hi[i] as [number, number])[1]]) : undefined;
    // band = min..max over the config's seeds, drawn by LineChart as a faint area behind the mean line
    out.push({ id: item.id, name: item.name, color, points: mean, band, running: own.some((r) => r.status === "running"), failed: own.every((r) => r.status === "failed") });
  }
  return out;
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/task/saveView.ts
/**
 * "Save as view" (spec 4.2): the Charts tab's shown panels as a view document. The text
 * is block YAML (plain scalars where safe, JSON-quoted otherwise, flow lists of scalars),
 * which the server parses with `yaml.safe_load` and validates like any view.
 */
import type { PanelSpec, ViewSpec } from "../api/models";
import { type MetricSection, matchesSearch } from "./stepMetrics";

const PLAIN = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*$/;
const KEYWORD = /^(true|false|null|yes|no|on|off|y|n)$/i;

function scalar(v: unknown): string {
  if (v === null) return "null";
  if (typeof v === "string") return PLAIN.test(v) && !KEYWORD.test(v) ? v : JSON.stringify(v);
  return String(v);
}

const isScalar = (v: unknown): boolean => v === null || typeof v !== "object";

function mapLines(map: Record<string, unknown>, indent: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(map)) {
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    if (isScalar(value)) {
      out.push(`${indent}${key}: ${scalar(value)}`);
    } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      if (value.every(isScalar)) {
        out.push(`${indent}${key}: [${value.map(scalar).join(", ")}]`);
      } else {
        out.push(`${indent}${key}:`);
        for (const item of value) {
          const inner = mapLines(item as Record<string, unknown>, `${indent}    `);
          if (inner.length === 0) out.push(`${indent}  - {}`);
          else out.push(`${indent}  - ${(inner[0] as string).trimStart()}`, ...inner.slice(1));
        }
      }
    } else {
      const inner = mapLines(value as Record<string, unknown>, `${indent}  `);
      out.push(inner.length ? `${indent}${key}:` : `${indent}${key}: {}`, ...inner);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function viewYaml(spec: ViewSpec): string {
  return `${mapLines(spec as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, "").join("\n")}\n`;
}

/** One curves panel per step-metric section, with the metrics the panel search shows. */
export function stepMetricPanels(sections: readonly MetricSection[], query: string): PanelSpec[] {
  return sections.flatMap((s): PanelSpec[] => {
    const metrics = s.metrics.filter((m) => matchesSearch(m, query));
    return metrics.length ? [{ type: "curves", title: s.title, data: { metrics, group_by: "group" } }] : [];
  });
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/ScoresSection.tsx
/**
 * Scores section (spec 4.2): the primary metric as dot + 95% CI + seed dots per visible
 * identity on one axis with the best interval as a band; for training kinds also the
 * score against GPU-hours with the Pareto front. Seed dots are always drawn (principle 6);
 * a row without an interval gets `DotCIChart`'s own "no interval" tooltip note.
 */
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import type { TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { type DotCIRow, DotCIChart } from "../charts/DotCIChart";
import { Fit } from "../charts/Fit";
import { type ScatterPoint, ScatterPareto } from "../charts/ScatterPareto";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { PanelSection } from "../chrome/PanelSection";
import { matchesSearch } from "./stepMetrics";
import { type Identity, keyLabel } from "./useRunSelection";

export function scoreRows(items: readonly Identity[], colorOf: (id: string) => string): DotCIRow[] {
  return items.map((i) => {
    const g = i.kind === "group" ? i.group : null;
    return {
      id: i.id,
      name: i.name,
      color: colorOf(i.id),
      mean: i.value,
      lo: g?.test_interval?.lo ?? g?.primary?.ci_low ?? null,
      hi: g?.test_interval?.hi ?? g?.primary?.ci_high ?? null,
      seeds: g ? g.seed_values : [],
      n: g?.primary?.n ?? (i.value === null ? 0 : 1),
      best: g?.is_best === true,
    };
  });
}

export function bestBand(data: TaskRuns): { lo: number; hi: number } | null {
  const best = data.groups.find((g) => g.is_best);
  return best?.test_interval ? { lo: best.test_interval.lo, hi: best.test_interval.hi } : null;
}

/** Mean GPU-hours per run (x) against the primary (y), for identities with both. */
export function paretoPoints(items: readonly Identity[], colorOf: (id: string) => string): ScatterPoint[] {
  return items.flatMap((i): ScatterPoint[] => {
    const hours = i.runs.map((r) => r.gpu_hours).filter((h): h is number => typeof h === "number" && Number.isFinite(h));
    if (i.value === null || hours.length === 0) return [];
    const g = i.kind === "group" ? i.group : null;
    return [
      {
        id: i.id,
        name: i.name,
        color: colorOf(i.id),
        x: hours.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / hours.length,
        y: i.value,
        yLo: g?.test_interval?.lo ?? null,
        yHi: g?.test_interval?.hi ?? null,
      },
    ];
  });
}

export interface ScoresSectionProps {
  data: TaskRuns;
  items: readonly Identity[];
  colorOf: (id: string) => string;
  highlight: string | null;
  query: string;
}

export function ScoresSection({ data, items, colorOf, highlight, query }: ScoresSectionProps): ReactElement | null {
  const title = keyLabel(data.primary);
  const paretoTitle = `${title} vs GPU-hours`;
  const points = data.kind === "training" ? paretoPoints(items, colorOf) : [];
  const showScore = matchesSearch(title, query);
  const showPareto = points.length > 0 && matchesSearch(paretoTitle, query);
  if (!showScore && !showPareto) return null;
  const rows = scoreRows(items, colorOf);
  const what = items.some((i) => i.kind === "run") ? "runs" : "configs";
  return (
    <PanelSection title="Scores" count={(showScore ? 1 : 0) + (showPareto ? 1 : 0)} storageKey={`${data.project}/${data.task}`} grid="fill">
      {showScore ? (
        <Panel title={title} unit={data.higher_is_better ? "higher is better" : "lower is better"} aside={`${rows.length} ${what}`}>
          <Fit>{(width) => <DotCIChart width={width} rows={rows} band={bestBand(data)} highlight={highlight} />}</Fit>
        </Panel>
      ) : null}
      {showPareto ? (
        <Panel title={paretoTitle} unit="Pareto front dashed">
          <Fit>
            {(width) => <ScatterPareto width={width} points={points} xName="GPU-hours per run" yName={title} higherIsBetter={data.higher_is_better} />}
          </Fit>
        </Panel>
      ) : null}
    </PanelSection>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/StepMetricsSection.tsx
/**
 * Step metrics (spec 4.2): one line panel per logged metric, a section per first `/`
 * prefix, crosshair synced inside a section (`crosshairGroup`). The histories come from
 * one `views/query` of curves panels over the visible runs only.
 */
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { useViewQuery } from "../api/queries";
import { Fit } from "../charts/Fit";
import { LineChart } from "../charts/LineChart";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { PanelSection } from "../chrome/PanelSection";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import {
  type CurvePoint,
  type MetricSection,
  type SeedsMode,
  type XMode,
  X_LABEL,
  curveSeries,
  matchesSearch,
  stepCurvesBody,
} from "./stepMetrics";
import type { Identity } from "./useRunSelection";

export interface StepCurves {
  points: CurvePoint[];
  error: Error | null;
  loading: boolean;
}

export function useStepCurves(project: string, task: string, metricNames: readonly string[], items: readonly Identity[]): StepCurves {
  const runIds = items.flatMap((i) => i.runs.map((r) => r.run_id));
  const body = stepCurvesBody(metricNames, runIds);
  const query = useViewQuery(project, task, body);
  const failed = query.data?.panels.map((p) => p.meta.error).find((e): e is string => typeof e === "string");
  return {
    points: (query.data?.panels ?? []).flatMap((p) => p.rows as unknown as CurvePoint[]),
    error: query.error ?? (failed ? new Error(failed) : null),
    loading: body !== null && (query.isPending || query.isPlaceholderData),
  };
}

export interface StepMetricsSectionProps {
  curves: StepCurves;
  sections: readonly MetricSection[];
  items: readonly Identity[];
  colorOf: (id: string) => string;
  highlight: string | null;
  query: string;
  smoothing: number;
  x: XMode;
  seeds: SeedsMode;
  /** `${project}/${task}`: section open state per task. */
  storageKey: string;
  onAddPanel?: () => void;
}

export function StepMetricsSection(props: StepMetricsSectionProps): ReactElement {
  const { curves, sections, items, colorOf, highlight, query, smoothing, x, seeds, storageKey, onAddPanel } = props;
  return (
    <>
      {sections.map((s) => {
        const metrics = s.metrics.filter((m) => matchesSearch(m, query));
        if (metrics.length === 0) return null;
        return (
          <PanelSection key={s.title} title={s.title} count={metrics.length} storageKey={storageKey} onAddPanel={onAddPanel}>
            {curves.error ? <ErrorBox error={curves.error} /> : null}
            {metrics.map((m) => (
              <Panel key={m} title={m}>
                {curves.loading ? (
                  <Loading />
                ) : (
                  <Fit>
                    {(width) => (
                      <LineChart
                        width={width}
                        series={curveSeries(curves.points, m, items, colorOf, seeds, x)}
                        smoothing={smoothing}
                        crosshairGroup={`step:${s.title}`}
                        xLabel={X_LABEL[x]}
                        highlight={seeds === "each" ? null : highlight}
                      />
                    )}
                  </Fit>
                )}
              </Panel>
            ))}
          </PanelSection>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/ScoreKeySections.tsx
/**
 * Score keys (spec 4.2, eval tasks): keys split as `<prefix>/<A>.<B>.<metric>` into one
 * section per metric (`sectionsFromKeys`; the primary's section first and open, others
 * closed, so 50+ keys stay fast) and one horizontal bar panel per key: bars from zero in
 * run colours, the best config green, CI whiskers on the primary key. Panel search
 * matches titles and keys.
 */
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import type { TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { type BarRow, BarPanel } from "../charts/BarPanel";
import { Fit } from "../charts/Fit";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { PanelSection } from "../chrome/PanelSection";
import { type KeySection, sectionsFromKeys } from "../lib/scoreKeys";
import { matchesSearch } from "./stepMetrics";
import { type Identity, scoreOf } from "./useRunSelection";

export function visibleKeySections(data: TaskRuns, query: string): KeySection[] {
  return sectionsFromKeys(data.score_keys, data.primary)
    .map((s) => ({
      metric: s.metric,
      panels: s.panels
        .filter((p) => matchesSearch(p.title, query) || matchesSearch(p.key, query))
        .sort((a, b) => Number(b.key === data.primary) - Number(a.key === data.primary)),
    }))
    .filter((s) => s.panels.length > 0);
}

export function barRows(items: readonly Identity[], key: string, data: TaskRuns, colorOf: (id: string) => string): BarRow[] {
  return items.map((i) => {
    const g = i.kind === "group" ? i.group : null;
    const t = key === data.primary ? g?.test_interval : null;
    return {
      id: i.id,
      name: i.name,
      color: colorOf(i.id),
      value: scoreOf(i, key),
      ci: t ? { lo: t.lo, hi: t.hi, method: t.method } : null,
      best: g?.is_best === true,
    };
  });
}

export interface ScoreKeySectionsProps {
  data: TaskRuns;
  items: readonly Identity[];
  colorOf: (id: string) => string;
  highlight: string | null;
  query: string;
}

export function ScoreKeySections({ data, items, colorOf, highlight, query }: ScoreKeySectionsProps): ReactElement {
  const primaryMetric = sectionsFromKeys(data.score_keys, data.primary)[0]?.metric;
  return (
    <>
      {visibleKeySections(data, query).map((s) => (
        <PanelSection
          key={s.metric}
          title={s.metric}
          count={s.panels.length}
          defaultOpen={s.metric === primaryMetric}
          storageKey={`${data.project}/${data.task}`}
          grid="small"
        >
          {s.panels.map((p) => (
            <Panel key={p.key} title={p.title} aside={p.key === data.primary ? <span className="star">★ primary</span> : undefined}>
              <Fit>{(width) => <BarPanel width={width} rows={barRows(items, p.key, data, colorOf)} metric={p.key} highlight={highlight} />}</Fit>
            </Panel>
          ))}
        </PanelSection>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```
