```tsx
// ui/src/task/ViewPanels.tsx
/**
 * Server panel results in panel chrome: the foundation's `PanelGrid` (each result in a
 * `chrome/Panel`, span 12 = full row). For training, agent_eval, agent_iteration and
 * system_bench tasks a bare `/r/<id>` link inside a panel opens that run inline
 * (`onSelectRun`), as on the v4 page; every other link navigates. `query` (the Charts
 * tab's panel search) keeps the panels whose title matches.
 */
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import type { PanelResult, PanelSpec, TaskKind } from "../api/models";
import { NavigateContext, useNavigateHref } from "../pages/components/links";
import { PanelGrid } from "../pages/components/PanelGrid";
import { matchesSearch } from "./stepMetrics";

export const INLINE_RUN_KINDS: ReadonlySet<TaskKind> = new Set<TaskKind>(["training", "agent_eval", "agent_iteration", "system_bench"]);

/** The run id of a bare `/r/<id>` link (no query, no hash), else null. */
export function inlineRunId(href: string): string | null {
  const match = /^\/r\/([^/?#]+)$/.exec(href);
  if (!match) return null;
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(match[1] as string);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** The title a panel is shown (and searched) by: the result's, else the spec's, else the type. */
export function panelTitle(result: PanelResult, spec: PanelSpec | undefined): string {
  return result.title || spec?.title || result.type;
}

export interface ViewPanelsProps {
  results: readonly PanelResult[];
  specs?: readonly PanelSpec[];
  kind?: TaskKind;
  onSelectRun?: (runId: string) => void;
  query?: string;
}

export function ViewPanels({ results, specs, kind, onSelectRun, query = "" }: ViewPanelsProps): ReactElement {
  const navigate = useNavigateHref();
  const select = (href: string): void => {
    const id = kind !== undefined && onSelectRun && INLINE_RUN_KINDS.has(kind) ? inlineRunId(href) : null;
    if (id !== null && onSelectRun) onSelectRun(id);
    else navigate(href);
  };
  const kept = results.map((result, i) => ({ result, spec: specs?.[i] })).filter(({ result, spec }) => matchesSearch(panelTitle(result, spec), query));
  const keptSpecs = specs && kept.every((k) => k.spec !== undefined) ? kept.map((k) => k.spec as PanelSpec) : undefined;
  return (
    <NavigateContext.Provider value={select}>
      <PanelGrid results={kept.map((k) => k.result)} specs={keptSpecs} />
    </NavigateContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

Replace `ui/src/task/KindSection.tsx` with the T3 file plus `query` (non-matching extras are hidden; the whole section returns `null` when nothing matches):

```tsx
// ui/src/task/KindSection.tsx
/**
 * The task kind's preset panels and extras, one collapsible section of the Charts tab
 * (spec 4.2 "The task kind's preset panels ... render in the same panel chrome"). The
 * preset's leaderboard and per-config curves are left out: the Scores and Step metrics
 * sections draw them. Extras keep their v4 behaviour: training run and checkpoint tables,
 * iteration example changes, benchmark raw samples scoped to the inline-selected run.
 * The section uses the one-column grid: the preset panels bring their own `PanelGrid`.
 * `query` (panel search) hides non-matching panels, and the section when none match.
 */
import { type ReactElement, type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import type { Leaderboard, PanelSpec, TaskKind, ViewSpec } from "../api/models";
import { useView, useViewQuery } from "../api/queries";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { PanelSection } from "../chrome/PanelSection";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { SelectedRun } from "../pages/components/SelectedRun";
import { AgentIterationFlips, SystemRawSamples } from "../pages/components/TaskInsights";
import { TrainingCheckpoints, TrainingRuns } from "../pages/components/TrainingDetails";
import { matchesSearch } from "./stepMetrics";
import { ViewPanels, panelTitle } from "./ViewPanels";

export const KIND_TITLE: Record<TaskKind, string> = {
  generic: "Summary",
  training: "Training",
  agent_eval: "Agent eval",
  agent_iteration: "Iterations",
  system_bench: "Benchmark",
};

/** Preset panels this section draws: all but leaderboards and `group_by: group` curves. */
export function presetPanels(view: ViewSpec): PanelSpec[] {
  return (view.panels ?? []).filter(
    (p) => p.type !== "leaderboard" && !(p.type === "curves" && (p.data?.group_by ?? "group") === "group"),
  );
}

export interface KindSectionProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  kind: TaskKind;
  board: Leaderboard | undefined;
  query?: string;
}

export function KindSection({ project, task, kind, board, query = "" }: KindSectionProps): ReactElement | null {
  const [selectedRun, setSelectedRun] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const preset = useView(project, task, "overview");
  const panels = preset.data ? presetPanels(preset.data.view) : [];
  const body = preset.data && panels.length > 0 ? { view: { ...preset.data.view, panels } } : null;
  const results = useViewQuery(project, task, body);
  const select = (runId: string): void => setSelectedRun(runId);
  const extras: { title: string; node: ReactNode }[] =
    kind === "training"
      ? [
          { title: "Training runs", node: <TrainingRuns project={project} task={task} onSelectRun={select} /> },
          { title: "Checkpoint metrics", node: <TrainingCheckpoints project={project} task={task} onSelectRun={select} /> },
        ]
      : kind === "agent_iteration"
        ? [{ title: "Example changes", node: <AgentIterationFlips project={project} task={task} board={board} /> }]
        : kind === "system_bench"
          ? [{ title: "Raw samples", node: <SystemRawSamples project={project} task={task} selectedRunId={selectedRun ?? undefined} /> }]
          : [];
  const shownExtras = extras.filter((x) => matchesSearch(x.title, query));
  const anyMatch =
    query.trim() === "" ||
    shownExtras.length > 0 ||
    (results.data?.panels ?? []).some((r, i) => matchesSearch(panelTitle(r, panels[i]), query));
  if (!anyMatch) return null;
  return (
    <PanelSection title={KIND_TITLE[kind]} count={panels.length + extras.length} storageKey={`${project}/${task}`} grid="wide">
      {preset.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={preset.error} />
      ) : results.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={results.error} />
      ) : body === null ? null : results.data && !results.isPlaceholderData ? (
        <ViewPanels results={results.data.panels} specs={panels} kind={kind} onSelectRun={select} query={query} />
      ) : (
        <Loading />
      )}
      {shownExtras.map((x) => (
        <Panel key={x.title} title={x.title}>
          {x.node}
        </Panel>
      ))}
      {selectedRun ? <SelectedRun runId={selectedRun} onClose={() => setSelectedRun(null)} /> : null}
    </PanelSection>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/ChartsTab.tsx
/**
 * Charts tab (spec 4.2): the runs sidebar and the panel area. Toolbar: panel search,
 * smoothing (EMA, value shown), x axis, seeds, `+ Panel`, `Save as view`. Sections:
 * Scores, Step metrics (one per prefix), Score keys (more than one key), then the kind's
 * preset panels. Every panel draws the visible identities in their colours and follows
 * the sidebar's hover.
 */
import { type ReactElement, useState } from "react";
import type { Leaderboard, PanelSpec, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { useSaveView } from "../api/queries";
import { EmptyState } from "../chrome/EmptyState";
import { FilterField } from "../chrome/FilterField";
import { colorFor } from "../lib/color";
import { hrefs, useNavigateHref } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { isViewName } from "../pages/ViewEditor";
import { useHighlight } from "./highlight";
import { KindSection } from "./KindSection";
import { RunsSidebar } from "./RunsSidebar";
import { stepMetricPanels, viewYaml } from "./saveView";
import { ScoreKeySections } from "./ScoreKeySections";
import { ScoresSection } from "./ScoresSection";
import { StepMetricsSection, useStepCurves } from "./StepMetricsSection";
import { type SeedsMode, type XMode, hasTime, metricSections } from "./stepMetrics";
import { type Selection, listIdentities } from "./useRunSelection";

export interface ChartsTabProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  data: TaskRuns;
  board: Leaderboard | undefined;
  selection: Selection;
  onSelection: (patch: Partial<Selection>) => void;
  onOpenRun: (runId: string) => void;
  /** Open a saved view's tab (after Save as view). */
  onOpenView: (name: string) => void;
  /** Names already used by views of the task (Save as view must not overwrite one). */
  viewNames: readonly string[];
}

export interface AddPanelItem {
  label: string;
  onPick: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function ChartsTab(props: ChartsTabProps): ReactElement {
  const { project, task, data, board, selection, onSelection, onOpenRun, onOpenView, viewNames } = props;
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [smoothing, setSmoothing] = useState(0.6);
  const [x, setX] = useState<XMode>("step");
  const [seeds, setSeeds] = useState<SeedsMode>("mean");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const highlight = useHighlight();
  const navigate = useNavigateHref();
  const items = listIdentities(selection, data).filter((i) => !i.hidden);
  const order = items.map((i) => i.id);
  const colorOf = (id: string): string => colorFor(id, order);
  const sections = metricSections(data.metric_names);
  const curves = useStepCurves(project, task, data.metric_names, items);
  const timed = hasTime(curves.points);
  const seedWord = data.kind === "system_bench" ? "Repeats" : "Seeds";
  const addView = (): void => navigate(hrefs.edit(project, task, "new"));
  const savedPanels: PanelSpec[] = stepMetricPanels(sections, query);
  return (
    <div className="ws">
      <RunsSidebar data={data} selection={selection} onChange={onSelection} onOpen={onOpenRun} />
      <div className="panels">
        <div className="ptools">
          <FilterField value={query} onChange={setQuery} placeholder="Search panels" label="Search panels" size="sm" />
          {data.metric_names.length > 0 ? (
            <>
              <label>
                Smoothing
                <input
                  type="range"
                  className="ctl"
                  min={0}
                  max={0.95}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={smoothing}
                  aria-label="Smoothing"
                  onChange={(e) => setSmoothing(Number(e.target.value))}
                />
                <span className="val">{smoothing.toFixed(2)}</span>
              </label>
              <label>
                X
                <select className="ctl" aria-label="X axis" value={x} onChange={(e) => setX(e.target.value as XMode)}>
                  <option value="step">step</option>
                  <option value="wall" disabled={!timed}>
                    wall time
                  </option>
                  <option value="relative" disabled={!timed}>
                    relative time
                  </option>
                </select>
              </label>
              <label>
                {seedWord}
                <select className="ctl" aria-label={seedWord} value={seeds} onChange={(e) => setSeeds(e.target.value as SeedsMode)}>
                  <option value="mean">mean</option>
                  <option value="band">mean + band</option>
                  <option value="each">{seedWord === "Repeats" ? "each repeat" : "each seed"}</option>
                </select>
              </label>
            </>
          ) : null}
          <span className="sp" />
          <AddPanelMenu items={[{ label: "Custom view…", onPick: addView }]} />
          <button type="button" className="btn sm" aria-expanded={saving} onClick={() => setSaving((s) => !s)}>
            Save as view
          </button>
        </div>
        {saving ? (
          <SaveViewForm
            project={project}
            task={task}
            panels={savedPanels}
            taken={viewNames}
            onSaved={(name) => {
              setSaving(false);
              onOpenView(name);
            }}
            onCancel={() => setSaving(false)}
          />
        ) : null}
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title={data.runs.length === 0 ? "No runs yet" : "No runs shown"} />
        ) : (
          <>
            <ScoresSection data={data} items={items} colorOf={colorOf} highlight={highlight} query={query} />
            <StepMetricsSection
              curves={curves}
              sections={sections}
              items={items}
              colorOf={colorOf}
              highlight={highlight}
              query={query}
              smoothing={smoothing}
              x={x}
              seeds={seeds}
              storageKey={`${project}/${task}`}
              onAddPanel={addView}
            />
            {data.score_keys.length > 1 ? (
              <ScoreKeySections data={data} items={items} colorOf={colorOf} highlight={highlight} query={query} />
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
        <KindSection project={project} task={task} kind={data.kind} board={board} query={query} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AddPanelMenu({ items }: { items: readonly AddPanelItem[] }): ReactElement {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <span className="popover-anchor">
      <button type="button" className="btn sm" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
        + Panel
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <div
          className="popover"
          role="menu"
          aria-label="Add panel"
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          {items.map((it) => (
            <button
              key={it.label}
              type="button"
              role="menuitem"
              disabled={it.disabled}
              onClick={() => {
                setOpen(false);
                it.onPick();
              }}
            >
              {it.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

interface SaveViewFormProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  panels: readonly PanelSpec[];
  taken: readonly string[];
  onSaved: (name: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

function SaveViewForm({ project, task, panels, taken, onSaved, onCancel }: SaveViewFormProps): ReactElement {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const save = useSaveView(project, task);
  const exists = taken.includes(name);
  const ok = isViewName(name) && !exists && panels.length > 0;
  return (
    <form
      className="save-view"
      aria-label="Save as view"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!ok || save.isPending) return;
        save.mutate({ name, text: viewYaml({ title: name, panels: [...panels] }) }, { onSuccess: () => onSaved(name) });
      }}
    >
      <input aria-label="View name" value={name} placeholder="view_name" onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value.trim())} />
      <span className="muted">{exists ? `${name} exists` : `${panels.length} panel${panels.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}</span>
      <button type="submit" className="btn sm primary" disabled={!ok || save.isPending}>
        Save
      </button>
      <button type="button" className="btn sm" onClick={onCancel}>
        Cancel
      </button>
      {save.error ? <ErrorBox error={save.error} /> : null}
    </form>
  );
}
```

  ```ts
  export interface CompareRow { metric: string; dataset: string; values: (number | null)[]; best: number | null }
  export interface CompareResultRow { dataset: string; model: string | null; metric: string; key: string; run_id: string; group_id: string; name: string; value: number | null }
  export const DEFAULT_DATASETS = 4;
  export function compareLabels(names?: readonly string[] | null): CompareLabels;
  export function compareModel(keys: readonly string[], primary: string, names?: readonly string[] | null): CompareModel | null; // null below 2 datasets
  export function defaultCompare(model: CompareModel, primary: string, names?: readonly string[] | null): CompareState;
  export function toggleKeepOne(selected: readonly string[], value: string, order: readonly string[]): string[];
  export function compareKeyFor(model: CompareModel, dataset: string, modelName: string | null, metric: string): string | undefined;
  export function rowBest(values: readonly (number | null)[], higherIsBetter: boolean): number | null;
  export function compareRows(model: CompareModel, state: CompareState, columns: readonly CompareColumn[], higherIsBetter: boolean): CompareRow[];
  export function comparePanelSpec(state: CompareState, labels: CompareLabels): PanelSpec;
  export function compareFromRows(rows: readonly CompareResultRow[]): { model: CompareModel; columns: Omit<CompareColumn, "color">[]; state: Omit<CompareState, "render"> } | null;
  // ComparePanel.tsx
  export interface CompareBodyProps { model: CompareModel; state: CompareState; onState: (next: CompareState) => void; columns: readonly CompareColumn[]; higherIsBetter: boolean; showSwitch?: boolean }
  export function CompareBody(props: CompareBodyProps): ReactElement;
  export function ComparePanel(props: CompareBodyProps & { onRemove?: () => void }): ReactElement;
  ```

```ts
// ui/src/task/compareModel.ts
/**
 * The Compare panel's model (spec 4.2): score keys `<prefix>/<dataset>.<model>.<metric>`
 * (or `<dataset>.<metric>`) with the primary's prefix, split by `splitKey`. Defaults: the
 * first four datasets, the primary's model, the primary's metric, table. Multi-selects
 * keep at least one value. A row's best value is marked only between two or more
 * distinct values.
 */
import type { PanelSpec } from "../api/models";
import { type KeyParts, splitKey } from "../lib/scoreKeys";

export type CompareRender = "table" | "bars";

export interface CompareState {
  datasets: string[];
  model: string | null;
  metrics: string[];
  render: CompareRender;
}

export interface CompareKey extends KeyParts {
  key: string;
}

export interface CompareLabels {
  datasets: string;
  model: string;
  metrics: string;
}

export interface CompareModel {
  keys: CompareKey[];
  datasets: string[];
  models: string[];
  metrics: string[];
  labels: CompareLabels;
}

/** One table column / bar series: a visible identity and its scores by key. */
export interface CompareColumn {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  scores: Readonly<Record<string, number | null | undefined>>;
}

export interface CompareRow {
  metric: string;
  dataset: string;
  values: (number | null)[];
  best: number | null;
}

/** A `views/query` row of a saved `compare` panel. */
export interface CompareResultRow {
  dataset: string;
  model: string | null;
  metric: string;
  key: string;
  run_id: string;
  group_id: string;
  name: string;
  value: number | null;
}

export const DEFAULT_DATASETS = 4;

const cap = (s: string): string => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);

/** Control labels from `hypothex.yaml` `score_keys` names (`{split}.{arch}.{metric}` → Splits, Arch). */
export function compareLabels(names?: readonly string[] | null): CompareLabels {
  if (!names || names.length < 2) return { datasets: "Datasets", model: "Model", metrics: "Metrics" };
  const others = names.filter((n) => n !== "metric");
  return { datasets: `${cap(others[0] ?? "dataset")}s`, model: cap(others[1] ?? "model"), metrics: "Metrics" };
}

function uniq(values: readonly (string | null)[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(values.filter((v): v is string => v !== null))];
}

export function compareModel(keys: readonly string[], primary: string, names?: readonly string[] | null): CompareModel | null {
  const prefix = splitKey(primary, names).prefix;
  const parsed = [...new Set(keys)]
    .map((key): CompareKey => ({ key, ...splitKey(key, names) }))
    .filter((k) => k.prefix === prefix && k.dataset !== null);
  const datasets = uniq(parsed.map((k) => k.dataset));
  if (datasets.length < 2) return null;
  return {
    keys: parsed,
    datasets,
    models: uniq(parsed.map((k) => k.model)),
    metrics: uniq(parsed.map((k) => k.metric)),
    labels: compareLabels(names),
  };
}

export function defaultCompare(model: CompareModel, primary: string, names?: readonly string[] | null): CompareState {
  const prim = splitKey(primary, names);
  return {
    datasets: model.datasets.slice(0, DEFAULT_DATASETS),
    model: prim.model !== null && model.models.includes(prim.model) ? prim.model : (model.models[0] ?? null),
    metrics: [model.metrics.includes(prim.metric) ? prim.metric : (model.metrics[0] as string)],
    render: "table",
  };
}

/** Toggle `value`; the last selected value cannot be removed; the result keeps `order`. */
export function toggleKeepOne(selected: readonly string[], value: string, order: readonly string[]): string[] {
  if (selected.includes(value)) return selected.length > 1 ? selected.filter((v) => v !== value) : [...selected];
  const next = new Set([...selected, value]);
  return order.filter((v) => next.has(v));
}

export function compareKeyFor(model: CompareModel, dataset: string, modelName: string | null, metric: string): string | undefined {
  return model.keys.find((k) => k.dataset === dataset && k.model === modelName && k.metric === metric)?.key;
}

export function rowBest(values: readonly (number | null)[], higherIsBetter: boolean): number | null {
  const v = values.filter((x): x is number => x !== null && Number.isFinite(x));
  if (v.length < 2 || new Set(v).size < 2) return null;
  return higherIsBetter ? Math.max(...v) : Math.min(...v);
}

export function compareRows(model: CompareModel, state: CompareState, columns: readonly CompareColumn[], higherIsBetter: boolean): CompareRow[] {
  const metrics = model.metrics.filter((m) => state.metrics.includes(m));
  const datasets = model.datasets.filter((d) => state.datasets.includes(d));
  return metrics.flatMap((metric) =>
    datasets.map((dataset) => {
      const key = compareKeyFor(model, dataset, state.model, metric);
      const values = columns.map((c) => (key === undefined ? null : (c.scores[key] ?? null)));
      return { metric, dataset, values, best: rowBest(values, higherIsBetter) };
    }),
  );
}

/** The view panel "Save as view" writes (`type: compare`). */
export function comparePanelSpec(state: CompareState, labels: CompareLabels): PanelSpec {
  return {
    type: "compare",
    title: `Compare ${labels.datasets.toLowerCase()}${state.model ? ` · ${state.model}` : ""}`,
    data: { datasets: [...state.datasets], model: state.model, metrics: [...state.metrics] },
    render: state.render,
  };
}

/** A saved compare panel's rows as a model, one column per group, everything selected. */
export function compareFromRows(
  rows: readonly CompareResultRow[],
): { model: CompareModel; columns: Omit<CompareColumn, "color">[]; state: Omit<CompareState, "render"> } | null {
  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const keys = new Map<string, CompareKey>();
  const columns = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; scores: Record<string, number | null> }>();
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (!keys.has(r.key)) {
      const cut = r.key.indexOf("/");
      keys.set(r.key, { key: r.key, prefix: cut > 0 ? r.key.slice(0, cut) : "", dataset: r.dataset, model: r.model, metric: r.metric });
    }
    const id = r.group_id || r.run_id;
    const col = columns.get(id) ?? { id, name: r.name, scores: {} };
    col.scores[r.key] = r.value;
    columns.set(id, col);
  }
  const list = [...keys.values()];
  const model: CompareModel = {
    keys: list,
    datasets: uniq(list.map((k) => k.dataset)),
    models: uniq(list.map((k) => k.model)),
    metrics: uniq(list.map((k) => k.metric)),
    labels: compareLabels(null),
  };
  return { model, columns: [...columns.values()], state: { datasets: model.datasets, model: list[0]?.model ?? null, metrics: model.metrics } };
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/ComparePanel.tsx
/**
 * Compare panel (spec 4.2): datasets side by side. Controls: Datasets (multi), Model
 * (single, when keys have a model part), Metrics (multi); multi-selects keep one value.
 * Table by default: one row per dataset (grouped under metric header rows when several
 * metrics), one column per visible run; best value per row green. `Table | Bars` shows
 * grouped bars instead (one facet per metric, legend).
 */
import { Fragment, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { Fit } from "../charts/Fit";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { Segmented } from "../chrome/Segmented";
import { fmtScore } from "../pages/components/format";
import { GroupedBars } from "../charts/BarPanel";
import { type CompareColumn, type CompareModel, type CompareRender, type CompareRow, type CompareState, compareRows, toggleKeepOne } from "./compareModel";

export interface CompareBodyProps {
  model: CompareModel;
  state: CompareState;
  onState: (next: CompareState) => void;
  columns: readonly CompareColumn[];
  higherIsBetter: boolean;
  /** Draw the Table | Bars switch inside the body (a saved view panel); the Charts tab puts it in the header. */
  showSwitch?: boolean;
}

const RENDERS = [
  ["table", "Table"],
  ["bars", "Bars"],
] as const;

function RenderSwitch({ state, onState }: Pick<CompareBodyProps, "state" | "onState">): ReactElement {
  return <Segmented label="Render" options={RENDERS} value={state.render} onChange={(render: CompareRender) => onState({ ...state, render })} />;
}

interface ChipGroupProps {
  label: string;
  values: readonly string[];
  selected: readonly string[];
  single?: boolean;
  onToggle: (value: string) => void;
}

function ChipGroup({ label, values, selected, single = false, onToggle }: ChipGroupProps): ReactElement {
  return (
    <div className="cmp-row">
      <span className="cmp-l">{label}</span>
      <div className="cmp-chips" role={single ? "radiogroup" : "group"} aria-label={label}>
        {values.map((v) => (
          <button
            key={v}
            type="button"
            className={`chip${selected.includes(v) ? " on" : ""}`}
            role={single ? "radio" : "checkbox"}
            aria-checked={selected.includes(v)}
            onClick={() => onToggle(v)}
          >
            {v}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function CompareTable({ rows, columns, metrics }: { rows: readonly CompareRow[]; columns: readonly CompareColumn[]; metrics: readonly string[] }): ReactElement {
  const many = metrics.length > 1;
  return (
    <div className="tblwrap cmp-wrap">
      <table className="t cmp-t" aria-label="Compare table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">{many ? "Metric · dataset" : `${metrics[0] ?? ""} · dataset`}</th>
            {columns.map((c) => (
              <th key={c.id} scope="col" className="num">
                <span className="sw" style={{ background: c.color }} aria-hidden="true" />
                {c.name}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {metrics.map((metric) => (
            <Fragment key={metric}>
              {many ? (
                <tr className="g">
                  <td colSpan={columns.length + 1}>{metric}</td>
                </tr>
              ) : null}
              {rows
                .filter((r) => r.metric === metric)
                .map((r) => (
                  <tr key={`${metric}/${r.dataset}`}>
                    <th scope="row" className={many ? "in" : undefined}>
                      {r.dataset}
                    </th>
                    {r.values.map((v, i) => (
                      <td key={columns[i]?.id ?? i} className={`num${v !== null && v === r.best ? " best" : ""}`}>
                        {fmtScore(v)}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

function CompareBars({ rows, columns, metrics }: { rows: readonly CompareRow[]; columns: readonly CompareColumn[]; metrics: readonly string[] }): ReactElement {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="legend">
        {columns.map((c) => (
          <span key={c.id} className="st">
            <span className="sw" style={{ background: c.color }} aria-hidden="true" />
            {c.name}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="facets" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${metrics.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}>
        {metrics.map((metric) => {
          const mine = new Map(rows.filter((r) => r.metric === metric).map((r) => [r.dataset, r]));
          const index = new Map(columns.map((c, i) => [c.id, i]));
          return (
            <div key={metric} className="facet">
              <div className="facet-h">{metric}</div>
              <Fit>
                {(width) => (
                  <GroupedBars
                    width={width}
                    categories={[...mine.keys()]}
                    series={columns}
                    valueOf={(dataset, seriesId) => mine.get(dataset)?.values[index.get(seriesId) ?? -1] ?? null}
                    best={(dataset) => mine.get(dataset)?.best ?? null}
                  />
                )}
              </Fit>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function CompareBody({ model, state, onState, columns, higherIsBetter, showSwitch = true }: CompareBodyProps): ReactElement {
  const rows = compareRows(model, state, columns, higherIsBetter);
  const metrics = model.metrics.filter((m) => state.metrics.includes(m));
  return (
    <div className="cmp-body">
      <div className="cmp">
        <ChipGroup
          label={model.labels.datasets}
          values={model.datasets}
          selected={state.datasets}
          onToggle={(v) => onState({ ...state, datasets: toggleKeepOne(state.datasets, v, model.datasets) })}
        />
        {model.models.length > 1 ? (
          <ChipGroup single label={model.labels.model} values={model.models} selected={state.model ? [state.model] : []} onToggle={(v) => onState({ ...state, model: v })} />
        ) : null}
        <ChipGroup
          label={model.labels.metrics}
          values={model.metrics}
          selected={state.metrics}
          onToggle={(v) => onState({ ...state, metrics: toggleKeepOne(state.metrics, v, model.metrics) })}
        />
        {showSwitch ? <RenderSwitch state={state} onState={onState} /> : null}
      </div>
      {state.render === "bars" ? <CompareBars rows={rows} columns={columns} metrics={metrics} /> : <CompareTable rows={rows} columns={columns} metrics={metrics} />}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ComparePanel({ onRemove, ...body }: CompareBodyProps & { onRemove?: () => void }): ReactElement {
  const shown = body.model.datasets.filter((d) => body.state.datasets.includes(d)).length;
  return (
    <Panel
      title={`Compare ${body.model.labels.datasets.toLowerCase()}${body.state.model ? ` · ${body.state.model}` : ""}`}
      aside={`${shown} × ${body.columns.length} runs`}
      tools={
        <span className="cmp-aside">
          <RenderSwitch state={body.state} onState={body.onState} />
          {onRemove ? (
            <button type="button" className="btn sm ghost" aria-label="Remove compare panel" onClick={onRemove}>
              Remove
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </span>
      }
    >
      <CompareBody {...body} showSwitch={false} />
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/panels/Compare.tsx
/**
 * `compare` view panel (spec 4.2 "Save as view"): a saved Compare panel drawn from its
 * `views/query` rows (`{dataset, model, metric, key, run_id, group_id, name, value}`).
 * `meta.render` picks table or bars; `meta.higher_is_better` the best direction.
 */
import { type ReactElement, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { colorFor } from "../lib/color";
import { CompareBody } from "../task/ComparePanel";
import { type CompareResultRow, type CompareState, compareFromRows } from "../task/compareModel";
import type { PanelProps } from "./index";

export function ComparePanelResult({ result }: PanelProps): ReactElement {
  const built = useMemo(() => compareFromRows(result.rows as unknown as CompareResultRow[]), [result.rows]);
  const [state, setState] = useState<CompareState | null>(null);
  if (!built) return <p className="panel-empty">No compare rows</p>;
  const order = built.columns.map((c) => c.id);
  const columns = built.columns.map((c) => ({ ...c, color: colorFor(c.id, order) }));
  const render = result.meta?.render === "bars" ? "bars" : "table";
  return (
    <CompareBody
      model={built.model}
      state={state ?? { ...built.state, render }}
      onState={setState}
      columns={columns}
      higherIsBetter={result.meta?.higher_is_better !== false}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
// ui/test/task/runsTable.test.ts
import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { fmtP } from "../../src/pages/components/format";
import { columnsKey, identityCells, loadHiddenColumns, runCells, runsColumns, saveHiddenColumns, sortItems } from "../../src/task/runsTable";
import { listIdentities, parseSelection } from "../../src/task/useRunSelection";
import { PROJECT, TASK, makeTaskRuns } from "./fixtures";

const sel = parseSelection(new URLSearchParams(), { sortDir: "desc" });
const data = makeTaskRuns();
const items = listIdentities(sel, data);
const byId = (id: string) => items.find((i) => i.id === id) ?? (() => { throw new Error(id); })();

test("columns: status, each varying param, the primary, CI, Δ best, run facts", () => {
  expect(runsColumns(data).map((c) => c.label)).toEqual(["Status", "lr", "beam", "top1", "95% CI", "Δ best", "Launcher", "Host", "GPU-h", "Started", "Commit", "Tags"]);
});

test("config cells: counts per status, mean ± sd, test interval, Δ best muted inside noise", () => {
  const a = identityCells(byId("g-a"), data);
  expect(a).toMatchObject({ status: [["finished", 2], ["running", 1]], params: { lr: "3e-4", beam: "10" }, mean: 0.911, sd: 0.0014, ci: { lo: 0.905, hi: 0.917 }, delta: null, host: ["gpu1"], gpu: 3, started: "2026-10-03T09:00:05Z", commit: ["8f4cac4"], tags: ["final"] });
  const b = identityCells(byId("g-b"), data);
  expect(b.delta).toBeCloseTo(-0.013, 10);
  expect(b.deltaMuted).toBe(false);
  expect(b.deltaTitle).toBe(`outside the best config's interval · ${fmtP(0.01)}`);
  const c = identityCells(byId("g-c"), data);
  expect(c).toMatchObject({ status: [["queued", 1], ["failed", 1]], mean: null, delta: null, ci: null, gpu: 1.5 });
  const d = identityCells(listIdentities({ ...sel, showSuperseded: true }, data).find((i) => i.id === "g-d") ?? byId("g-a"), data);
  expect(d.deltaMuted).toBe(true);
});

test("a seed row: its own value and status, Δ against the best config", () => {
  const run = data.runs.find((r) => r.run_id === "run-b1");
  if (!run) throw new Error("fixture");
  const cells = runCells(run, data.groups.find((g) => g.group_id === "g-b") ?? null, data);
  expect(cells).toMatchObject({ status: [["finished", 1]], mean: 0.899, sd: null, ci: null, host: ["dgx"] });
  expect(cells.delta).toBeCloseTo(-0.012, 10);
});

test("sort by a column; missing values last; null column keeps the list order", () => {
  expect(sortItems(items, data, "param:host", "desc").map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(["g-a", "g-b", "g-c"]);
  expect(sortItems(items, data, "host", "desc").map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(["g-a", "g-c", "g-b"]);
  expect(sortItems(items, data, "host", "asc").map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(["g-b", "g-a", "g-c"]);
  expect(sortItems(items, data, "primary", "asc").map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(["g-b", "g-a", "g-c"]);
  expect(sortItems(items, data, "param:lr", "asc").map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(["g-b", "g-a", "g-c"]);
  expect(sortItems(items, data, null, "asc").map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(["g-a", "g-b", "g-c"]);
});

test("hidden columns persist per task and survive bad storage", () => {
  saveHiddenColumns(PROJECT, TASK, ["host", "tags"]);
  expect(loadHiddenColumns(PROJECT, TASK)).toEqual(["host", "tags"]);
  localStorage.setItem(columnsKey(PROJECT, TASK), "{not json");
  expect(loadHiddenColumns(PROJECT, TASK)).toEqual([]);
});
```

```tsx
// ui/test/task/RunsTab.test.tsx
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { cleanup, fireEvent, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { TaskRuns } from "../../src/api/models";
import { fmtDate } from "../../src/pages/components/format";
import { RunsTab } from "../../src/task/RunsTab";
import { type Selection, parseSelection } from "../../src/task/useRunSelection";
import { type Call, mockApi, renderWithClient, restoreFetch } from "../pages/helpers";
import { PROJECT, TASK, makeTaskRun, makeTaskRuns } from "./fixtures";

afterEach(restoreFetch);

interface Log {
  patches: Partial<Selection>[];
  charts: number;
  opened: string[];
}

function Harness({ data, log }: { data: TaskRuns; log: Log }) {
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Selection>(parseSelection(new URLSearchParams(), { sortDir: "desc" }));
  return (
    <RunsTab
      project={PROJECT}
      task={TASK}
      data={data}
      selection={sel}
      onSelection={(p) => {
        log.patches.push(p);
        setSel((s) => ({ ...s, ...p }));
      }}
      onOpenCharts={() => {
        log.charts += 1;
      }}
      onOpenRun={(id) => log.opened.push(id)}
    />
  );
}

function setup(data: TaskRuns = makeTaskRuns()): Log {
  const log: Log = { patches: [], charts: 0, opened: [] };
  renderWithClient(<Harness data={data} log={log} />);
  return log;
}

const table = () => screen.getByRole("table", { name: "Runs" });
const headers = () => within(table()).getAllByRole("columnheader").map((h) => h.textContent ?? "");
const bodyRows = () => within(table()).getAllByRole("row").slice(1) as HTMLElement[];
const cell = (row: HTMLElement, label: string) => within(row).getAllByRole("cell")[headers().indexOf(label)] as HTMLElement;
const nameOf = (row: HTMLElement) => within(row).getAllByRole("link")[0]?.textContent;
const pick = (name: string) => fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("checkbox", { name: `Select ${name}` }));

describe("RunsTab", () => {
  test("one row per config with every column", () => {
    setup();
    expect(headers().slice(2)).toEqual(["Name", "Status", "lr", "beam", "top1", "95% CI", "Δ best", "Launcher", "Host", "GPU-h", "Started", "Commit", "Tags"]);
    const [a, b, c] = bodyRows() as [HTMLElement, HTMLElement, HTMLElement];
    expect(bodyRows()).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(nameOf(a)).toBe("lr 3e-4 · beam 10");
    expect(cell(a, "top1").textContent).toBe("0.9110 ± 0.0014");
    expect(cell(a, "top1").className).toContain("best");
    expect(cell(a, "95% CI").textContent).toBe("0.905–0.917");
    expect(cell(a, "Δ best").textContent).toBe("—");
    expect(within(cell(a, "Status")).getByTitle("2 finished")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(within(cell(a, "Status")).getByTitle("1 running")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(cell(a, "lr").textContent).toBe("3e-4");
    expect(cell(a, "GPU-h").textContent).toBe("3.0");
    expect(cell(a, "Started").textContent).toBe(fmtDate("2026-10-03T09:00:05Z"));
    expect(cell(a, "Commit").textContent).toBe("8f4cac4");
    expect(cell(a, "Tags").textContent).toBe("final");
    const delta = within(cell(b, "Δ best")).getByTitle(/outside the best config's interval/);
    expect(delta.textContent).toBe("−0.0130");
    expect(delta.className).not.toContain("muted");
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement `runsTable.ts`**

```ts
// ui/src/task/runsTable.ts
/**
 * The Runs tab table (spec 4.2 "Runs"): columns, the cells of a config or a run, sorting,
 * and the column chooser's stored choice (localStorage, per task).
 */
import type { RunStatus, TaskGroup, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { fmtP } from "../pages/components/format";
import { type Identity, keyLabel } from "./useRunSelection";

export interface RunsColumn {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  numeric: boolean;
}

export function runsColumns(data: TaskRuns): RunsColumn[] {
  return [
    { id: "status", label: "Status", numeric: false },
    ...data.varying_keys.map((k) => ({ id: `param:${k}`, label: k, numeric: false })),
    { id: "primary", label: keyLabel(data.primary), numeric: true },
    { id: "ci", label: "95% CI", numeric: true },
    { id: "delta", label: "Δ best", numeric: true },
    { id: "launcher", label: "Launcher", numeric: false },
    { id: "host", label: "Host", numeric: false },
    { id: "gpu", label: "GPU-h", numeric: true },
    { id: "started", label: "Started", numeric: false },
    { id: "commit", label: "Commit", numeric: false },
    { id: "tags", label: "Tags", numeric: false },
  ];
}

export const STATUS_ORDER: readonly RunStatus[] = ["finished", "running", "queued", "failed", "killed", "lost"];

export interface Cells {
  status: [RunStatus, number][];
  params: Record<string, string>;
  mean: number | null;
  sd: number | null;
  ci: { lo: number; hi: number } | null;
  delta: number | null;
  deltaMuted: boolean;
  deltaTitle: string | undefined;
  launcher: string[];
  host: string[];
  gpu: number | null;
  started: string | null;
  commit: string[];
  tags: string[];
}

export function bestGroup(data: TaskRuns): TaskGroup | undefined {
  return data.groups.find((g) => g.is_best && g.primary !== null);
}

const uniq = (values: readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): string[] =>
  [...new Set(values.filter((v): v is string => typeof v === "string" && v !== ""))];

export function cellsFor(
  runs: readonly TaskRun[],
  group: TaskGroup | null,
  value: number | null,
  sd: number | null,
  data: TaskRuns,
  asGroup: boolean,
): Cells {
  const best = bestGroup(data);
  const isBest = asGroup && best !== undefined && group?.group_id === best.group_id;
  const delta = best?.primary && value !== null && !isBest ? value - best.primary.mean : null;
  const within = group?.within_noise_of_best === true;
  const p = group?.vs_best?.p;
  const hours = runs.map((r) => r.gpu_hours).filter((h): h is number => typeof h === "number" && Number.isFinite(h));
  return {
    status: STATUS_ORDER.map((s): [RunStatus, number] => [s, runs.filter((r) => r.status === s).length]).filter(([, n]) => n > 0),
    params: Object.fromEntries(data.varying_keys.map((k) => [k, uniq(runs.map((r) => r.params[k])).join(", ")])),
    mean: value,
    sd,
    ci: asGroup && group?.test_interval ? { lo: group.test_interval.lo, hi: group.test_interval.hi } : null,
    delta,
    deltaMuted: delta !== null && within,
    deltaTitle:
      delta === null ? undefined : `${within ? "inside" : "outside"} the best config's interval${typeof p === "number" ? ` · ${fmtP(p)}` : ""}`,
    launcher: uniq(runs.map((r) => r.created_by)),
    host: uniq(runs.map((r) => r.host)),
    gpu: hours.length ? hours.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) : null,
    started: runs.map((r) => r.started_at).filter((s): s is string => typeof s === "string").sort()[0] ?? null,
    commit: uniq(runs.map((r) => r.commit?.slice(0, 7))),
    tags: uniq(runs.flatMap((r) => r.tags)),
  };
}

export function identityCells(item: Identity, data: TaskRuns): Cells {
  return cellsFor(item.runs, item.group, item.value, item.sd, data, item.kind === "group");
}

export function runCells(run: TaskRun, group: TaskGroup | null, data: TaskRuns): Cells {
  return cellsFor([run], group, run.primary, null, data, false);
}

export type TableSortDir = "asc" | "desc";

const NUMERIC = /^[-+]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(e[-+]?\d+)?$/i;

function sortValue(item: Identity, cells: Cells, col: string): number | string | null {
  if (col === "name") return item.name.toLowerCase();
  if (col.startsWith("param:")) {
    const v = cells.params[col.slice(6)] ?? "";
    if (v === "") return null;
    return NUMERIC.test(v) ? Number(v) : v;
  }
  const joined = (list: readonly string[]): string | null => (list.length ? list.join(", ") : null);
  switch (col) {
    case "status":
      return joined(cells.status.map(([s]) => s));
    case "primary":
      return cells.mean;
    case "ci":
      return cells.ci?.lo ?? null;
    case "delta":
      return cells.delta;
    case "gpu":
      return cells.gpu;
    case "started":
      return cells.started;
    case "launcher":
      return joined(cells.launcher);
    case "host":
      return joined(cells.host);
    case "commit":
      return joined(cells.commit);
    case "tags":
      return joined(cells.tags);
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** Sort by one column; missing values last in either direction; ties keep the list order. */
export function sortItems(items: readonly Identity[], data: TaskRuns, col: string | null, dir: TableSortDir): Identity[] {
  if (col === null) return [...items];
  return items
    .map((item, i) => ({ item, i, v: sortValue(item, identityCells(item, data), col) }))
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.v === null || b.v === null) return a.v === b.v ? a.i - b.i : a.v === null ? 1 : -1;
      const d = typeof a.v === "number" && typeof b.v === "number" ? a.v - b.v : String(a.v).localeCompare(String(b.v));
      return d !== 0 ? (dir === "asc" ? d : -d) : a.i - b.i;
    })
    .map((x) => x.item);
}

export function columnsKey(project: string, task: string): string {
  return `hx.runs.columns.${project}/${task}`;
}

export function loadHiddenColumns(project: string, task: string): string[] {
  try {
    const raw: unknown = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(columnsKey(project, task)) ?? "[]");
    return Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string") : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function saveHiddenColumns(project: string, task: string, hidden: readonly string[]): void {
  localStorage.setItem(columnsKey(project, task), JSON.stringify(hidden));
}
```

Note: in the test `sortItems(items, data, "param:host", "desc")` sorts by a param that does not exist (every value missing), so the list order stays.

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement `RunsTab.tsx`**

```tsx
// ui/src/task/RunsTab.tsx
/**
 * Runs tab (spec 4.2 "Runs"): the full table with a sticky header. Columns: select,
 * swatch, name, status (counts per state for configs), each varying param, primary mean ±
 * sd, 95% CI, Δ best (muted inside the best interval), launcher, host, GPU-h, started,
 * commit, tags. Configs expand to their seeds; headers sort; a column chooser; bulk
 * actions on the selection: Compare, Tag, Archive, Rename. Filter and grouping are the
 * sidebar's (shared URL state).
 */
import type { QueryKey } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Fragment, type MouseEvent, type ReactElement, type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { TaskGroup, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES, useRenameRun } from "../api/queries";
import { EmptyState } from "../chrome/EmptyState";
import { FilterField } from "../chrome/FilterField";
import { Icon } from "../chrome/Icon";
import { Launcher } from "../chrome/Launcher";
import { Segmented } from "../chrome/Segmented";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { colorFor } from "../lib/color";
import { fmtDate, fmtDelta, fmtInterval, fmtScore, shortId } from "../pages/components/format";
import { hrefs, isPlainClick } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { fmtGpuHours } from "../pages/components/SweepModel";
import { useAction } from "../pages/components/useAction";
import {
  type Cells,
  type RunsColumn,
  type TableSortDir,
  identityCells,
  loadHiddenColumns,
  runCells,
  runsColumns,
  saveHiddenColumns,
  sortItems,
} from "./runsTable";
import { type Selection, identities, latestRun, listIdentities } from "./useRunSelection";

export interface RunsTabProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  data: TaskRuns;
  selection: Selection;
  onSelection: (patch: Partial<Selection>) => void;
  onOpenCharts: () => void;
  onOpenRun: (runId: string) => void;
}

const TASK_RUN_INVALIDATES: readonly QueryKey[] = [...RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES, ["taskRuns"]];
const GROUPS = [
  ["config", "By config"],
  ["run", "Each run"],
] as const;

export function RunsTab({ project, task, data, selection, onSelection, onOpenCharts, onOpenRun }: RunsTabProps): ReactElement {
  const listed = listIdentities(selection, data);
  const visible = listed.filter((i) => !i.hidden).map((i) => i.id);
  const columns = runsColumns(data);
  const [hiddenCols, setHiddenCols] = useState<string[]>(() => loadHiddenColumns(project, task));
  const shown = columns.filter((c) => !hiddenCols.includes(c.id));
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<{ col: string; dir: TableSortDir } | null>(null);
  const rows = sortItems(listed, data, sort?.col ?? null, sort?.dir ?? "desc");
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const [form, setForm] = useState<"tag" | "rename" | null>(null);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [renameError, setRenameError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const chosen = rows.filter((i) => picked.has(i.id));
  const runIds = chosen.flatMap((i) => i.runs.map((r) => r.run_id));
  const tag = useAction({
    send: async ({ ids, tag: name }: { ids: string[]; tag: string }, opts) => {
      for (const id of ids) await api.tagRun(id, { add: [name] }, { ...opts, command_id: `${opts.command_id}:${id}` });
    },
    invalidate: TASK_RUN_INVALIDATES,
    onSuccess: () => {
      setForm(null);
      setText("");
    },
  });
  const archive = useAction({
    send: async (ids: string[], opts) => {
      for (const id of ids) await api.archiveRun(id, true, { ...opts, command_id: `${opts.command_id}:${id}` });
    },
    invalidate: TASK_RUN_INVALIDATES,
    onSuccess: () => setPicked(new Set()),
  });
  const rename = useRenameRun();
  const toggle = (set: ReadonlySet<string>, id: string): Set<string> => {
    const next = new Set(set);
    if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
    else next.add(id);
    return next;
  };
  const sortBy = (col: string): void =>
    setSort((s) => (s && s.col === col ? { col, dir: s.dir === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc" } : { col, dir: "desc" }));
  const compare = (): void => {
    onSelection({ hidden: identities(data, selection.group).map((i) => i.id).filter((id) => !picked.has(id)) });
    onOpenCharts();
  };
  const saveName = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const item = chosen[0];
    if (!item) return;
    const name = text.trim() === "" ? null : text.trim();
    setRenameError(null);
    try {
      for (const run of item.runs) await rename.mutateAsync({ runId: run.run_id, name });
      setForm(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setRenameError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    }
  };
  const allPicked = rows.length > 0 && rows.every((i) => picked.has(i.id));
  return (
    <div className="runs-tab">
      <div className="ptools">
        <FilterField
          value={selection.filter}
          onChange={(filter) => onSelection({ filter })}
          placeholder="Filter  lr=3e-4 · tag:final · status:running"
          label="Filter runs"
        />
        <Segmented label="Group" options={GROUPS} value={selection.group} onChange={(group) => onSelection({ group })} />
        <ColumnChooser
          columns={columns}
          hidden={hiddenCols}
          onChange={(next) => {
            setHiddenCols(next);
            saveHiddenColumns(project, task, next);
          }}
        />
        <span className="sp" />
        <span className="muted">{`${picked.size} selected`}</span>
        <button type="button" className="btn sm" disabled={picked.size === 0} onClick={compare}>
          Compare
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn sm" disabled={picked.size === 0} aria-expanded={form === "tag"} onClick={() => setForm((f) => (f === "tag" ? null : "tag"))}>
          Tag
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn sm" disabled={picked.size === 0 || archive.pending} onClick={() => archive.run(runIds)}>
          Archive
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn sm"
          disabled={chosen.length !== 1}
          title={chosen.length > 1 ? "Rename one config or run at a time" : undefined}
          onClick={() => {
            setText(chosen[0]?.baseName ?? "");
            setRenameError(null);
            setForm("rename");
          }}
        >
          Rename
        </button>
      </div>
      {form === "tag" ? (
        <form
          className="bulk-form"
          aria-label="Tag runs"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const name = text.trim();
            if (name && runIds.length) tag.run({ ids: runIds, tag: name });
          }}
        >
          <input aria-label="Tag" value={text} placeholder="tag" onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} />
          <button type="submit" className="btn sm primary" disabled={!text.trim() || tag.pending}>
            {`Add to ${runIds.length} runs`}
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : null}
      {form === "rename" ? (
        <form
          className="bulk-form"
          aria-label="Rename"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            void saveName();
          }}
        >
          <input aria-label="Name" value={text} maxLength={80} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} />
          <button type="submit" className="btn sm primary" disabled={rename.isPending}>
            Save name
          </button>
          {renameError ? <span role="alert">{renameError}</span> : null}
        </form>
      ) : null}
      {tag.error ? <ErrorBox error={tag.error} /> : null}
      {archive.error ? <ErrorBox error={archive.error} /> : null}
      {data.runs.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No runs yet" />
      ) : (
        <div className="tblwrap runs-table">
          <table className="t" aria-label="Runs">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th className="sel">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    aria-label="Select all"
                    checked={allPicked}
                    onChange={(e) => setPicked(e.target.checked ? new Set(rows.map((i) => i.id)) : new Set())}
                  />
                </th>
                <th aria-label="Colour" />
                <SortHeader col="name" label="Name" numeric={false} sort={sort} onSort={sortBy} />
                {shown.map((c) => (
                  <SortHeader key={c.id} col={c.id} label={c.label} numeric={c.numeric} sort={sort} onSort={sortBy} />
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map((item) => (
                <Fragment key={item.id}>
                  <tr className={`${item.kind === "group" ? "g" : ""}${item.hidden ? " off" : ""}`}>
                    <td className="sel">
                      <input type="checkbox" aria-label={`Select ${item.name}`} checked={picked.has(item.id)} onChange={() => setPicked((s) => toggle(s, item.id))} />
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className="sw" style={item.hidden ? undefined : { background: colorFor(item.id, visible) }} aria-hidden="true" />
                    </td>
                    <td className="name">
                      {item.kind === "group" ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="caret"
                          aria-expanded={open.has(item.id)}
                          aria-label={`${open.has(item.id) ? "Collapse" : "Expand"} ${item.name}`}
                          onClick={() => setOpen((s) => toggle(s, item.id))}
                        >
                          ▸
                        </button>
                      ) : null}
                      <RunLink run={latestRun(item.runs)} onOpen={onOpenRun}>
                        {item.name}
                      </RunLink>
                      {item.kind === "group" ? <span className="muted">{` ${item.runs.length} seed${item.runs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}</span> : null}
                    </td>
                    {shown.map((c) => (
                      <CellView key={c.id} col={c} cells={identityCells(item, data)} best={item.kind === "group" && item.group?.is_best === true} asRun={item.kind === "run"} />
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                  {item.kind === "group" && open.has(item.id)
                    ? item.runs.map((run) => <SeedRow key={run.run_id} run={run} group={item.group} data={data} shown={shown} onOpenRun={onOpenRun} />)
                    : null}
                </Fragment>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SortHeader({ col, label, numeric, sort, onSort }: { col: string; label: string; numeric: boolean; sort: { col: string; dir: TableSortDir } | null; onSort: (col: string) => void }): ReactElement {
  const active = sort?.col === col;
  return (
    <th scope="col" className={numeric ? "num" : undefined} aria-sort={active ? (sort.dir === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending") : undefined}>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => onSort(col)}>
        {label}
        {active ? (sort.dir === "asc" ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""}
      </button>
    </th>
  );
}

function RunLink({ run, onOpen, children }: { run: TaskRun | undefined; onOpen: (runId: string) => void; children: ReactNode }): ReactElement {
  if (!run) return <span>{children}</span>;
  return (
    <a
      href={hrefs.run(run.run_id)}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        if (!isPlainClick(e)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        onOpen(run.run_id);
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

function SeedRow({ run, group, data, shown, onOpenRun }: { run: TaskRun; group: TaskGroup | null; data: TaskRuns; shown: readonly RunsColumn[]; onOpenRun: (runId: string) => void }): ReactElement {
  return (
    <tr className="seed">
      <td className="sel" />
      <td />
      <td className="name">
        <span>{`seed ${run.seed ?? "—"}`}</span>{" "}
        <RunLink run={run} onOpen={onOpenRun}>
          <span className="mono">{shortId(run.run_id)}</span>
        </RunLink>
      </td>
      {shown.map((c) => (
        <CellView key={c.id} col={c} cells={runCells(run, group, data)} best={false} asRun />
      ))}
    </tr>
  );
}

function CellView({ col, cells, best, asRun }: { col: RunsColumn; cells: Cells; best: boolean; asRun: boolean }): ReactElement {
  if (col.id.startsWith("param:")) return <td>{cells.params[col.id.slice(6)] || "—"}</td>;
  switch (col.id) {
    case "status":
      return (
        <td>
          <span className="sts">
            {cells.status.map(([s, n]) => (
              <StatusIcon key={s} status={s} title={`${n} ${s}`} label={asRun ? undefined : String(n)} />
            ))}
          </span>
        </td>
      );
    case "primary":
      return (
        <td className={`num${best ? " best" : ""}`}>
          {fmtScore(cells.mean)}
          {cells.sd !== null ? <span className="muted">{` ± ${fmtScore(cells.sd)}`}</span> : null}
        </td>
      );
    case "ci":
      return <td className="num muted">{cells.ci ? fmtInterval(cells.ci.lo, cells.ci.hi) : ""}</td>;
    case "delta":
      return (
        <td className="num">
          {cells.delta === null ? (
            "—"
          ) : (
            <span className={cells.deltaMuted ? "muted" : undefined} title={cells.deltaTitle}>
              {fmtDelta(cells.delta)}
            </span>
          )}
        </td>
      );
    case "launcher":
      return (
        <td>
          {cells.launcher.map((by) => (
            <Launcher key={by} who={by} />
          ))}
        </td>
      );
    case "host":
      return <td>{cells.host.join(", ")}</td>;
    case "gpu":
      return <td className="num">{cells.gpu === null ? "—" : fmtGpuHours(cells.gpu)}</td>;
    case "started":
      return <td className="muted">{cells.started ? fmtDate(cells.started) : "—"}</td>;
    case "commit":
      return <td className="mono">{cells.commit.join(", ")}</td>;
    case "tags":
      return (
        <td>
          {cells.tags.map((t) => (
            <span key={t} className="tag">
              {t}
            </span>
          ))}
        </td>
      );
    default:
      return <td />;
  }
}

function ColumnChooser({ columns, hidden, onChange }: { columns: readonly RunsColumn[]; hidden: readonly string[]; onChange: (next: string[]) => void }): ReactElement {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const count = columns.filter((c) => !hidden.includes(c.id)).length;
  return (
    <span className="popover-anchor">
      <button type="button" className="chip" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
        Columns <b>{count}</b>
        <span className="chev">
          <Icon name="chevron" size={9} />
        </span>
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <div className="popover" role="group" aria-label="Columns">
          {columns.map((c) => (
            <label key={c.id}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={!hidden.includes(c.id)}
                onChange={() => onChange(hidden.includes(c.id) ? hidden.filter((h) => h !== c.id) : [...hidden, c.id])}
              />
              {c.label}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: F10 `ParallelCoords` (`axes: PCAxis {key, label, values?}`, `lines: PCLine {id, name, values}`, `colorBy` = a numeric axis key; it colours on its own sequential ramp); `SweepModel` (`parseCell`, `parseCells`, `rankCells`, `heatAxes`, `gridLabel`, `paramsText`, `orderRuns`, `runState`, `staleHosts`, `seedValues`, `hostsOf`, `sweepStats`, `fmtGpuHours`), `SweepActions`, `SweepRerun`, `SweepHeat`, `SweepTable`, `SweepRuns`, `SweepProgress`, `StatStrip` (`pages/components/StatStrip`), `useNow` (`HostsPanel`), `useSweep`, `useAllRuns`, `useHosts`, `useProjectSweeps`, `api.leaderboard`, `queryKeys.leaderboard`; F `ParallelCoords`/`PCAxis`/`PCLine`, `Fit`, `Panel`, `Launcher`, `EmptyState`; T1 `runLabel`.
- Produces:
  ```ts
  // sweepMath.ts
  export function taskSweepIds(data: TaskRuns): string[];               // newest run first
  export interface Importance { name: string; share: number }
  export function whatMatters(cells: readonly SweepCellRow[], names: readonly string[]): Importance[];
  export const SCORE_AXIS = "#score";
  export interface BestComparison { best: SweepCellRow; next: SweepCellRow | null; delta: number | null; overlap: boolean | null }
  export function bestComparison(cells: readonly SweepCellRow[], higherIsBetter: boolean): BestComparison | null;
  export function sweepLines(data: TaskRuns, spec: SweepSpec): PCLine[];       // F10 PCLine: values keyed by axis key
  export function parallelAxes(spec: SweepSpec, metric: string): PCAxis[];       // grid params, then the score axis (colorBy)
  // SweepDetail.tsx
  export function sweepRunsQuery(project: string, tag: string): Omit<RunsQuery, "limit">;
  export function SweepDetail(props: { project: string; sweepId: string; data?: TaskRuns; now?: number }): ReactElement;
  // SweepsTab.tsx
  export function SweepsTab(props: { project: string; data: TaskRuns; sweepId: string | null; onSelect: (id: string) => void; now?: number }): ReactElement;
  // SweepRedirect.tsx
  export function SweepRedirect(props: { project: string; sweepId: string }): ReactElement;
  // links.tsx
  hrefs.taskSweep(project: string, task: string, sweepId: string): string;  // /t/p/t?tab=sweeps&sweep=<id>
  ```

**What matters (exact formula).** From the cells only (`summarize_sweep`: per cell `n` scored seeds, mean `m_c`, seed sd `s_c`). Let `N = Σ n_c`, `M = Σ n_c·m_c / N`. For each param `p` and each value `v`: `n_v = Σ_{c: p=v} n_c`, `m_v = Σ_{c: p=v} n_c·m_c / n_v`, and `SS_p = Σ_v n_v·(m_v − M)²`. Between cells `SS_cells = Σ n_c·(m_c − M)²`; `interaction = max(0, SS_cells − Σ_p SS_p)`; seeds `SS_seed = Σ (n_c − 1)·s_c²` (a cell without `std` adds 0). `share_x = SS_x / (Σ_p SS_p + interaction + SS_seed)`. On a balanced full grid the denominator is the total sum of squares of all seed values, so the shares are the classic one-way main-effect shares. Rows: params by share (largest first), `interaction` only when its share is at least 0.5 %, then `seed`. Empty when no cell is scored or the denominator is 0.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `sweepMath.ts`**

```ts
// ui/src/task/sweepMath.ts
/**
 * Sweeps tab math (spec 4.2 "Sweeps"): the task's sweeps, "What matters" (share of the
 * primary metric's variance per param, from the cells; formula in `whatMatters`), the
 * best cell against the next one, and the parallel-coordinates axes and lines (the chart
 * colours lines by the score axis on its own sequential ramp).
 */
import type { SweepSpec, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import type { PCAxis, PCLine } from "../charts/ParallelCoords";
import { type SweepCellRow, rankCells } from "../pages/components/SweepModel";
import { runLabel } from "./useRunSelection";

/** Sweep ids of the task's runs, the sweep with the newest run first. */
export function taskSweepIds(data: TaskRuns): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const r of [...data.runs].sort((a, b) => b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at))) {
    if (r.sweep_id && !out.includes(r.sweep_id)) out.push(r.sweep_id);
  }
  return out;
}

export interface Importance {
  name: string;
  share: number;
}

/**
 * Share of variance per param, their interaction and the seeds.
 *
 * With `n_c` scored seeds, mean `m_c` and seed sd `s_c` per cell, `N = Σ n_c` and
 * `M = Σ n_c·m_c / N`: `SS_p = Σ_v n_v (m_v − M)²` over the values `v` of param `p`
 * (`n_v`, `m_v` pooled over the cells with `p = v`); `interaction = max(0, Σ n_c (m_c − M)²
 * − Σ_p SS_p)`; `SS_seed = Σ (n_c − 1) s_c²`. Each share is its SS over
 * `Σ_p SS_p + interaction + SS_seed`.
 */
export function whatMatters(cells: readonly SweepCellRow[], names: readonly string[]): Importance[] {
  const scored = cells.filter((c): c is SweepCellRow & { mean: number } => c.mean !== null && c.n > 0);
  const total = scored.reduce((a, c) => a + c.n, 0);
  if (total === 0) return [];
  const grand = scored.reduce((a, c) => a + c.n * c.mean, 0) / total;
  const between = scored.reduce((a, c) => a + c.n * (c.mean - grand) ** 2, 0);
  const seed = scored.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.n - 1) * (c.std ?? 0) ** 2, 0);
  const main = names.map((name) => {
    const levels = new Map<string, { n: number; sum: number }>();
    for (const c of scored) {
      const v = c.params[name] ?? "";
      const level = levels.get(v) ?? { n: 0, sum: 0 };
      level.n += c.n;
      level.sum += c.n * c.mean;
      levels.set(v, level);
    }
    let ss = 0;
    for (const level of levels.values()) ss += level.n * (level.sum / level.n - grand) ** 2;
    return { name, ss };
  });
  const mainTotal = main.reduce((a, m) => a + m.ss, 0);
  const interaction = Math.max(0, between - mainTotal);
  const denominator = mainTotal + interaction + seed;
  if (denominator <= 1e-15) return [];
  const params = main.map((m) => ({ name: m.name, share: m.ss / denominator })).sort((a, b) => b.share - a.share);
  const inter = interaction / denominator;
  return [...params, ...(inter >= 0.005 ? [{ name: "interaction", share: inter }] : []), { name: "seed", share: seed / denominator }];
}

/** Key of the score axis (`#` keeps it apart from param names, which are identifiers). */
export const SCORE_AXIS = "#score";

export interface BestComparison {
  best: SweepCellRow;
  next: SweepCellRow | null;
  delta: number | null;
  /** The two cells' 95% intervals overlap; null when either has none. */
  overlap: boolean | null;
}

export function bestComparison(cells: readonly SweepCellRow[], higherIsBetter: boolean): BestComparison | null {
  const ranked = rankCells(cells, higherIsBetter);
  const best = ranked[0];
  if (!best || best.mean === null) return null;
  const next = ranked[1];
  if (!next || next.mean === null) return { best, next: null, delta: null, overlap: null };
  const overlap =
    best.lo !== null && best.hi !== null && next.lo !== null && next.hi !== null ? next.lo <= best.hi && best.lo <= next.hi : null;
  return { best, next, delta: best.mean - next.mean, overlap };
}

/** One line per scored run of the sweep: its grid values and the primary (`SCORE_AXIS`). */
export function sweepLines(data: TaskRuns, spec: SweepSpec): PCLine[] {
  return data.runs
    .filter((r) => r.sweep_id === spec.id && r.primary !== null)
    .map((r) => {
      const values: Record<string, string | number | null> = { [SCORE_AXIS]: r.primary };
      for (const p of spec.grid) {
        const raw = r.params[p.name];
        values[p.name] = raw === undefined ? null : p.values ? raw : Number.isFinite(Number(raw)) ? Number(raw) : null;
      }
      return { id: r.run_id, name: runLabel(r), values };
    });
}

/** One axis per grid param (listed values: categorical; sampled ranges: numeric), then the score. */
export function parallelAxes(spec: SweepSpec, metric: string): PCAxis[] {
  return [
    ...spec.grid.map((p): PCAxis => (p.values ? { key: p.name, label: p.name, values: p.values.map(String) } : { key: p.name, label: p.name })),
    { key: SCORE_AXIS, label: metric },
  ];
}
```
