```tsx
// ui/src/task/SweepDetail.tsx
/**
 * One sweep in the Sweeps tab (spec 4.2 "Sweeps"): header (id, grid shape, hosts, GPUs,
 * launcher, time, progress, Rerun sweep, Copy as CLI, Cancel queued, Add seeds, Resume),
 * the issuance state, the stat strip, then panels: parallel coordinates (one line per
 * finished run, sequential colour by the primary), mean per cell (heat table for two
 * params, sortable table otherwise), what matters, best cell against the next, runs on
 * hosts. Data and actions are those of the v4 sweep page.
 */
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { type ReactElement, useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { HostRow, Leaderboard, RunRecord, RunStatus, RunsQuery, SweepSummary, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { queryKeys, useAllRuns, useHosts, useSweep } from "../api/queries";
import { Fit } from "../charts/Fit";
import { ParallelCoords } from "../charts/ParallelCoords";
import { Launcher } from "../chrome/Launcher";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { fmtClock, fmtDelta, fmtInterval, fmtScore, primaryMetricName } from "../pages/components/format";
import { useNow } from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { StatStrip } from "../pages/components/StatStrip";
import { SweepActions } from "../pages/components/SweepActions";
import { SweepProgress } from "../pages/components/SweepGlyphs";
import { SweepHeat } from "../pages/components/SweepHeat";
import {
  type SweepCellRow,
  gridLabel,
  heatAxes,
  hostsOf,
  orderRuns,
  paramsText,
  parseCell,
  parseCells,
  runState,
  seedValues,
  staleHosts,
  sweepStats,
} from "../pages/components/SweepModel";
import { SweepRerun } from "../pages/components/SweepRerun";
import { SweepRuns } from "../pages/components/SweepRuns";
import { SweepTable } from "../pages/components/SweepTable";
import { SCORE_AXIS, bestComparison, parallelAxes, sweepLines, whatMatters } from "./sweepMath";

/**
 * `GET /api/v1/runs` for every run of a sweep: its member tag (`SweepSummary.tag`),
 * archived included, no limit (`useAllRuns` pages until it has them all).
 */
export function sweepRunsQuery(project: string, tag: string): Omit<RunsQuery, "limit"> {
  return { project, tag, archived: true };
}

export interface SweepDetailProps {
  project: string;
  sweepId: string;
  /** The task's runs (parallel coordinates, best-cell p); absent for a sweep without a task. */
  data?: TaskRuns;
  /** Clock for ages, GPU-hours and ETA (tests pass a fixed time). */
  now?: number;
}

export function SweepDetail({ project, sweepId, data, now }: SweepDetailProps): ReactElement {
  const summary = useSweep(project, sweepId);
  const memberTag = summary.data?.tag;
  const runs = useAllRuns(sweepRunsQuery(project, memberTag ?? ""), memberTag !== undefined);
  const hosts = useHosts();
  const tick = useNow();
  const task = summary.data?.spec.task ?? null;
  const board = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.leaderboard(project, task ?? "", []),
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => api.leaderboard(project, task ?? "", [], signal),
    enabled: task !== null,
  });
  return (
    <section className="sweep" aria-label={`Sweep ${sweepId}`}>
      {summary.data ? (
        <SweepBody
          project={project}
          sweepId={sweepId}
          summary={summary.data}
          runs={runs.data?.runs}
          runsError={runs.error}
          onRefresh={() => {
            void runs.refetch();
            void summary.refetch();
          }}
          hosts={hosts.data}
          board={board.data}
          data={data}
          now={now ?? tick}
        />
      ) : summary.error ? (
        <header className="sweep-head">
          <h2>{sweepId}</h2>
        </header>
      ) : (
        <Loading />
      )}
      {summary.error ? <ErrorBox error={summary.error} /> : null}
      {runs.error && runs.data !== undefined && !summary.error ? <ErrorBox error={runs.error} /> : null}
    </section>
  );
}

interface SweepBodyProps {
  project: string;
  sweepId: string;
  summary: SweepSummary;
  runs: readonly RunRecord[] | undefined;
  runsError: Error | null;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  hosts: readonly HostRow[] | undefined;
  board: Leaderboard | undefined;
  data: TaskRuns | undefined;
  now: number;
}

function SweepBody({ project, sweepId, summary, runs, runsError, onRefresh, hosts, board, data, now }: SweepBodyProps): ReactElement {
  const { spec, counts } = summary;
  const names = spec.grid.map((p) => p.name);
  const cells = parseCells(summary.cells);
  const best = parseCell(summary.best);
  const higherIsBetter = board?.higher_is_better ?? true;
  const metric = board ? primaryMetricName(board.primary) : "score";
  const stale = staleHosts(hosts);
  const ordered = orderRuns(runs ?? [], summary.run_ids);
  const byId = new Map(ordered.map((r) => [r.run_id, r]));
  const stateOf = (id: string, fallback: RunStatus | null) => runState(byId.get(id), fallback, stale);
  const seedsOf = (c: SweepCellRow): number[] => seedValues(c, board);
  const axes = heatAxes(spec);
  const gpus = ordered.find((r) => (r.gpus_requested ?? 0) > 0)?.gpus_requested ?? 0;
  const hostList = ordered.length > 0 ? hostsOf(ordered, hosts) : spec.host ? [spec.host] : [];
  const states = ordered.map((r) => runState(r, null, stale));
  const running = states.filter((s) => s === "running" || s === "stale").length;
  const queued = states.filter((s) => s === "queued").length;
  const maxSeeds = spec.seeds.length;
  const [rerun, setRerun] = useState(false);
  const [launched, setLaunched] = useState<{ host: string; n: number } | null>(null);
  const importance = whatMatters(cells, names);
  const comparison = bestComparison(cells, higherIsBetter);
  const lines = data ? sweepLines(data, spec) : [];
  const nextGroup = comparison?.next?.group_id ? data?.groups.find((g) => g.group_id === comparison.next?.group_id) : undefined;
  const bestIsTaskBest = comparison?.best.group_id ? data?.groups.find((g) => g.group_id === comparison.best.group_id)?.is_best === true : false;
  const p = bestIsTaskBest ? nextGroup?.vs_best?.p : undefined;
  return (
    <>
      <header className="sweep-head">
        <div className="sweep-title">
          <h2>{spec.id}</h2>
          <span title={`${cells.length} param combinations × ${maxSeeds} seeds`}>
            <b>{gridLabel(spec)}</b>
            {` = ${counts.total ?? 0}`}
          </span>
          {gpus > 0 ? <span>{`${gpus} GPU / run`}</span> : null}
          {runs === undefined ? (
            <span title="Hosts">{runsError ? "hosts unavailable" : "loading hosts…"}</span>
          ) : hostList.length > 0 ? (
            <span title="Hosts">{hostList.join(", ")}</span>
          ) : null}
          <Launcher who={spec.created_by} />
          <span title={spec.created_at}>{`${fmtClock(spec.created_at)} UTC`}</span>
          <SweepProgress counts={counts} />
        </div>
        <SweepActions
          project={project}
          sweepId={sweepId}
          spec={spec}
          queued={counts.queued ?? 0}
          issuance={summary.issuance}
          cellCount={cells.length}
          runs={ordered}
          onRerun={() => setRerun(true)}
        />
      </header>
      {summary.issuance ? (
        <div className="sweep-issuance" role="status">
          <p>
            {`Issuance ${summary.issuance.state} · ${counts.total ?? 0} observed / ${summary.issuance.planned} planned`}
            {summary.issuance.cancel_requested ? " · cancellation requested" : ""}
          </p>
          {summary.issuance.reason ? <p>{summary.issuance.reason.replaceAll("_", " ")}</p> : null}
          {summary.issuance.error ? <p role="alert">{`${summary.issuance.error.type}: ${summary.issuance.error.message}`}</p> : null}
          {summary.issuance.resume ? <p>{summary.issuance.resume.message}</p> : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {launched ? <p className="small launched" role="status">{`Launched ${launched.n} on ${launched.host}`}</p> : null}
      <div className="sweep-stats">
        <StatStrip
          items={sweepStats({
            counts,
            totalUsd: summary.total_usd,
            best,
            names,
            metric,
            unit: board?.unit ?? "",
            runs: ordered,
            runsState: runs !== undefined ? undefined : runsError ? "error" : "loading",
            hosts,
            now,
          })}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="pgrid sweep-grid">
        {lines.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="wide">
            <Panel title="Parallel coordinates" unit={`one line per finished run · colour = ${metric}`}>
              <Fit>{(width) => <ParallelCoords width={width} axes={parallelAxes(spec, metric)} lines={lines} colorBy={SCORE_AXIS} higherIsBetter={higherIsBetter} />}</Fit>
            </Panel>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="wide">
          <Panel title={`Mean ${metric} per cell`} aside="mean over seeds">
            {axes ? (
              <SweepHeat axes={axes} cells={cells} best={best} metric={metric} higherIsBetter={higherIsBetter} maxSeeds={maxSeeds} stateOf={stateOf} seedsOf={seedsOf} />
            ) : (
              <SweepTable names={names} cells={cells} best={best} metric={metric} higherIsBetter={higherIsBetter} maxSeeds={maxSeeds} stateOf={stateOf} />
            )}
          </Panel>
        </div>
        <Panel title="What matters" unit={`share of ${metric} variance`}>
          {importance.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="wm">
              {importance.map((x) => (
                <div key={x.name} className="wm-row">
                  <span>{x.name}</span>
                  <span className="bar" aria-hidden="true">
                    <i style={{ width: `${(x.share * 100).toFixed(1)}%` }} />
                  </span>
                  <span className="num">{`${Math.round(x.share * 100)}%`}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="muted">No scored cells yet</p>
          )}
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Best cell">
          {comparison ? (
            <dl className="kv">
              <dt>params</dt>
              <dd>{paramsText(comparison.best.params, names)}</dd>
              <dt>{metric}</dt>
              <dd>
                <b className="ok">{fmtScore(comparison.best.mean)}</b>
                {comparison.best.lo !== null && comparison.best.hi !== null ? ` 95% CI ${fmtInterval(comparison.best.lo, comparison.best.hi)}` : ""}
              </dd>
              {comparison.next && comparison.delta !== null ? (
                <>
                  <dt>vs next</dt>
                  <dd>
                    {`${fmtDelta(comparison.delta)} over ${paramsText(comparison.next.params, names)}`}
                    {typeof p === "number" ? `, p = ${p.toPrecision(2)}` : ""}
                    {comparison.overlap !== null ? <div className="muted">{comparison.overlap ? "intervals overlap" : "intervals separate"}</div> : null}
                  </dd>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </dl>
          ) : (
            <p className="muted">No scored runs yet</p>
          )}
        </Panel>
        <div className="wide">
          <Panel title="Runs on hosts" aside={runs === undefined ? "" : `${running} running, ${queued} queued`}>
            {runs === undefined ? (
              runsError ? <ErrorBox error={runsError} /> : <Loading />
            ) : (
              <SweepRuns runs={ordered} names={names} stale={stale} hosts={hosts} now={now} />
            )}
          </Panel>
        </div>
      </div>
      {rerun ? (
        <SweepRerun
          project={project}
          spec={spec}
          best={best}
          runs={runs === undefined ? undefined : ordered}
          runsError={runsError}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          onClose={() => setRerun(false)}
          onLaunched={(records, host) => {
            setRerun(false);
            setLaunched({ host, n: records.length });
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/SweepsTab.tsx
/**
 * Sweeps tab (spec 4.2): the task's sweeps (those its runs belong to, newest first, plus a
 * sweep named by `?sweep=` that has no task run yet) and the selected sweep's detail.
 */
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import type { TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { useProjectSweeps } from "../api/queries";
import { EmptyState } from "../chrome/EmptyState";
import { fmtScore } from "../pages/components/format";
import { paramsText } from "../pages/components/SweepModel";
import { SweepDetail } from "./SweepDetail";
import { taskSweepIds } from "./sweepMath";

export interface SweepsTabProps {
  project: string;
  data: TaskRuns;
  sweepId: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  now?: number;
}

export function SweepsTab({ project, data, sweepId, onSelect, now }: SweepsTabProps): ReactElement {
  const list = useProjectSweeps(project);
  const own = taskSweepIds(data);
  const ids = sweepId !== null && !own.includes(sweepId) ? [sweepId, ...own] : own;
  const current = sweepId ?? ids[0] ?? null;
  if (current === null) return <EmptyState title="No sweeps" />;
  return (
    <div className="sweeps">
      <nav className="sweep-list" aria-label="Sweeps">
        {ids.map((id) => {
          const info = list.data?.find((s) => s.id === id);
          return (
            <button key={id} type="button" className={id === current ? "on" : undefined} aria-current={id === current ? "true" : undefined} onClick={() => onSelect(id)}>
              <b>{id}</b>
              <span className="muted">{info ? `${info.n_runs} runs` : ""}</span>
              {info?.best && info.best.mean !== null ? (
                <span className="best-line">{`${paramsText(info.best.params, Object.keys(info.best.params))} ${fmtScore(info.best.mean)}`}</span>
              ) : null}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
      <SweepDetail key={current} project={project} sweepId={current} data={data} now={now} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/task/SweepRedirect.tsx
/**
 * `/s/$project/$id`: a sweep link. A sweep of a task opens that task's Sweeps tab
 * (`/t/$project/$task?tab=sweeps&sweep=$id`, history replaced); a sweep without a task, or
 * one that fails to load, is shown in place.
 */
import { useRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { type ReactElement, useEffect } from "react";
import { useSweep } from "../api/queries";
import { hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { SweepDetail } from "./SweepDetail";
import "./task.css";

export function SweepRedirect({ project, sweepId }: { project: string; sweepId: string }): ReactElement {
  const summary = useSweep(project, sweepId);
  const router = useRouter({ warn: false }) as unknown as { history: { replace: (href: string) => void } } | null | undefined;
  const task = summary.data?.spec.task ?? null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (task === null) return;
    const href = hrefs.taskSweep(project, task, sweepId);
    if (router) router.history.replace(href);
    else window.location.replace(href);
  }, [project, task, sweepId, router]);
  if (task === null && (summary.data || summary.error)) {
    return (
      <div className="task-page">
        <SweepDetail project={project} sweepId={sweepId} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return <Loading />;
}
```

## Contract conflicts and open questions (for the plan owner)

1. **`TaskRun.name` meaning differs between B and F.** B3's backend `TaskRun.name: str` is the display name (`naming.display_name`); F3's UI type is `name: string | null` ("the name a person or agent set"). This part reads only `renamed ? name : derived_name` (`runBaseName`), which is right under both readings; B and F should still agree on one (recommend F's: explicit name or null, since `renamed` then carries no extra meaning).
2. **`TaskRun.commit` is in neither B3 nor F3.** The Runs tab needs it (spec column "commit"). This part adds `commit?: string | null` to the UI type (T1) and asks B3 to send `commit: str | None` (short `git.commit`). Until then the column is empty.
3. **Curves rows have no `t`.** Spec asks for x = step | wall time | relative time; `views/query` curves rows carry `step` only. T4 offers the time axes but disables them until a row has `t`; ask B to add `t` (from `MetricPoint.t`) to curves rows.
4. **`LineChart` highlight in "each seed" mode.** F6 keys series by `id` and highlights by exact `id`, so the seeds of one config cannot share an id. T4 gives them unique ids and turns hover highlight off in that mode; ask F6 for `LineSeries.group?: string` matched by `highlight`.
5. **Mean + band.** F6 draws lines only; T4 draws the band's min and max as two faint lines in the identity's colour. A filled band would need `LineSeries.band` in F6.
6. **Retired v4 behaviour (named, not silent).** The Metric select's alternate-primary *re-rank and headline* (`?primary=` leaderboard) is gone from the Charts tab (no headline exists in v5); the Sort chip sorts by any score key and the Score keys sections show every key; custom view tabs keep the full Metric override. `+ New run` always templates from the best config by the task's primary (the old page used the selected metric's best). The sweep page's seeds forest is replaced by parallel coordinates + Best cell; its per-cell seeds and CI stay in each cell's tooltip.
7. **Double-click to rename.** The row's name is a link (click opens the run; Part 5 X3 expects a link per row), so a double-click on the *name* would navigate first. Double-click works on the rest of the row; the pencil works everywhere. If the owner wants double-click on the name itself, the name must stop being a link (then rows need another open affordance).
8. **Sidebar "Columns" chip** (spec §4.2) is in the Runs tab only (the sidebar has one value column; the mockup sidebar has no Columns chip either).
9. **`api.tagRun` / `api.archiveRun`** are added by both this part (T6) and the Run part (R2, R4) with the same names and shapes; whichever lands second skips its client step.
10. **Parallel coordinates colour direction.** F10 colours by the score axis value (dark = high). For lower-is-better metrics dark means worse; F10 would need a `lowerIsBetter` flag to flip the ramp.
11. **Sweeps of a task** are found through `TaskRun.sweep_id` (the project sweep list has no task). A sweep with no runs yet appears only when named by `?sweep=` (the redirect does that).
12. **Compare `views/query` result**: this part reads `meta.render` and `meta.higher_is_better` and treats rows as one per group and key (B's contract does not say). Without `meta` the saved panel shows a table, higher is better.

## Self-review

- **Spec §4.2 coverage:** header facts (primary + direction, best value and run, runs/configs, running/queued, dataset) → T3; Charts two columns → T2/T4; sidebar filter/Group/Sort/superseded/`N/M shown`/rows/rename/eye/`aria-pressed`/Enter/hover highlight → T2; toolbar (search, smoothing with value and raw faint, x axis, seeds, `+ Panel`, `Save as view`, wraps) → T4; Scores (DotCI + band, Pareto for training) → T4; Step metrics (prefix sections, synced crosshair via `crosshairGroup`) → T4; Score keys (sections per metric, primary first and open, bars, CI on primary, search) → T4; Compare (first, table default, Bars, chips with keep-one, model single, labels from `key_parts`, several panels, Save as view `compare`) → T5; kind preset panels in panel chrome → T3; Runs tab (all columns, expand, sort, chooser, bulk Compare/Tag/Archive/Rename) → T6; Sweeps (header with progress and actions, parallel coordinates, mean per cell, what matters, best cell + comparison) → T7; Examples and view tabs → T3; `/s/` redirect → T7.
- **Placeholders:** none; every code step carries the code. Edits to existing files are given as exact snippets with their anchor.
- **Type consistency:** `Selection`, `Identity`, `listIdentities`, `visibleIdentities`, `keyLabel`, `scoreOf` (T1) are used unchanged in T2–T7; `ChartsTabProps` grows once (T4); `CompareState`/`CompareModel`/`CompareColumn` (T5) are used by the registry panel; F signatures are those of `20-ui-foundation.md`.
- **Verification done while writing:** the final state of every file in this part was applied to a scratch copy of `ui/` with the foundation's code (F2–F13, F17 `PanelGrid`) extracted from `20-ui-foundation.md` and F3/F4/F14 applied by hand: `bunx tsc --noEmit` reports no error in any file this part touches (the only errors are F17's own pending `KindPanels`/`panelGrid.test` edits); `bun test test/task test/panels/Compare.test.tsx test/api/client.test.ts test/pages/links.test.tsx test/router.test.tsx test/pages/sweepRerun.test.tsx test/pages/sweepGlyphs.test.tsx test/editor` → 232 pass, 0 fail; `vite build` succeeds.

# Part 4 — Run page, Home, Hosts, Queue, restyles

## Part 4 — Run page, Home, Hosts, Queue, kept pages (R1–R8)

Summary (5 lines):
1. R1–R5 replace `pages/Run.tsx` with `ui/src/run/*`: an inline-rename `RunName`, a header coloured by the run's identity in its task, tabs in `?tab=`, an Overview tab (score tiles, "Where it ranks", curves, files), a properties sidebar, and Charts / Logs / Files / Examples tabs.
2. Every behaviour of the old run page survives (actions incl. 3 s stop confirm, queued/stale/lost banners, `?log=`, queue table, kind panels + trace picker, host:path copy, checkpoints, placement, scores by metric@version, notes) — see the mapping below.
3. R6 replaces `pages/Overview.tsx` with `ui/src/home/*` (status strip, Running now, Hosts, Tasks with best-over-time, Recent runs with "Open stderr") and an `EmptyHome` for a fresh install; it needs one backend addition to `GET /overview` (specified below for the backend planner; the UI degrades gracefully without it).
4. R7 adds `/hosts` and `/queue` as full pages (GPU cells per host, connect/disconnect/reload, queued runs per host with a confirmed Stop).
5. R8 restyles the kept pages (Examples, ViewEditor, LaunchDialog, CommandPalette with run display names, AuthGate, toasts) to v5 tokens and chrome; no behaviour change except the palette searching run names.

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-hypothex-ui-v5-design.md` §2, §4.1, §4.3, §4.4, §5. Mockup:
`docs/mockups/ui-v5/index.html` (`renderRun`, `runTitle`, `strip`, `fileIcon`, `renderHome`,
`renderHomeEmpty`, CSS `.rhead .rbody .tiles .rank .files .rside .prop .chg .kpis .hostrow .gpus`).

**Requests to the backend planner (B):**

1. `TaskRuns.metric_versions: {metric: version}` — the task's current version per metric
   (from the leaderboard's `metric_versions`). UI type: `metric_versions?: Record<string, string>`
   (added by R2 as optional; without it the UI takes the newest version among the run's scores).
2. `GET /api/v1/overview` additions in `src/hypothex/core/overview.py` (existing fields
   unchanged; all new fields have defaults so old clients and tests keep working):

```python
class RecentRun(BaseModel):
    """One of the newest runs for Home's Recent runs table."""
    run_id: str
    project: str
    task: str | None
    name: str                 # run view name, see `names`
    status: RunStatus
    end_reason: str | None
    exit_code: int | None
    created_at: datetime
    created_by: str
    hypothesis: str
    primary: float | None     # the run's primary score at the task's current version (TaskRun.primary)
    delta_best: float | None  # primary - best config mean of the task (board.rows[0].primary.mean)

class RunProgress(BaseModel):
    """How far a running run is, for Home's Running now table."""
    progress: float | None    # same rule as TaskRun.progress (share one helper in core/taskruns.py)
    metric: str | None        # first logged metric named <primary metric> or ending in /<primary metric>
    value: float | None       # its last logged value
    eta_seconds: float | None # elapsed * (1 - p) / p when 0 < p < 1, else None

# ProjectRow gains:
primary: str = ""                      # board.primary, e.g. "accuracy/value"
higher_is_better: bool = True          # board.higher_is_better
best_7d_ago: float | None = None       # running best among configs whose time < now - 7 days
best_history: list[float] = []         # running best after each scored config in time order, last 24
running: int = 0                       # active runs of the task with status running
queued: int = 0                        # ... with status queued
# OverviewSummary gains:
recent: list[RecentRun] = []           # 12 newest unarchived, non-queued runs of ANY age (one SQL
                                       # ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12), newest first
names: dict[str, str] = {}             # run view name of every run in running, failures, recent:
                                       # run.name if set, else derive_names(task runs)[id] + " · seed N"
                                       # (seed only when not None); no task: group_label(...)
progress: dict[str, RunProgress] = {}  # keyed by run id, for every running run
```
   "Config time" = the latest `created_at` among the config's runs (one bounded index
   query for the board rows' run ids). Tests in `tests/core/test_overview.py`: recent is
   capped and newest first, names use renames and seeds, best_history/best_7d_ago for a
   higher- and a lower-is-better task, progress/eta for a running run. The UI types are
   added as optional fields by R6.

**Requests to Part 3 (T):** export `DEFAULT_SELECTION` from `task/useRunSelection.ts`
(the run page colours a run by its group's index in that selection, so its swatch matches
the Task page opened without search params).

```tsx
// ui/test/run/RunName.test.tsx
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { cleanup, fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { RunName, nameProblem, nameToSend, runTitle, withSeed } from "../../src/run/RunName";
import { RUN_SVM, makeRecord } from "../pages/fixtures";
import { HttpReply, mockApi, renderWithClient, restoreFetch } from "../pages/helpers";

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  restoreFetch();
});

const NAME_ROUTE = `POST /api/v1/runs/${RUN_SVM}/name`;
const PROPS = { runId: RUN_SVM, display: "model svm · seed 3", derived: "model svm · seed 3", renamed: false };

describe("names", () => {
  test("withSeed appends the seed in run views", () => {
    expect(withSeed("lr 3e-4 · beam 10", 2)).toBe("lr 3e-4 · beam 10 · seed 2");
    expect(withSeed("db v3", null)).toBe("db v3");
  });

  test("runTitle: a rename shows as typed; the derived name carries the seed", () => {
    const run = { name: "svm, tuned C", derived_name: "model svm", renamed: true, seed: 3 };
    expect(runTitle(run, makeRecord())).toEqual({ display: "svm, tuned C", derived: "model svm · seed 3", renamed: true });
    expect(runTitle({ ...run, name: "model svm", renamed: false }, makeRecord())).toEqual({
      display: "model svm · seed 3",
      derived: "model svm · seed 3",
      renamed: false,
    });
  });

  test("runTitle without the task's runs: the record's name, else the hypothesis clause", () => {
    expect(runTitle(null, makeRecord()).display).toBe("RBF-kernel SVM · seed 3");
    expect(runTitle(null, makeRecord({ name: "mine" }))).toEqual({
      display: "mine",
      derived: "RBF-kernel SVM · seed 3",
      renamed: true,
    });
    expect(runTitle(null, makeRecord({ hypothesis: "", seed: null })).display).toBe("run 6f71");
  });

  test("nameProblem and nameToSend", () => {
    expect(nameProblem("a\nb")).toBe("One line only");
    expect(nameProblem("x".repeat(81))).toBe("At most 80 characters");
    expect(nameProblem("  ok  ")).toBeNull();
    expect(nameToSend("   ", "model svm · seed 3")).toBeNull();
    expect(nameToSend("model svm · seed 3", "model svm · seed 3")).toBeNull();
    expect(nameToSend("  svm, tuned C ", "model svm · seed 3")).toBe("svm, tuned C");
  });
});

describe("RunName", () => {
  test("click, type, Enter: the new name shows at once and is posted", async () => {
    let release!: () => void;
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      release = resolve;
    });
    const calls = mockApi({
      [NAME_ROUTE]: async () => {
        await gate;
        return makeRecord({ name: "svm, tuned C" });
      },
    });
    renderWithClient(<RunName {...PROPS} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("model svm · seed 3"));
    const input = screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" }) as HTMLInputElement;
    expect(input.value).toBe("model svm · seed 3");
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: "svm, tuned C" } });
    fireEvent.keyDown(input, { key: "Enter" });
    expect(screen.getByText("svm, tuned C")).toBeTruthy();
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(calls[0]?.body).toMatchObject({ name: "svm, tuned C" });
    release();
  });

  test("the pencil opens the editor; Escape and Cancel close it without a request", () => {
    const calls = mockApi({});
    renderWithClient(<RunName {...PROPS} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }));
    fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" }), { key: "Escape" });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" })).toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));
    expect(screen.queryByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" })).toBeNull();
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  test("saving the unchanged name sends nothing", () => {
    const calls = mockApi({});
    renderWithClient(<RunName {...PROPS} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
    expect(screen.queryByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" })).toBeNull();
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  test("Reset name posts null and shows the derived name; only a renamed run offers it", async () => {
    const calls = mockApi({ [NAME_ROUTE]: makeRecord() });
    const view = renderWithClient(<RunName {...PROPS} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }));
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Reset name" })).toBeNull();
    view.unmount();
    renderWithClient(<RunName {...PROPS} display="svm, tuned C" renamed />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Reset name" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("model svm · seed 3")).toBeTruthy();

  test("a refused name goes back and shows the server's reason", async () => {
    mockApi({ [NAME_ROUTE]: new HttpReply(422, { error: "name has a newline", type: "ValueError" }) });
    renderWithClient(<RunName {...PROPS} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("model svm · seed 3"));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" }), { target: { value: "new" } });
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
    expect((await screen.findByRole("alert")).textContent).toBe("name has a newline");
    expect(screen.getByText("model svm · seed 3")).toBeTruthy();

  test("too long a name is refused before any request and the editor stays open", () => {
    const calls = mockApi({});
    renderWithClient(<RunName {...PROPS} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }));
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" }), { target: { value: "x".repeat(81) } });
    fireEvent.keyDown(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" }), { key: "Enter" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("alert").textContent).toBe("At most 80 characters");
    expect(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" })).toBeTruthy();

  test('editOn="dblclick": one click on the text does not edit, a double click does', () => {

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("model svm · seed 3"));

    fireEvent.doubleClick(screen.getByText("model svm · seed 3"));
    expect(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" })).toBeTruthy();
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/RunName.tsx
/**
 * A run's name with inline rename (spec 5.2): the name, a pencil to rename, and while
 * editing an input with Save, Cancel and, for a renamed run, Reset name. Enter saves,
 * Escape cancels. The new name shows at once and goes back if the server refuses it.
 */
import { type KeyboardEvent, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { RunRecord, TaskRun } from "../api/models";
import { useRenameRun } from "../api/queries";
import { Icon } from "../chrome/Icon";
import { firstClause, shortId } from "../pages/components/format";
import "./run.css";

/** Longest name the API takes (spec 5.2). */
export const MAX_NAME = 80;

/** `name · seed 2` (run views); the name alone for a run without a seed. */
export function withSeed(name: string, seed: number | null | undefined): string {
  return seed === null || seed === undefined ? name : `${name} · seed ${seed}`;
}

export interface RunTitle {
  /** What the run is called now. */
  display: string;
  /** The derived name in the same form; Reset name restores it. */
  derived: string;
  renamed: boolean;
}

/**
 * The run views' name: a rename as typed, else the derived name with its seed. Without
 * the task's runs (no task, or still loading): the record's own name, else the first
 * clause of the hypothesis, else the short id, with the seed.
 */
export function runTitle(
  run: Pick<TaskRun, "name" | "derived_name" | "renamed" | "seed"> | null,
  record: Pick<RunRecord, "run_id" | "hypothesis" | "seed" | "name">,
): RunTitle {
  if (run) {
    const derived = withSeed(run.derived_name, run.seed);
    return run.renamed ? { display: run.name, derived, renamed: true } : { display: derived, derived, renamed: false };
  }
  const derived = withSeed(firstClause(record.hypothesis, `run ${shortId(record.run_id)}`), record.seed);
  const own = record.name?.trim();
  return own ? { display: own, derived, renamed: true } : { display: derived, derived, renamed: false };
}

/** Why `text` cannot be a name, or null (an empty text is a reset, not a problem). */
export function nameProblem(text: string): string | null {
  if (/[\r\n]/.test(text)) return "One line only";
  if (text.trim().length > MAX_NAME) return `At most ${MAX_NAME} characters`;
  return null;
}

/** The name to send: null resets (empty, or the derived name typed back). */
export function nameToSend(typed: string, derived: string): string | null {
  const v = typed.trim();
  return v === "" || v === derived ? null : v;
}

export interface RunNameProps {
  runId: string;
  display: string;
  derived: string;
  renamed: boolean;
  /** What on the text starts editing: "click" (run header) or "dblclick" (list rows). The pencil always does. */
  editOn?: "click" | "dblclick";
  className?: string;
}

interface Shown {
  display: string;
  renamed: boolean;
}

export function RunName({ runId, display, derived, renamed, editOn = "click", className }: RunNameProps) {
  const rename = useRenameRun();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState(display);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  // new server data replaces the optimistic name
  useEffect(() => setShown(null), [display, renamed]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing) return;
    input.current?.focus();
    input.current?.select();
  }, [editing]);
  const current: Shown = shown ?? { display, renamed };
  const cls = (extra: string) => ["run-name", extra, className].filter(Boolean).join(" ");

  const start = () => {
    setText(current.display);
    setError(null);
    setEditing(true);
  };
  const cancel = () => {
    setEditing(false);
    setError(null);
  };
  const send = (name: string | null) => {
    const before = current;
    setShown(name === null ? { display: derived, renamed: false } : { display: name, renamed: true });
    setEditing(false);
    setError(null);
    rename.mutate(
      { runId, name },
      {
        onError: (err) => {
          setShown(before);
          setError(err.message);
        },
      },
    );
  };
  const save = () => {
    const problem = nameProblem(text);
    if (problem) {
      setError(problem);
      return;
    }
    const name = nameToSend(text, derived);
    const unchanged = name === null ? !current.renamed : current.renamed && name === current.display;
    if (unchanged) cancel();
    else send(name);
  };
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      save();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      cancel();
    }
  };

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <span className={cls("editing")}>
        <input
          ref={input}
          className="rename"
          aria-label="Run name"
          value={text}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={onKey}
        />
        <button type="button" className="btn sm primary" onClick={save}>
          Save
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="btn sm" onClick={cancel}>
          Cancel
        </button>
        {current.renamed ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn sm ghost" onClick={() => send(null)}>
            Reset name
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {error ? (
          <span className="rename-err" role="alert">
            {error}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </span>
    );
  }
  const open = editOn === "click" ? { onClick: start } : { onDoubleClick: start };
  return (
    <span className={cls("")}>
      <span className="rn-t" {...open}>
        {current.display}
      </span>
      <button type="button" className="pen" aria-label="Rename" title="Rename" onClick={start}>
        <Icon name="edit" />
      </button>
      {error ? (
        <span className="rename-err" role="alert">
          {error}
        </span>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```ts
// ui/test/run/taskRunsFixtures.ts
/**
 * `GET /tasks/toy-classifier/toy-test/runs` for the run page tests, consistent with
 * ../pages/fixtures.ts: the SVM config (RUN_SVM is seed 3, the best seed of the best
 * config) and the RF config, three seeds each.
 */
import type { Stats, TaskGroup, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../../src/api/models";
import { RUN_RF, RUN_SVM } from "../pages/fixtures";

export const SVM_GROUP = "63c2ec5f@8f4cac4";
export const RF_GROUP = "5a810ddb@2bbf5a3";
export const SVM_SIBLINGS = ["20260926-210302-toy-test-e294", "20260926-210304-toy-test-03bb"] as const;
export const RF_SIBLINGS = ["20260926-210028-toy-test-b5c4", "20260926-210030-toy-test-2e66"] as const;
const TASK_RUNS = "GET /api/v1/tasks/toy-classifier/toy-test/runs";

export function taskRun(over: Partial<TaskRun> & { run_id: string }): TaskRun {
  return {
    name: "model svm",
    derived_name: "model svm",
    renamed: false,
    group_id: SVM_GROUP,
    seed: 1,
    status: "finished",
    end_reason: null,
    exit_code: 0,
    created_by: "agent:acceptance",
    created_at: "2026-09-26T21:03:02Z",
    started_at: "2026-09-26T21:03:02Z",
    ended_at: "2026-09-26T21:03:03Z",
    host: "mbp.local",
    params: { model: "svm" },
    tags: [],
    archived: false,
    starred: false,
    sweep_id: null,
    scores: {},
    primary: null,
    progress: null,
    gpu_hours: null,
    cost_usd: null,
    ...over,
  };
}

function scored(run_id: string, seed: number, acc: number, f1: number, created_at: string, rf = false): TaskRun {
  return taskRun({
    run_id,
    seed,
    created_at,
    scores: { "accuracy/value": acc, "macro_f1/value": f1 },
    primary: acc,
    ...(rf ? { name: "model rf", derived_name: "model rf", group_id: RF_GROUP, params: { model: "rf" }, created_by: "human" } : {}),
  });
}

const mean = (v: number[]): number => v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length;
const sd = (v: number[]): number => Math.sqrt(v.reduce((a, x) => a + (x - mean(v)) ** 2, 0) / (v.length - 1));

function group(id: string, name: string, members: TaskRun[], lo: number, hi: number, best: boolean): TaskGroup {
  const acc = members.map((r) => r.primary ?? 0);
  const f1 = members.map((r) => r.scores["macro_f1/value"] ?? 0);
  const primary: Stats = { mean: mean(acc), std: sd(acc), n: acc.length, ci_low: null, ci_high: null };
  return {
    group_id: id,
    name,
    run_ids: members.map((r) => r.run_id),
    n: members.length,
    primary,
    test_interval: { lo, hi, method: "wilson", n: 180 },
    scores: { "accuracy/value": mean(acc), "macro_f1/value": mean(f1) },
    seed_values: acc,
    within_noise_of_best: !best,
    vs_best: null,
    is_best: best,
  };
}

export function makeTaskRuns(over: Partial<TaskRuns> = {}): TaskRuns {
  const runs = [
    scored(SVM_SIBLINGS[0], 1, 0.88, 0.92, "2026-09-26T21:03:02Z"),
    scored(SVM_SIBLINGS[1], 2, 0.89, 0.923, "2026-09-26T21:03:04Z"),
    scored(RUN_SVM, 3, 0.9222222222222223, 0.9224758529636579, "2026-09-26T21:03:06Z"),
    scored(RF_SIBLINGS[0], 1, 0.8833333333333333, 0.88, "2026-09-26T21:00:28Z", true),
    scored(RF_SIBLINGS[1], 2, 0.8777777777777778, 0.87, "2026-09-26T21:00:30Z", true),
    scored(RUN_RF, 3, 0.8944444444444445, 0.89, "2026-09-26T21:00:32Z", true),
  ];
  return {
    project: "toy-classifier",
    task: "toy-test",
    kind: "generic",
    primary: "accuracy/value",
    higher_is_better: true,
    unit: "",
    value_format: "fraction",
    varying_keys: ["model"],
    metric_names: ["train_accuracy"],
    score_keys: ["accuracy/value", "macro_f1/value"],
    key_parts: null,
    metric_versions: { accuracy: "v1", macro_f1: "v1" },
    runs,
    groups: [
      group(SVM_GROUP, "model svm", runs.slice(0, 3), 0.874, 0.953, true),
      group(RF_GROUP, "model rf", runs.slice(3), 0.83, 0.924, false),
    ],
    ...over,
  };
}

/** mockApi routes for the task runs, whether or not the client sends `archived=false`. */
export function taskRunsRoutes(body: TaskRuns = makeTaskRuns(), archived = false): Record<string, unknown> {
  return archived
    ? { [`${TASK_RUNS}?archived=true`]: body }
    : { [TASK_RUNS]: body, [`${TASK_RUNS}?archived=false`]: body };
}
```

```ts
    compareHref: undefined,
    example: undefined,
    log: null,
    ...over,
  };

/** Text of a sidebar property's value, by its label. */
export function propValue(label: string): string | null {
  const row = [...document.querySelectorAll(".rside .prop")].find((r) => r.querySelector(".k")?.textContent === label);
  return row?.querySelector(".v")?.textContent ?? null;
```

```ts
// ui/test/run/runContext.test.ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { colorFor } from "../../src/lib/color";
import { asLogStream, asRunTab, compareTarget, exampleTargets, runIdentity, shownTab } from "../../src/run/runContext";
import { DEFAULT_SELECTION, visibleIdentities } from "../../src/task/useRunSelection";
import { RUN_RF, RUN_SVM } from "../pages/fixtures";
import { RF_GROUP, SVM_GROUP, SVM_SIBLINGS, makeTaskRuns } from "./taskRunsFixtures";

describe("tabs", () => {
  test("only known tabs and log streams pass (values come from the URL)", () => {
    expect(asRunTab("files")).toBe("files");
    expect(asRunTab("view:x")).toBeNull();
    expect(asLogStream("stderr")).toBe("stderr");
    expect(asLogStream("../etc/passwd")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("shownTab: ?tab= wins, an old ?log= link opens Logs, else Overview", () => {
    expect(shownTab("charts", "stderr")).toBe("charts");
    expect(shownTab(undefined, "stderr")).toBe("logs");
    expect(shownTab("nope", undefined)).toBe("overview");
  });
});

describe("runIdentity", () => {
  test("the run's group colour is its index in the Task page's default selection", () => {
    const data = makeTaskRuns();
    const id = runIdentity(data, RUN_SVM);
    expect(id.group?.group_id).toBe(SVM_GROUP);
    expect(id.siblings.map((r) => r.run_id)).toEqual([...SVM_SIBLINGS]);
    expect(id.color).toBe(colorFor(SVM_GROUP, visibleIdentities(DEFAULT_SELECTION, data)));
    expect(id.color).not.toBe("var(--c0)");
  });

  test("a run missing from the task's runs is neutral grey", () => {
    expect(runIdentity(makeTaskRuns(), "other").color).toBe("var(--c0)");
    expect(runIdentity(null, RUN_SVM)).toEqual({ run: null, group: null, siblings: [], color: "var(--c0)" });
  });
});

describe("examples targets", () => {
  test("other scored configs, best first, each by its newest run", () => {
    const data = makeTaskRuns();
    expect(exampleTargets(data, RUN_SVM).map((t) => [t.groupId, t.runId, t.name])).toEqual([[RF_GROUP, RUN_RF, "model rf"]]);
    expect(compareTarget(data, RUN_SVM)).toBe(RUN_RF);
    expect(compareTarget(data, RUN_RF)).toBe(RUN_SVM);
  });

  test("lower-is-better tasks rank the smallest mean first; no other config gives null", () => {
    const data = makeTaskRuns({ higher_is_better: false });
    expect(compareTarget(data, RUN_SVM)).toBe(RUN_RF);
    expect(compareTarget({ ...data, groups: data.groups.slice(0, 1) }, RUN_SVM)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
  };
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/run/useArmed.ts
/** A two-click confirm: the first click arms, a second within `ms` acts (spec 4.3 Stop). */
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export const ARM_MS = 3000;

/** `armed` resets when any of `resetKeys` changes, and `ms` after it was armed. */
export function useArmed(resetKeys: readonly unknown[], ms: number = ARM_MS): { armed: boolean; arm: () => void; disarm: () => void } {
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState(false);
  const key = JSON.stringify(resetKeys);
  useEffect(() => {
    setArmed(false);
  }, [key]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!armed) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setArmed(false), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [armed, ms]);
  return { armed, arm: () => setArmed(true), disarm: () => setArmed(false) };
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/run/runContext.ts
/**
 * What the run page knows about one run (built once in RunPage, read by every tab and the
 * sidebar), and the pure rules behind it: tabs from the URL, the run's identity colour in
 * its task (principle 1), and which run the Examples page compares it with.
 */
import type { HostRow, RunDetail, RunRecord, TaskGroup, TaskKindInfo, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { colorFor } from "../lib/color";
import type { RunPhase } from "../pages/components/remote";
import { DEFAULT_SELECTION, visibleIdentities } from "../task/useRunSelection";
import type { RunTitle } from "./RunName";

export const LOG_STREAMS = ["stdout", "stderr", "supervisor"] as const;
export type LogStream = (typeof LOG_STREAMS)[number];

/** Accept only the log streams the API serves (the value comes from the URL). */
export function asLogStream(value: unknown): LogStream | null {
  return LOG_STREAMS.find((s) => s === value) ?? null;
}

export const RUN_TABS = ["overview", "charts", "logs", "files", "examples"] as const;
export type RunTab = (typeof RUN_TABS)[number];
export const RUN_TAB_LABELS: Record<RunTab, string> = {
  overview: "Overview",
  charts: "Charts",
  logs: "Logs",
  files: "Files",
  examples: "Examples",
};

export function asRunTab(value: unknown): RunTab | null {
  return RUN_TABS.find((t) => t === value) ?? null;
}

/** The tab to show: `?tab=`, else Logs for an old `?log=` link (failures, Where), else Overview. */
export function shownTab(tab: unknown, log: unknown): RunTab {
  return asRunTab(tab) ?? (asLogStream(log) ? "logs" : "overview");
}

export interface RunIdentity {
  run: TaskRun | null;
  group: TaskGroup | null;
  /** The other runs of the run's config (its seeds), in the task's list order. */
  siblings: TaskRun[];
  /** `var(--cN)` of the run's config in the Task page's default selection; `var(--c0)` otherwise. */
  color: string;
}

export const NO_IDENTITY: RunIdentity = { run: null, group: null, siblings: [], color: "var(--c0)" };

export function runIdentity(data: TaskRuns | null | undefined, runId: string): RunIdentity {
  const run = data?.runs.find((r) => r.run_id === runId) ?? null;
  if (!data || !run) return NO_IDENTITY;
  return {
    run,
    group: data.groups.find((g) => g.group_id === run.group_id) ?? null,
    siblings: data.runs.filter((r) => r.group_id === run.group_id && r.run_id !== runId),
    color: colorFor(run.group_id, visibleIdentities(DEFAULT_SELECTION, data)),
  };
}

export interface ExampleTarget {
  runId: string;
  groupId: string;
  name: string;
  primary: number;
  color: string;
}

/** Other scored configs of the task, best first in the primary's direction, each by its newest run. */
export function exampleTargets(data: TaskRuns | null | undefined, runId: string): ExampleTarget[] {
  const me = data?.runs.find((r) => r.run_id === runId);
  if (!data || !me) return [];
  const visible = visibleIdentities(DEFAULT_SELECTION, data);
  const sign = data.higher_is_better ? -1 : 1;
  return data.groups
    .filter((g) => g.group_id !== me.group_id && g.primary !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => sign * ((a.primary?.mean ?? 0) - (b.primary?.mean ?? 0)))
    .flatMap((g) => {
      const newest = data.runs
        .filter((r) => r.group_id === g.group_id)
        .sort((a, b) => b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at))[0];
      return newest
        ? [{ runId: newest.run_id, groupId: g.group_id, name: g.name, primary: g.primary?.mean ?? 0, color: colorFor(g.group_id, visible) }]
        : [];
    });
}

/** The header's Compare target: the best other config's newest run. */
export function compareTarget(data: TaskRuns | null | undefined, runId: string): string | null {
  return exampleTargets(data, runId)[0]?.runId ?? null;
}

export interface RunContext {
  runId: string;
  detail: RunDetail;
  record: RunRecord;
  phase: RunPhase;
  /** The hosts row serving a remote run (`runHostRow`); null for a hub run or without the list. */
  host: HostRow | null;
  hostsLoaded: boolean;
  /** The run lives on a remote host (`host_state` set) or on an environment no host serves. */
  remote: boolean;
  now: number;
  lostWhy: string | null;
  hubEnvId: string | null;
  taskRuns: TaskRuns | null;
  identity: RunIdentity;
  title: RunTitle;
  kind: TaskKindInfo | null;
  kindError: unknown;
  inferStage: boolean | undefined;
  /** Examples link for Compare; null: no other config yet; undefined: the run has no task. */
  compareHref: string | null | undefined;
  example: string | undefined;
  log: LogStream | null;
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/RunHeader.tsx
/** Run header (spec 4.3, mockup .rhead): swatch, name, status pill, actions, hypothesis, banners, tabs. */
import type { RunStatus } from "../api/models";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { RunActions } from "../pages/components/RunActions";
import { StateBanner } from "../pages/components/StateBanner";
import { RUN_TABS, RUN_TAB_LABELS, type RunContext, type RunTab } from "./runContext";
import { RunName } from "./RunName";

const WORD: Record<RunStatus | "stale", string> = {
  queued: "Queued",
  running: "Running",
  finished: "Finished",
  failed: "Failed",
  killed: "Killed",
  lost: "Lost",
  stale: "Stale",
};

/** The pill's state: a run on an unreachable host is stale (derived on the hub), else its status. */
export function pillState(ctx: Pick<RunContext, "phase" | "record">): RunStatus | "stale" {
  return ctx.phase === "stale" ? "stale" : ctx.record.status;
}

export function RunHeader({ ctx, tab }: { ctx: RunContext; tab: RunTab }) {
  const { record, title } = ctx;
  const state = pillState(ctx);
  return (
    <header className="rhead">
      <div className="rhead-top">
        <span className="sw lg" data-color={ctx.identity.color} style={{ background: ctx.identity.color }} aria-hidden="true" />
        <h1>
          <RunName runId={ctx.runId} display={title.display} derived={title.derived} renamed={title.renamed} />
        </h1>
        <span className={`pill ${state}`}>
          <StatusIcon status={state} />
          {WORD[state]}
        </span>
        <span className="sp" />
        <RunActions
          record={record}
          phase={ctx.phase}
          hostName={ctx.host?.name ?? null}
          served={ctx.detail.served === true}
          hostsLoaded={ctx.hostsLoaded}
          inferStage={ctx.inferStage}
          compareHref={ctx.compareHref}
        />
      </div>
      {record.hypothesis ? <p className="rhyp">{record.hypothesis}</p> : null}
      {title.renamed ? <p className="rderived">{`Renamed. Derived name: ${title.derived}`}</p> : null}
      <StateBanner
        record={record}
        phase={ctx.phase}
        host={ctx.host}
        conn={ctx.detail.host_state ?? null}
        now={ctx.now}
        reason={ctx.lostWhy}
      />
      <nav className="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Run">
        {RUN_TABS.map((t) => (
          <AppLink
            key={t}
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={t === tab}
            className={t === tab ? "on" : undefined}
            href={hrefs.run(ctx.runId, { tab: t })}
          >
            {RUN_TAB_LABELS[t]}
          </AppLink>
        ))}
      </nav>
    </header>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/RunPage.tsx
/**
 * Run page (spec 4.3): header with the run's identity colour, name, status, actions and
 * tabs; the tab's main column; the properties sidebar (R4). Tabs live in `?tab=`; an old
 * `?log=` link opens the Logs tab on that stream; `?example=` picks a trace.
 */
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import { useLostReason } from "../api/lostReasons";
import { HOSTS_REFETCH_MS, useHosts, useHubEnvironment, useRun, useTask, useTaskKind, useTaskRuns } from "../api/queries";
import { useNow } from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { runHostRow, runPhase } from "../pages/components/remote";
import { RunHeader } from "./RunHeader";
import { type RunContext, type RunTab, asLogStream, compareTarget, runIdentity, shownTab } from "./runContext";
import { runTitle } from "./RunName";
import "./run.css";

/** Clock tick of an unfinished run: its elapsed times move even when a poll returns the same data. */
export const RUN_CLOCK_MS = 10_000;

export interface RunPageProps {
  runId: string;
  tab?: string;
  log?: string;
  example?: string;
  clockMs?: number;
}

export function RunPage({ runId, tab, log, example, clockMs = RUN_CLOCK_MS }: RunPageProps) {
  const run = useRun(runId);
  const lostWhy = useLostReason(runId);
  const record = run.data?.record;
  const project = record?.project ?? "";
  const task = record?.task ?? "";
  const hasTask = task !== "";
  const taskRuns = useTaskRuns(project, task, { archived: record?.archived === true, enabled: hasTask });
  const kind = useTaskKind(project, task, { enabled: hasTask });
  const taskDetail = useTask(project, task, { enabled: hasTask });
  // an unserved environment needs host lookup even without a connection state
  const remote = (run.data?.host_state ?? null) !== null || run.data?.served === false;
  const hosts = useHosts(HOSTS_REFETCH_MS, remote);
  const hubEnv = useHubEnvironment({ enabled: Boolean(record?.sweep_id) });
  const now = useNow(clockMs, record !== undefined && record.ended_at === null);

  if (run.error) {
    const missing = run.error instanceof ApiError && run.error.status === 404;
    return (
      <div className="run-page">
        <header className="rhead">
          {missing ? (
            <>
              <h1>Not found</h1>
              <p className="rhyp">
                <AppLink href={hrefs.overview()}>Home</AppLink>
              </p>
            </>
          ) : null}
          <ErrorBox error={run.error} />
        </header>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!run.data || !record) {
    return (
      <div className="run-page">
        <Loading />
      </div>
    );
  }
  const detail = run.data;
  const data = taskRuns.data ?? null;
  const identity = runIdentity(data, runId);
  const hubEnvId = hubEnv.data?.environment_id;
  const other = hasTask ? compareTarget(data, runId) : null;
  const ctx: RunContext = {
    runId,
    detail,
    record,
    phase: runPhase(detail),
    host: runHostRow(detail, hosts.data),
    hostsLoaded: hosts.data !== undefined,
    remote,
    now,
    lostWhy,
    hubEnvId: typeof hubEnvId === "string" ? hubEnvId : null,
    taskRuns: data,
    identity,
    title: runTitle(identity.run, record),
    kind: kind.data ?? null,
    kindError: kind.error ?? null,
    inferStage: !hasTask ? false : taskDetail.isSuccess ? Object.hasOwn(taskDetail.data.stages, "infer") : undefined,
    compareHref: !hasTask ? undefined : other ? hrefs.examples(other, runId) : null,
    example,
    log: asLogStream(log),
  };
  const current = shownTab(tab, log);
  return (
    <div className="run-page" style={{ "--rc": identity.color } as CSSProperties}>
      <RunHeader ctx={ctx} tab={current} />
      <div className="rbody">
        <RunTabBody ctx={ctx} tab={current} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The main column of one tab; R3 and R5 fill in the tabs. */
function RunTabBody({ ctx, tab }: { ctx: RunContext; tab: RunTab }) {
  return <div className="rmain" data-tab={tab} data-run={ctx.runId} />;
}
```

`ui/src/pages/components/RunActions.tsx` (whole file):

```tsx
/**
 * Run actions (spec 4.3, 8A.8): Compare and Rerun in the run header; Re-infer,
 * Re-evaluate, Stop (two clicks within 3 s) and Archive in a ⋯ menu. Each sends a
 * command_id. A run waiting in a queue can only be cancelled; a run on an unreachable
 * host offers Reconnect; a lost run makes Rerun the main action.
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../../api/client";
import type { EvalReport } from "../../api/models";
import { HOST_EVENT_INVALIDATES, REMOTE_RUN_INVALIDATES, RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES } from "../../api/queries";
import { Icon } from "../../chrome/Icon";
import { useArmed } from "../../run/useArmed";
import { AppLink, hrefs, useNavigateHref } from "./links";
import { ErrorBox } from "./QueryState";
import { ReevalSummary } from "./ReevalSummary";
import type { RunPhase } from "./remote";
import { ACTIVE_STATUSES, type HostState, type RunRecord, type RunRef } from "./types";
import { useAction } from "./useAction";

export interface RunActionsProps {
  record: RunRecord;
  phase?: RunPhase;
  /** Authoritative routing availability from RunDetail, independent of connection state. */
  served: boolean;
  hostsLoaded?: boolean;
  /**
   * The hub's name for the run's host (`runHostRow(...)?.name`); null for a hub run or while
   * the hosts list is not loaded. Never `executor.host` (the machine's hostname).
   */
  hostName?: string | null;
  /** Only a successfully loaded task with an infer stage enables Re-infer. */
  inferStage?: boolean;
  /** Examples page link; null: no other config (disabled); undefined: no Compare button. */
  compareHref?: string | null;
}

/** Close a popover on Escape or a press outside `ref`. */
function useDismiss(open: boolean, close: () => void, ref: { current: HTMLElement | null }): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) close();
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") close();
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    };
  }, [open, close, ref]);
}

export function RunActions({
  record,
  phase = "local",
  hostName = null,
  served,
  hostsLoaded = false,
  inferStage,
  compareHref,
}: RunActionsProps) {
  const navigate = useNavigateHref();
  const id = record.run_id;
  const label = hostName ?? record.host;
  const refresh = phase === "local" ? RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES : REMOTE_RUN_INVALIDATES;
  const openNew = (made: RunRef) => navigate(hrefs.run(made.run_id));
  const rerun = useAction<RunRef>({ send: (_: void, opts) => api.rerun(id, opts), invalidate: refresh, onSuccess: openNew });
  const reinfer = useAction<RunRef>({
    send: (_: void, opts) => api.reinfer(id, undefined, opts),
    invalidate: refresh,
    onSuccess: openNew,
  });
  const [report, setReport] = useState<{ runId: string; value: EvalReport } | null>(null);
  const reeval = useAction({
    send: async (_: void, opts) => {
      const runId = id;
      return { runId, value: await api.reevalRun(runId, {}, opts) };
    },
    invalidate: refresh,
    onSuccess: setReport,
  });
  const stop = useAction({
    send: (onlyQueued: boolean, opts) => (onlyQueued ? api.cancelQueuedRun(id, opts) : api.stop(id, opts)),
    invalidate: refresh,
  });
  const reconnect = useAction<HostState>({
    send: (_: void, opts) => api.connectHost(hostName ?? "", opts),
    invalidate: HOST_EVENT_INVALIDATES,
  });
  const archive = useAction({
    send: (on: boolean, opts) => api.archiveRun(id, on, opts),
    invalidate: [...refresh, ["taskRuns"]],
  });
  const active = ACTIVE_STATUSES.has(record.status);
  const { armed, arm, disarm } = useArmed([id, record.status, served, phase]);
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const close = useCallback(() => setMenu(false), []);
  useDismiss(menu, close, wrap);
  const unavailable = hostsLoaded
    ? "No configured host serves this run's environment"
    : "The hosts list is not loaded; this run's serving host is unknown";
  const error = rerun.error ?? reinfer.error ?? reeval.error ?? stop.error ?? reconnect.error ?? archive.error;
  const waiting = phase === "queued" || phase === "pending";
  const lost = phase === "lost";
  return (
    <div className="run-actions">
      <div className="actions">
        {waiting ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn primary"
            disabled={!served || stop.pending}
            onClick={() => stop.run(true)}
            title={
              !served ? unavailable : phase === "pending" && record.executor.slurm_job_id
                ? `Cancel SLURM job ${record.executor.slurm_job_id}`
                : `Remove from the ${label} queue`
            }
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
        ) : phase === "stale" ? (
          <>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn primary"
              disabled={!served || reconnect.pending || hostName === null}
              onClick={() => {
                if (hostName !== null) reconnect.run();
              }}
              title={
                !served ? unavailable : hostName === null
                  ? hostsLoaded ? unavailable : `The hosts list is not loaded, so the hub's name for ${record.host} is unknown`
                  : `Try ${hostName} again now`
              }
            >
              Reconnect
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="btn" disabled title={!served ? unavailable : `${label} is unreachable`}>
              Stop
            </button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            {compareHref === undefined ? null : compareHref ? (
              <AppLink className="btn" href={compareHref} title="Compare examples with the best other config">
                Compare
              </AppLink>
            ) : (
              <button type="button" className="btn" disabled title="No other scored config in this task">
                Compare
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              className={lost ? "btn primary" : "btn"}
              disabled={!served || rerun.pending}
              onClick={() => rerun.run()}
              title={!served ? unavailable : "Run again with the same command, code, and seed"}
            >
              Rerun
            </button>
            <div className="menu-wrap" ref={wrap}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn icon"
                aria-label="More actions"
                aria-haspopup="menu"
                aria-expanded={menu}
                title="Re-infer, re-evaluate, stop, archive"
                onClick={() => setMenu((open) => !open)}
              >
                <Icon name="more" />
              </button>
              {menu ? (
                <div className="menu" role="menu" aria-label="Run actions">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitem"
                    disabled={!served || reinfer.pending || inferStage !== true}
                    onClick={() => {
                      close();
                      reinfer.run();
                    }}
                    title={
                      !served ? unavailable : inferStage === true
                        ? "Run the infer stage again on this run's checkpoint"
                        : inferStage === false ? "Task has no infer stage" : "Infer stage not loaded"
                    }
                  >
                    Re-infer
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitem"
                    disabled={!served || reeval.pending}
                    onClick={() => {
                      close();
                      setReport(null);
                      reeval.run();
                    }}
                    title={!served ? unavailable : "Re-score saved predictions with the current metric versions"}
                  >
                    Re-evaluate
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitem"
                    disabled={!served || !active || stop.pending}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!served || !active || stop.pending) return;
                      if (armed) {
                        disarm();
                        close();
                        stop.run(false);
                      } else {
                        arm();
                      }
                    }}
                    onBlur={disarm}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Escape") disarm();
                    }}
                    title={!served ? unavailable : active ? (armed ? "Click again to stop this run" : "Stop this run") : "The run is not active"}
                  >
                    {armed ? "Stop ✓?" : "Stop"}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitem"
                    disabled={!served || archive.pending}
                    onClick={() => {
                      close();
                      archive.run(!record.archived);
                    }}
                    title={!served ? unavailable : record.archived ? "Show this run in lists again" : "Hide this run from lists; nothing is deleted"}
                  >
                    {record.archived ? "Unarchive" : "Archive"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {error ? <ErrorBox error={error} /> : null}
      {report?.runId === id ? <ReevalSummary report={report.value} /> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// ui/test/run/scores.test.ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import type { ScoreRecord } from "../../src/api/models";
import { currentVersions, meanSd, rankModel, scoreTiles } from "../../src/run/scores";
import { RUN_RF, RUN_SVM, makeDetail } from "../pages/fixtures";
import { SVM_SIBLINGS, makeTaskRuns } from "./taskRunsFixtures";

const data = makeTaskRuns();
const group = data.runs.filter((r) => r.group_id === data.runs.find((x) => x.run_id === RUN_SVM)?.group_id);
const ctx = { primary: "accuracy/value", higherIsBetter: true, versions: data.metric_versions ?? null, group };
const score = (over: Partial<ScoreRecord>): ScoreRecord => ({
  metric: "accuracy", version: "v1", key: "value", value: 0.5, error: null, source_hash: null, created_at: "2026-09-26T21:03:08Z", ...over,
});

describe("scoreTiles", () => {
  test("primary first and marked; Δ vs the config mean coloured outside one seed sd, muted inside", () => {
    const tiles = scoreTiles(makeDetail().scores, ctx);
    expect(tiles.map((t) => [t.label, t.primary, t.old])).toEqual([["accuracy@v1", true, false], ["macro_f1@v1", false, false]]);
    const [acc, f1] = tiles;
    expect(acc?.delta).toBeCloseTo(0.024815, 5);
    expect(acc?.sd).toBeCloseTo(0.022064, 5);
    expect([acc?.noise, acc?.better]).toEqual([false, true]);
    expect(f1?.delta).toBeCloseTo(0.000651, 5);
    expect([f1?.noise, f1?.better]).toEqual([true, null]);
  });

  test("old versions are marked and have no Δ; a failed score keeps its error; the * key is dropped", () => {
    const scores = [...makeDetail().scores, score({ version: "v0", value: 0.88 }), score({ metric: "f2", error: "boom", value: null }), score({ key: "*", error: "x", value: null })];
    const tiles = scoreTiles(scores, ctx);
    const old = tiles.find((t) => t.label === "accuracy@v0");
    expect([old?.old, old?.delta, old?.primary]).toEqual([true, null, false]);
    expect(tiles.at(-1)?.label).toBe("accuracy@v0");
    expect(tiles.find((t) => t.metric === "f2")?.error).toBe("boom");
    expect(tiles.some((t) => t.id.endsWith("/*"))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("without task versions the newest version per metric is current; a single seed has no Δ", () => {
    expect(currentVersions([score({ version: "v2" }), score({ version: "v10" })], null)).toEqual({ accuracy: "v10" });
    const lone = scoreTiles(makeDetail().scores, { ...ctx, versions: null, group: group.slice(2) });
    expect(lone[0]?.delta).toBeNull();
  });

  test("lower is better: a smaller value than the config mean is better", () => {
    const tiles = scoreTiles(makeDetail().scores, { ...ctx, higherIsBetter: false });
    expect(tiles[0]?.better).toBe(false);
  });

  test("meanSd uses the sample sd and needs two values", () => {
    expect(meanSd([1])).toBeNull();
    expect(meanSd([1, 3])).toEqual({ mean: 2, sd: Math.SQRT2 });
  });
});

describe("rankModel", () => {
  test("this run, its seeds, the other configs and the best band, with a one-line summary", () => {
    const rank = rankModel(data, RUN_SVM, "var(--c1)");
    expect(rank?.summary).toBe("1st of 3 seeds · config is best of 2");
    expect(rank?.band).toEqual([0.874, 0.953]);
    expect(rank?.marks.filter((m) => m.kind === "seed").map((m) => m.value)).toEqual([0.89, 0.88]);
    expect(rank?.marks.filter((m) => m.kind === "other")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(rank?.marks.at(-1)).toEqual({ kind: "this", value: 0.9222222222222223, color: "var(--c1)" });
    expect(rankModel(data, RUN_RF, "var(--c2)")?.summary).toBe("1st of 3 seeds · config is 2nd of 2");
    expect(rankModel(data, SVM_SIBLINGS[0], "var(--c1)")?.summary).toBe("3rd of 3 seeds · config is best of 2");
  });

  test("an unscored run has no strip", () => {
    const unscored = { ...data, runs: data.runs.map((r) => (r.run_id === RUN_SVM ? { ...r, primary: null } : r)) };
    expect(rankModel(unscored, RUN_SVM, "var(--c1)")).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
  expect(metricSections(["train/loss", "lr", "val/top1", "train/acc"])).toEqual([
    { title: "train", names: ["train/loss", "train/acc"] },
    { title: "Metrics", names: ["lr"] },
    { title: "val", names: ["val/top1"] },

test("curveSeries: this run in its colour and drawn last, seeds grey and faint", () => {
  const p = (name: string, step: number, value: number): MetricPoint => ({ name, step, value, t: null });
  const byRun = new Map([["me", [p("loss", 0, 2), p("loss", 1, 1), p("lr", 0, 1)]], ["s1", [p("loss", 0, 3)]], ["s2", [p("lr", 0, 1)]]]);

  expect(curveSeries(byRun, "loss", "me", "var(--c1)", labels)).toEqual([
    { id: "s1", label: "seed 1", color: "var(--c0)", points: [{ x: 0, y: 3 }], emphasis: "faint" },
    { id: "me", label: "this run", color: "var(--c1)", points: [{ x: 0, y: 2 }, { x: 1, y: 1 }], emphasis: "bold" },
  ]);
});
```

```tsx
// ui/test/run/KindSection.test.tsx — the old KindPanels behaviours, in v5 panels
import { afterEach, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { act, cleanup, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import type { PanelSpec } from "../../src/api/models";
import { KindSection, runPanelSpecs } from "../../src/run/KindSection";
import { fakeRegistry, mockApi, renderWithClient, restoreFetch } from "../pages/helpers";

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  restoreFetch();
});

const TRACES = [
  { example_id: "T-001", turns: 3, failed: false },
  { example_id: "T-014", turns: 13, failed: true },
];

function traceRoutes(example: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    "GET /api/v1/runs/R/traces": TRACES,
    [`GET /api/v1/runs/R/traces/${example}`]: {
      type: "trace",
      title: "",
      rows: Array.from({ length: example === "T-014" ? 13 : 3 }, (_, i) => ({ turn: i + 1 })),
      meta: { run_id: "R", example_id: example },
    },
  };
}

test("runPanelSpecs drops curves (the Charts tab draws step metrics)", () => {
  const kind = { kind: "agent_eval" as const, run_view: [{ type: "curves" as const, title: "metrics" }, { type: "trace" as const, title: "steps" }] };
  expect(runPanelSpecs(kind, 2, []).map((p) => [p.type, p.title])).toEqual([["trace", "Steps"]]);
  expect(runPanelSpecs(kind, 0, [])).toEqual([]);
  expect(runPanelSpecs(null, undefined, [])).toEqual([]);
});

test("scoped panels, and the trace panel shows the failed trace first with a picker", async () => {
  const calls = mockApi({
    ...traceRoutes("T-014"),
    "POST /api/v1/tasks/p/t/views/query": { panels: [{ type: "table", title: "Tokens per turn", rows: [{}, {}], meta: {} }] },
  });
  const specs: PanelSpec[] = [{ type: "table", title: "Tokens per turn", data: { source: "traces" } }, { type: "trace", title: "Trajectory" }];
  renderWithClient(<KindSection project="p" task="t" runId="R" specs={specs} />, { registry: fakeRegistry(["table", "trace"]) });
  expect((await screen.findByTestId("panel-table")).textContent).toBe("Tokens per turn:2");
  expect(await screen.findByText("Trajectory · T-014")).toBeTruthy();
  expect((await screen.findByTestId("panel-trace")).textContent).toBe(":13");
  const picker = screen.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Traced examples" });
  expect(picker.querySelector('a[aria-current="true"]')?.textContent).toBe("T-014");
  expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "T-001" }).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/r/R?example=T-001");
  const body = calls.find((c) => c.method === "POST")?.body as { view: { panels: PanelSpec[] } };
  expect(body.view.panels[0]?.data).toEqual({ source: "traces", filter: { run_id: "R" } });
});

test("the cross-config grid stays unscoped; an explicit ?example= wins over the failed one", async () => {
  const calls = mockApi({ ...traceRoutes("T-001"), "POST /api/v1/tasks/p/t/views/query": { panels: [{ type: "grid", title: "Comparison", rows: [], meta: {} }] } });
  renderWithClient(
    <KindSection project="p" task="t" runId="R" example="T-001" currentGroupId="g"
      specs={[{ type: "trace", title: "Trajectory" }, { type: "grid", title: "Comparison" }]} />,
    { registry: { ...fakeRegistry(["trace"]), grid: ({ selectedItemId, currentGroupId }: { selectedItemId?: string; currentGroupId?: string }) => <p>{`compare ${selectedItemId}/${currentGroupId}`}</p> } },
  );
  expect(await screen.findByText("compare T-001/g")).toBeTruthy();
  const titles = screen.getAllByText(/^(Trajectory · T-001|Comparison)$/).map((e) => e.textContent);
  expect(titles).toEqual(["Trajectory · T-001", "Comparison"]);
  const body = calls.find((c) => c.method === "POST")?.body as { view: { panels: PanelSpec[] } };
  expect(body.view.panels[0]).toEqual({ type: "grid", title: "Comparison" });
});

test("while traces load, and with no traces, the grid never shows every target", async () => {
  let release!: (traces: typeof TRACES) => void;
  const pending = new Promise<typeof TRACES>((resolve) => {
    release = resolve;
  });
  mockApi({
    "GET /api/v1/runs/R/traces": () => pending,
    "POST /api/v1/tasks/p/t/views/query": { panels: [{ type: "grid", title: "Comparison", rows: [{ item_id: "other" }], meta: {} }] },
  });
  const { client } = renderWithClient(
    <KindSection project="p" task="t" runId="R" specs={[{ type: "trace", title: "Trajectory" }, { type: "grid", title: "Comparison" }]} />,
    { registry: fakeRegistry(["grid", "trace"]) },
  );
  await waitFor(() => expect(client.getQueryCache().getAll().some((q) => q.state.status === "success")).toBe(true));
  expect(screen.queryByTestId("panel-grid")).toBeNull();
  await act(async () => {
    release([]);
  });
  expect(await screen.findByText("No traced example available for comparison")).toBeTruthy();
  expect(screen.queryByTestId("panel-grid")).toBeNull();
});
```

```ts
/** One run's history of `names` (idle with no names: an empty list would read every series). */
export const useRunMetrics = (runId: string, names: readonly string[], maxPoints = 300) =>
  useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.runMetrics(runId, names, maxPoints),
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => api.runMetrics(runId, { names, max_points: maxPoints }, signal),
    enabled: names.length > 0,
  });

/** The same names for several runs (a run and its seeds), one request per run. */
export function useRunsMetrics(runIds: readonly string[], names: readonly string[], maxPoints = 300) {
  const results = useQueries({
    queries: runIds.map((runId) => ({
      queryKey: queryKeys.runMetrics(runId, names, maxPoints),
      queryFn: ({ signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }) => api.runMetrics(runId, { names, max_points: maxPoints }, signal),
      enabled: names.length > 0,
    })),
  });
  const byRun = new Map<string, M.MetricPoint[]>();
  results.forEach((result, i) => {
    const id = runIds[i];
    if (id !== undefined && result.data) byRun.set(id, result.data);
  });
  return {
    byRun,
    error: results.find((r) => r.error)?.error ?? null,
    pending: names.length > 0 && results[0]?.isPending === true,
  };
}
```
