```ts
// ui/src/run/scores.ts
/**
 * The Overview tab's numbers (spec 4.3): one tile per metric@version/key of the run, the
 * primary first, Δ against the config's seed mean (muted inside one sample sd), and the
 * "Where it ranks" strip on the primary metric.
 */
import type { ScoreRecord, Stats, TaskGroup, TaskRun, TaskRuns } from "../api/models";
import { ordinal } from "../pages/components/remote";
import { latestScores } from "../pages/components/ScoresList";

export interface ScoreTile {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  metric: string;
  value: number | null;
  error: string | null;
  primary: boolean;
  old: boolean;
  /** This run minus the config's seed mean; null for old versions, failed scores and single seeds. */
  delta: number | null;
  sd: number | null;
  /** |Δ| is under one sd of the config's seeds (or the seeds agree). */
  noise: boolean;
  /** Δ is better in the metric's direction; null when the direction is unknown or Δ is noise. */
  better: boolean | null;
}

export interface TileContext {
  /** `metric/key` of the task's primary (`TaskRuns.primary`); null without a task. */
  primary: string | null;
  higherIsBetter: boolean;
  /** The task's current version per metric; null: the newest version among the run's scores. */
  versions: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | null;
  /** This run and its sibling seeds (TaskRun.scores by `metric/key`). */
  group: readonly Pick<TaskRun, "run_id" | "scores">[];
}

const byVersion = (a: string, b: string): number => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true });

export function currentVersions(scores: readonly ScoreRecord[], versions: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | null): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = { ...(versions ?? {}) };
  for (const s of scores) {
    if (versions && versions[s.metric] !== undefined) continue;
    const seen = out[s.metric];
    if (seen === undefined || byVersion(s.version, seen) > 0) out[s.metric] = s.version;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Mean and sample sd; null for fewer than two values. */
export function meanSd(values: readonly number[]): { mean: number; sd: number } | null {
  if (values.length < 2) return null;
  const mean = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
  const sd = Math.sqrt(values.reduce((a, v) => a + (v - mean) ** 2, 0) / (values.length - 1));
  return { mean, sd };
}

const finite = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);

export function scoreTiles(scores: readonly ScoreRecord[], ctx: TileContext): ScoreTile[] {
  const current = currentVersions(scores, ctx.versions);
  const [pMetric = "", pKey = "value"] = (ctx.primary ?? "").split("/");
  const tiles = latestScores([...scores])
    .filter((s) => s.key !== "*")
    .map((s): ScoreTile => {
      const old = current[s.metric] !== s.version;
      const scoreKey = `${s.metric}/${s.key}`;
      const value = s.error === null && finite(s.value) ? s.value : null;
      const stats = old || value === null ? null : meanSd(ctx.group.map((r) => r.scores[scoreKey]).filter(finite));
      const delta = stats && value !== null ? value - stats.mean : null;
      const noise = stats !== null && delta !== null && (delta === 0 || Math.abs(delta) < stats.sd);
      const better = delta === null || noise || s.metric !== pMetric ? null : ctx.higherIsBetter ? delta > 0 : delta < 0;
      return {
        id: `${s.metric}@${s.version}/${s.key}`,
        label: `${s.metric}@${s.version}${s.key === "value" ? "" : `/${s.key}`}`,
        metric: s.metric,
        value,
        error: s.error,
        primary: !old && s.metric === pMetric && s.key === pKey,
        old,
        delta,
        sd: stats?.sd ?? null,
        noise,
        better,
      };
    });
  return tiles.sort((a, b) => Number(b.primary) - Number(a.primary) || Number(a.old) - Number(b.old) || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
}

export interface StripMark {
  kind: "this" | "seed" | "other";
  value: number;
  color?: string;
}

export interface RankModel {
  marks: StripMark[];
  /** The best config's 95% test-set interval (green band); null when it has none. */
  band: [number, number] | null;
  /** `2nd of 3 seeds · config is best of 12`. */
  summary: string;
  seeds: number;
  configs: number;
  color: string;
}

type Scored<T, K extends keyof T> = T & { [P in K]: NonNullable<T[P]> };

export function rankModel(data: TaskRuns, runId: string, color: string): RankModel | null {
  const me = data.runs.find((r) => r.run_id === runId);
  if (!me || me.primary === null) return null;
  const order = (a: number, b: number): number => (data.higher_is_better ? b - a : a - b);
  const configs = data.groups
    .filter((g): g is Scored<TaskGroup, "primary"> => g.primary !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => order((a.primary as Stats).mean, (b.primary as Stats).mean));
  const seeds = data.runs
    .filter((r): r is Scored<TaskRun, "primary"> => r.group_id === me.group_id && r.primary !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => order(a.primary, b.primary));
  const seedRank = seeds.findIndex((r) => r.run_id === runId) + 1;
  const configRank = configs.findIndex((g) => g.group_id === me.group_id) + 1;
  const best = configs[0];
  const marks: StripMark[] = [
    ...configs.filter((g) => g.group_id !== me.group_id).map((g): StripMark => ({ kind: "other", value: g.primary.mean })),
    ...seeds.filter((r) => r.run_id !== runId).map((r): StripMark => ({ kind: "seed", value: r.primary, color })),
    { kind: "this", value: me.primary, color },
  ];
  const seedText = seeds.length > 1 ? `${ordinal(seedRank)} of ${seeds.length} seeds` : "1 seed";
  const configText =
    configRank === 0 ? `${configs.length} configs` : `config is ${configRank === 1 ? "best" : ordinal(configRank)} of ${configs.length}`;
  return {
    marks,
    band: best?.test_interval ? [best.test_interval.lo, best.test_interval.hi] : null,
    summary: `${seedText} · ${configText}`,
    seeds: seeds.length,
    configs: configs.length,
    color,
  };
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/run/files.ts
/** The run's files as list rows (spec 4.3 Files): name, path relative to the run folder, size, copy text. */
import type { RunDetail, RunRecord } from "../api/models";
import { displayPath, relativeTo, splitHostPath } from "../pages/components/format";
import { hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";

export type FileIcon = "folder" | "doc" | "box";

export interface FileRow {
  icon: FileIcon;
  name: string;
  /** Relative to the run folder when inside it, else `host:path`. */
  path: string;
  /** The full `host:path` the Copy button copies. */
  copy: string;
  size: number | null;
  /** In-app link (the log rows open the Logs tab). */
  href?: string;
  note?: string;
}

interface Loc {
  host: string;
  path: string;
}

const STREAMS = ["stdout", "stderr", "supervisor"] as const;
const baseName = (p: string): string => p.replace(/\/+$/, "").split("/").pop() || p;
const iconOf = (p: string): FileIcon => (/\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(baseName(p)) ? "doc" : "folder");

function rowFor(loc: Loc, dir: Loc, extra: Partial<FileRow> = {}): FileRow {
  const rel = dir.host === loc.host ? relativeTo(loc.path, dir.path) : null;
  const full = displayPath(loc.host, loc.path);
  return { icon: iconOf(loc.path), name: baseName(loc.path), path: rel ?? full, copy: full, size: null, ...extra };
}

/** The machine the run folder is on: its `host:` prefix, else the run's own hostname. */
export function filesHost(detail: RunDetail): string {
  const dir = detail.paths.run_dir;
  const host = dir ? splitHostPath(dir).host : "local";
  return host === "local" ? detail.record.host : host;
}

function fileRows(detail: RunDetail, all: boolean): FileRow[] {
  const { paths, record } = detail;
  if (!paths.run_dir) return [];
  const dir = splitHostPath(paths.run_dir);
  const folder = displayPath(dir.host, dir.path);
  const rows: FileRow[] = [{ icon: "folder", name: "Run folder", path: folder, copy: folder, size: null }];
  for (const stream of STREAMS) {
    const p = paths[stream];
    if (p) rows.push(rowFor(splitHostPath(p), dir, { icon: "doc", href: hrefs.run(record.run_id, { tab: "logs", log: stream }) }));
  }
  for (const key of all ? ["predictions", "env", "config"] : ["predictions"]) {
    const p = paths[key];
    if (p) rows.push(rowFor(splitHostPath(p), dir));
  }
  if (all && (paths.diff || detail.has_diff)) {
    const diff = paths.diff ? splitHostPath(paths.diff) : { host: dir.host, path: `${dir.path}/git.diff` };
    rows.push(rowFor(diff, dir, { icon: "doc", note: "tracked diff" }));
  }
  for (const art of record.artifacts) {
    if (!all && art.kind !== "checkpoint") continue;
    const note = [art.kind, art.step !== null ? `step ${art.step}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    rows.push(rowFor({ host: art.host, path: art.path }, dir, { icon: art.kind === "checkpoint" ? "box" : iconOf(art.path), size: art.size, note }));
  }
  return rows;
}

/** Run folder, logs, predictions and checkpoints (Overview tab). */
export function overviewFiles(detail: RunDetail): FileRow[] {
  return fileRows(detail, false);
}

/** Every recorded path of the run (Files tab). */
export function allFiles(detail: RunDetail): FileRow[] {
  return fileRows(detail, true);
}

/** The project checkout and working directory (Files tab "Code"). */
export function codeRows(detail: RunDetail): FileRow[] {
  const repo = splitHostPath(detail.paths.repo ?? detail.paths.cwd ?? detail.record.cwd);
  const rows: FileRow[] = [{ icon: "folder", name: "Project", path: displayPath(repo.host, repo.path), copy: displayPath(repo.host, repo.path), size: null }];
  const cwd = splitHostPath(detail.paths.cwd ?? detail.record.cwd);
  if (cwd.path !== repo.path) rows.push(rowFor(cwd, repo, { icon: "folder", name: "cwd" }));
  return rows;
}

/** The run's datasets (Files tab "Data"). */
export function dataRows(record: RunRecord): FileRow[] {
  return record.datasets.map((ds) => ({
    icon: iconOf(ds.path),
    name: `${ds.name} ${ds.version}${ds.split ? ` ${ds.split}` : ""}`,
    path: displayPath(ds.host, ds.path),
    copy: displayPath(ds.host, ds.path),
    size: ds.size,
  }));
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/run/curves.ts
/** Which step metrics the run page draws, and as which series (spec 4.3 Curves, Charts tab). */
import type { MetricPoint } from "../api/models";
import { SWEEP_PREFIX } from "../pages/components/KindPanels";

/** Metrics over time: `sweep/*` (step = the swept value) and the step counter are left out. */
export function stepMetrics(names: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return names.filter((n) => !n.startsWith(SWEEP_PREFIX) && n !== "step");
}

/** The Overview's curves: the primary's metric (`val/top1` for `top1/value`), then losses, then the rest. */
export function pickCurves(names: readonly string[], primary: string | null, n = 3): string[] {
  const metric = primary?.split("/")[0] ?? "";
  const first = metric ? names.filter((x) => x === metric || x.endsWith(`/${metric}`)) : [];
  const losses = names.filter((x) => /loss/i.test(x));
  return [...new Set([...first, ...losses, ...names])].slice(0, n);
}

/** Sections by the first `/` prefix, in first-seen order; names without a prefix go to "Metrics". */
export function metricSections(names: readonly string[]): { title: string; names: string[] }[] {
  const out = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const name of names) {
    const cut = name.indexOf("/");
    const title = cut > 0 ? name.slice(0, cut) : "Metrics";
    out.set(title, [...(out.get(title) ?? []), name]);
  }
  return [...out].map(([title, list]) => ({ title, names: list }));
}

export interface CurveSeries {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  color: string;
  points: { x: number; y: number }[];
  emphasis: "bold" | "faint";
}

/** This run in its identity colour (drawn last, on top); sibling seeds grey. */
export function curveSeries(
  byRun: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly MetricPoint[]>,
  metric: string,
  runId: string,
  color: string,
  labels: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
): CurveSeries[] {
  const out: CurveSeries[] = [];
  for (const [id, points] of byRun) {
    const pts = points.filter((p) => p.name === metric).map((p) => ({ x: p.step, y: p.value }));
    if (pts.length === 0) continue;
    const me = id === runId;
    out.push({ id, label: labels.get(id) ?? id, color: me ? color : "var(--c0)", points: pts, emphasis: me ? "bold" : "faint" });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => Number(a.id === runId) - Number(b.id === runId));
}
```

```tsx
import { CopyButton } from "../pages/components/CopyButton";

const GLYPH: Record<FileIcon, string> = {
  folder: "M2 4.5h4l1.5 1.5H14v6.5H2z",

};

function FileGlyph({ kind }: { kind: FileIcon }) {

    <svg className="ficon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d={GLYPH[kind]} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.2" strokeLinejoin="round" />

export function FileList({ rows }: { rows: FileRow[] }) {

          </span>
          <span className="fp mono" title={row.copy}>
            {row.path}
          </span>
          <span className="fs">{row.size !== null ? fmtBytes(row.size) : ""}</span>
          <CopyButton text={row.copy} label={row.name} />
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/MetricPanels.tsx
/** Step-metric panels of one run: this run in colour, up to four sibling seeds grey, one crosshair. */
import type { MetricPoint } from "../api/models";
import { useRunsMetrics } from "../api/queries";
import { Fit } from "../charts/Fit";
import { LineChart } from "../charts/LineChart";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { curveSeries } from "./curves";
import type { RunContext } from "./runContext";

export const MAX_SIBLINGS = 4;
export const CURVE_POINTS = 300;

export function useRunCurves(ctx: RunContext, metrics: readonly string[]) {
  const ids = [ctx.runId, ...ctx.identity.siblings.slice(0, MAX_SIBLINGS).map((r) => r.run_id)];
  return useRunsMetrics(ids, metrics, CURVE_POINTS);
}

export interface MetricPanelsProps {
  ctx: RunContext;
  metrics: readonly string[];
  height: number;
  curves: { byRun: Map<string, MetricPoint[]>; error: Error | null; pending: boolean };
}

export function MetricPanels({ ctx, metrics, height, curves }: MetricPanelsProps) {
  const labels = new Map<string, string>([
    [ctx.runId, "this run"],
    ...ctx.identity.siblings.map((r): [string, string] => [r.run_id, r.seed === null ? r.run_id : `seed ${r.seed}`]),
  ]);
  return (
    <>
      {curves.error ? <ErrorBox error={curves.error} /> : null}
      <div className="curves">
        {metrics.map((metric) => (
          <Panel key={metric} title={metric}>
            {curves.pending ? (
              <Loading />
            ) : (
              <Fit minHeight={height}>
                {(width) => (
                  <LineChart
                    width={width}
                    height={height}
                    series={curveSeries(curves.byRun, metric, ctx.runId, ctx.identity.color, labels)}
                    crosshairGroup={`run:${ctx.runId}`}
                  />
                )}
              </Fit>
            )}
          </Panel>
        ))}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/KindSection.tsx
/**
 * The task kind's run panels (spec 8.4) in v5 panel chrome: every panel scoped to this run
 * (the cross-config grid stays unscoped), and a trace panel for agent kinds with a picker,
 * the failed trace first unless `?example=` names one. Curves are left to the Charts tab.
 */
import { useMemo } from "react";
import type { PanelSpec, RunStatus, TaskKindInfo, TraceSummary } from "../api/models";
import { useRunTrace, useRunTraces, useViewQuery } from "../api/queries";
import { Panel } from "../chrome/Panel";
import { pickExample, runViewPanels, scopeToRun, splitRunView, withoutSweeps } from "../pages/components/KindPanels";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { PanelBody } from "../pages/components/PanelGrid";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";

/** The run view panels to draw on the Overview: sentence-case titles, no curves, no empty trace panels. */
export function runPanelSpecs(kind: TaskKindInfo | null, traceCount: number | undefined, metricNames: readonly string[]): PanelSpec[] {
  return runViewPanels(kind?.run_view ?? [], traceCount, metricNames).filter((p) => p.type !== "curves");
}

interface TracePanelProps {
  runId: string;
  title: string;
  chosen: string | null;
  list: TraceSummary[] | undefined;
  listError: unknown;
}

function TracePanel({ runId, title, chosen, list, listError }: TracePanelProps) {
  const trace = useRunTrace(runId, chosen);
  const traces = list ?? [];
  return (
    <Panel title={chosen ? `${title} · ${chosen}` : title} aside={list ? `${traces.length} traced` : undefined}>
      {listError ? <ErrorBox error={listError} /> : null}
      {traces.length > 0 ? (
        <nav className="trace-pick" aria-label="Traced examples">
          {traces.map((t) => (
            <AppLink
              key={t.example_id}
              href={hrefs.run(runId, { example: t.example_id })}
              aria-current={t.example_id === chosen ? "true" : undefined}
              className={t.failed ? "failed" : undefined}
              title={`${t.turns} turns${t.failed ? ", failed" : ""}`}
            >
              {t.example_id}
            </AppLink>
          ))}
        </nav>
      ) : list ? (
        <p className="muted">no traces</p>
      ) : null}
      {trace.error ? <ErrorBox error={trace.error} /> : trace.data ? <PanelBody result={trace.data} /> : chosen ? <Loading /> : null}
    </Panel>
  );
}

export interface KindSectionProps {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  runId: string;
  specs: PanelSpec[];
  example?: string;
  currentGroupId?: string;
  runStatus?: RunStatus;
}

export function KindSection({ project, task, runId, specs, example, currentGroupId, runStatus }: KindSectionProps) {
  const { regular, trace } = useMemo(() => splitRunView(specs), [specs]);
  const traces = useRunTraces(runId, trace !== null);
  const chosen = example ? String(example) : pickExample(traces.data ?? []);
  const traceFirst = specs[0]?.type === "trace";
  // a current-target grid must never briefly render every target while the selection loads
  const waitingForTarget = trace !== null && regular.some((p) => p.type === "grid") && chosen === null;
  const panels = useViewQuery(
    project,
    task,
    regular.length > 0 ? { view: { title: "run", panels: regular.map((p) => scopeToRun(p, runId)) } } : null,
  );
  const results = useMemo(() => panels.data?.panels.map((r, i) => withoutSweeps(r, regular[i])), [panels.data, regular]);
  if (specs.length === 0) return null;
  const trajectory = trace ? (
    <TracePanel runId={runId} title={trace.title || "Trajectory"} chosen={chosen} list={traces.data} listError={traces.error} />
  ) : null;
  return (
    <section aria-label="Panels" className="kind-panels">
      {traceFirst ? trajectory : null}
      {panels.error ? <ErrorBox error={panels.error} /> : null}
      {regular.length > 0 && results && !waitingForTarget ? (
        results.map((result, i) => (
          <Panel key={`${i}-${result.type}`} title={result.title || regular[i]?.title || result.type}>
            <PanelBody result={result} selectedItemId={chosen ?? undefined} currentGroupId={currentGroupId} runStatus={runStatus} />
          </Panel>
        ))
      ) : waitingForTarget && traces.data ? (
        <p className="muted">No traced example available for comparison</p>
      ) : regular.length > 0 && !panels.error && !traces.error ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : null}
      {traceFirst ? null : trajectory}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/OverviewTab.tsx
/** Run Overview tab (spec 4.3): queue (queued runs), scores, where it ranks, curves, kind panels, files. */
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useAllRuns, useRunTraces } from "../api/queries";
import { Fit } from "../charts/Fit";
import { ScoreStrip } from "../charts/ScoreStrip";
import { fmtDelta, fmtScore, fmtScoreUnit } from "../pages/components/format";
import { readsTraces } from "../pages/components/KindPanels";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { QueuePanel, queueRows, queuedRunsQuery } from "../pages/components/QueuePanel";
import { hostLabel } from "../pages/components/remote";
import { pickCurves, stepMetrics } from "./curves";
import { FileList } from "./FileList";
import { filesHost, overviewFiles } from "./files";
import { KindSection, runPanelSpecs } from "./KindSection";
import { MetricPanels, useRunCurves } from "./MetricPanels";
import type { RunContext } from "./runContext";
import { type RankModel, type ScoreTile, rankModel, scoreTiles } from "./scores";

const SHOWN_TILES = 8;

function Tile({ tile, unit }: { tile: ScoreTile; unit: string }) {
  const why = tile.delta === null || tile.sd === null ? undefined : `${tile.noise ? "inside" : "outside"} 1 sd (${fmtScore(tile.sd)}) of the config's seeds`;
  const cls = tile.noise ? "muted" : tile.better === null ? "ink2" : tile.better ? "delta-up" : "delta-dn";
  return (
    <div className={tile.primary ? "tile prim" : "tile"}>
      <div className="tk">
        <span className="tl" title={tile.label}>
          {tile.label}
        </span>
        {tile.primary ? <span className="star">primary</span> : null}
        {tile.old ? <span className="old">old version</span> : null}
      </div>
      <div className="tv">
        {tile.error ? (
          <span className="err" title={tile.error}>
            error
          </span>
        ) : tile.primary ? (
          fmtScoreUnit(tile.value, unit)
        ) : (
          fmtScore(tile.value)
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="td" title={why}>
        {tile.delta === null ? null : (
          <>
            <span className={cls}>{fmtDelta(tile.delta)}</span>
            <span className="muted"> vs config mean</span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ScoreTiles({ tiles, unit }: { tiles: ScoreTile[]; unit: string }) {
  const [all, setAll] = useState(false);
  const shown = all ? tiles : tiles.slice(0, SHOWN_TILES);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="tiles">
        {shown.map((t) => (
          <Tile key={t.id} tile={t} unit={unit} />
        ))}
      </div>
      {tiles.length > SHOWN_TILES ? (
        <button type="button" className="btn sm ghost" onClick={() => setAll(!all)}>
          {all ? "Fewer scores" : `All ${tiles.length} scores`}
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

function RankStrip({ rank, label }: { rank: RankModel; label: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rank">
      <div className="rank-h">
        <span>Where it ranks</span>
        <span className="muted">{`${label} · ${rank.summary}`}</span>
      </div>
      <Fit minHeight={46}>{(width) => <ScoreStrip width={width} marks={rank.marks} band={rank.band} />}</Fit>
      <div className="rank-legend">
        <span>
          <i className="dot" style={{ background: rank.color }} />
          this run
        </span>
        {rank.seeds > 1 ? (
          <span>
            <i className="dot faint" style={{ background: rank.color }} />
            other seeds
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {rank.configs > 1 ? (
          <span>
            <i className="tick" />
            other configs
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {rank.band ? (
          <span>
            <i className="band" />
            best config, 95% CI
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function QueueSection({ ctx }: { ctx: RunContext }) {
  const { record, host, now } = ctx;
  const queued = useAllRuns(queuedRunsQuery(record.environment_id), true);
  const where = hostLabel(record, host);
  return (
    <section aria-label="Queue">
      <h3>
        Queue <span className="muted">{host ? `${host.name}, ${host.queue} waiting` : where}</span>
      </h3>
      {queued.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={queued.error} />
      ) : queued.data ? (
        <>
          <QueuePanel host={host} hostName={where} runId={ctx.runId} rows={queueRows(queued.data.runs, record.environment_id, now, record)} />
          {queued.data.complete ? null : <p className="muted">{`first ${queued.data.runs.length} queued runs on ${where}`}</p>}
        </>
      ) : (
        <Loading />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function CurvesSection({ ctx, metrics }: { ctx: RunContext; metrics: string[] }) {
  const curves = useRunCurves(ctx, metrics);
  return (
    <section aria-label="Curves">
      <h3>
        Curves
        <AppLink className="more" href={hrefs.run(ctx.runId, { tab: "charts" })}>
          All charts
        </AppLink>
      </h3>
      <MetricPanels ctx={ctx} metrics={metrics} height={150} curves={curves} />
    </section>
  );
}

export function OverviewTab({ ctx }: { ctx: RunContext }) {
  const { detail, record, phase, taskRuns, identity } = ctx;
  const waiting = phase === "queued" || phase === "pending";
  const tiles = useMemo(
    () =>
      scoreTiles(detail.scores, {
        primary: taskRuns?.primary ?? null,
        higherIsBetter: taskRuns?.higher_is_better ?? true,
        versions: taskRuns?.metric_versions ?? null,
        group: identity.run ? [identity.run, ...identity.siblings] : [],
      }),
    [detail.scores, taskRuns, identity],
  );
  const rank = taskRuns ? rankModel(taskRuns, ctx.runId, identity.color) : null;
  const curves = pickCurves(stepMetrics(detail.metric_names), taskRuns?.primary ?? null);
  const wantsTraces = (ctx.kind?.run_view ?? []).some(readsTraces);
  const traces = useRunTraces(ctx.runId, wantsTraces && !waiting);
  const specs = useMemo(
    () => runPanelSpecs(ctx.kind, traces.data?.length, detail.metric_names),
    [ctx.kind, traces.data, detail.metric_names],
  );
  const primaryLabel = tiles.find((t) => t.primary)?.label ?? taskRuns?.primary ?? "";
  return (
    <div className="rmain">
      {ctx.kindError ? <ErrorBox error={ctx.kindError} /> : null}
      {phase === "queued" ? <QueueSection ctx={ctx} /> : null}
      {tiles.length > 0 || rank ? (
        <section aria-label="Scores">
          <h3>Scores</h3>
          {tiles.length > 0 ? <ScoreTiles tiles={tiles} unit={taskRuns?.unit ?? ""} /> : null}
          {rank ? <RankStrip rank={rank} label={primaryLabel} /> : null}
        </section>
      ) : null}
      {curves.length > 0 && !waiting ? <CurvesSection ctx={ctx} metrics={curves} /> : null}
      {record.task && !waiting ? (
        <KindSection
          project={record.project}
          task={record.task}
          runId={ctx.runId}
          specs={specs}
          example={ctx.example}
          currentGroupId={identity.run?.group_id}
          runStatus={record.status}
        />
      ) : null}
      <section aria-label="Files">
        <h3>
          Files <span className="muted">{`on ${filesHost(detail)}`}</span>
        </h3>
        <FileList rows={overviewFiles(detail)} />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/run/props.ts
/** The texts of the run sidebar (spec 4.3): status with exit or reason, host, GPUs, commit, config. */
import type { HostRow, RunRecord } from "../api/models";
import { type PlaceRow, placementRows } from "../pages/components/Placement";
import { fmtWait, hostLabel, type RunPhase, secondsSince } from "../pages/components/remote";
import type { GitState } from "../pages/components/WhereList";

const WORD: Record<string, string> = { queued: "Queued", running: "Running", finished: "Finished", failed: "Failed", killed: "Killed", lost: "Lost" };

export function statusText(record: RunRecord, phase: RunPhase, host: HostRow | null, now: number, reason: string | null): string {
  if (phase === "stale") {
    const gone = host ? secondsSince(host.state.since, now) : null;
    const name = hostLabel(record, host);
    return gone === null ? `Stale · ${name} unreachable` : `Stale · ${name} unreachable ${fmtWait(gone)}`;
  }
  const word = WORD[record.status] ?? record.status;
  const why = record.end_reason?.trim() || "";
  if (record.status === "lost") {
    const told = why || reason?.trim() || "";
    return `Lost · ${told || (record.exit_code === null ? "no exit code" : `exit ${record.exit_code}`)}`;
  }
  const parts = [word, record.exit_code !== null ? `exit ${record.exit_code}` : "", why].filter(Boolean);
  return parts.join(" · ");
}

export function hostText(record: RunRecord, phase: RunPhase, host: HostRow | null): string {
  if (phase === "local") {
    const gpus = record.executor.gpus ?? [];
    return gpus.length > 0 ? `${record.host} · GPU ${gpus.join(", ")}` : record.host;
  }
  const kind = host?.kind ?? (record.executor.slurm_job_id ? "slurm" : "ssh");
  return `${hostLabel(record, host)} · ${kind}`;
}

/** Mean utilisation and memory of the GPUs a running remote run holds; null when unknown. */
export function gpuUse(record: RunRecord, phase: RunPhase, host: HostRow | null): string | null {
  const gpus = record.executor.gpus ?? [];
  // a SLURM job's GPU indices are on its compute node, not the login node's GPUs
  if (phase !== "running" || !host || gpus.length === 0 || record.executor.slurm_job_id) return null;
  const held = host.gpus.filter((g) => gpus.includes(g.index));
  if (held.length === 0) return null;
  const util = held.reduce((a, g) => a + g.util, 0) / held.length;
  const mem = held.reduce((a, g) => a + g.mem_used_mb, 0) / 1024;
  return `${Math.round(util)}% · ${Math.round(mem)} GB`;
}

export function commitText(git: GitState): string | null {
  if (!git.commit) return null;
  const state = git.dirty ? " · dirty" : (git.untracked_count ?? 0) > 0 ? " · untracked" : "";
  return `${git.commit.slice(0, 7)}${state}`;
}

export interface ConfigRow {
  key: string;
  value: string;
  varies: boolean;
}

/** The run's params in their order, then its seed; `varies` tints values that differ in the task. */
export function configRows(record: RunRecord, varying: readonly string[], seedVaries: boolean): ConfigRow[] {
  const rows = Object.entries(record.params).map(([key, value]) => ({ key, value, varies: varying.includes(key) }));
  if (record.seed !== null) rows.push({ key: "seed", value: String(record.seed), varies: seedVaries });
  return rows;
}

/** Placement rows (Job, Node, GPUs, PID, Queue) of a remote run; Host and Cost have their own rows. */
export function placementExtras(record: RunRecord, phase: RunPhase, host: HostRow | null): PlaceRow[] {
  return placementRows(record, phase, host).filter((row) => row.key !== "Host" && row.key !== "Cost");
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/PropsSidebar.tsx
/** Run properties sidebar (spec 4.3, mockup .rside): facts, config, tags, notes, ids. */
import { type ReactNode, useState } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES } from "../api/queries";
import { Launcher } from "../chrome/Launcher";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { CopyButton } from "../pages/components/CopyButton";
import { fmtCount, fmtDate, fmtDuration, runSeconds, shortId } from "../pages/components/format";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { Notes } from "../pages/components/Notes";
import { ErrorBox } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { costShown, sweepCrumb } from "../pages/components/remote";
import { useAction } from "../pages/components/useAction";
import { gitLine } from "../pages/components/WhereList";
import { commitText, configRows, gpuUse, hostText, placementExtras, statusText } from "./props";
import { pillState } from "./RunHeader";
import type { RunContext } from "./runContext";

function Prop({ k, children }: { k: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="prop">
      <span className="k">{k}</span>
      <span className="v">{children}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export function TagEditor({ runId, tags, served }: { runId: string; tags: string[]; served: boolean }) {
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const change = useAction<unknown, { add?: string[]; remove?: string[] }>({
    send: (body, opts) => api.tagRun(runId, body, opts),
    invalidate: [...RUN_EVENT_INVALIDATES, ["taskRuns"]],
    onSuccess: () => {
      setText("");
      setAdding(false);
    },
  });
  const close = () => {
    setAdding(false);
    setText("");
  };
  const submit = () => {
    const tag = text.trim();
    if (tag === "" || tags.includes(tag)) close();
    else change.run({ add: [tag] });
  };
  return (
    <div className="tagrow">
      {tags.map((tag) => (
        <span key={tag} className="tag">
          {tag}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="tag-x"
            aria-label={`Remove tag ${tag}`}
            disabled={!served || change.pending}
            onClick={() => change.run({ remove: [tag] })}
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </span>
      ))}
      {adding ? (
        <input
          className="tag-in"
          aria-label="New tag"
          autoFocus
          value={text}
          disabled={change.pending}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") {
              e.preventDefault();
              submit();
            } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
              e.preventDefault();
              close();
            }
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <button type="button" className="tag add" disabled={!served} onClick={() => setAdding(true)}>
          + Add
        </button>
      )}
      {change.error ? <ErrorBox error={change.error} /> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PropsSidebar({ ctx }: { ctx: RunContext }) {
  const { record, detail, phase, host, now } = ctx;
  const state = pillState(ctx);
  const sweep = sweepCrumb(record, ctx.hubEnvId);
  const cost = costShown(record.cost, host);
  const seconds = runSeconds(record, now);
  const git = gitLine(record.git);
  const commit = commitText(record.git);
  const use = gpuUse(record, phase, host);
  const extras = ctx.remote ? placementExtras(record, phase, host) : [];
  const varying = ctx.taskRuns?.varying_keys ?? [];
  const config = configRows(record, varying, ctx.identity.siblings.length > 0);
  const folder = detail.paths.run_dir?.split("/").filter(Boolean).pop() ?? "";
  const usage = record.usage;
  return (
    <aside className="rside" aria-label="Properties">
      <div className="pgroup">
        {record.task ? (
          <Prop k="Task">
            <AppLink className="lnk" href={hrefs.task(record.project, record.task)}>{`${record.project} / ${record.task}`}</AppLink>
            {ctx.kind ? <span className="tag">{ctx.kind.kind}</span> : null}
          </Prop>
        ) : (
          <Prop k="Project">{record.project}</Prop>
        )}
        <Prop k="Status">
          <span className={`st ${state}`}>
            <StatusIcon status={state} />
            {statusText(record, phase, host, now, ctx.lostWhy)}
          </span>
        </Prop>
        <Prop k="Launcher">
          <Launcher by={record.created_by} />
        </Prop>
        <Prop k="Host">{hostText(record, phase, host)}</Prop>
        {use ? <Prop k="GPU use">{use}</Prop> : null}
        {extras.map((row) => (
          <Prop key={row.key} k={row.key}>
            <span className={row.mono ? "mono" : undefined}>{row.value}</span>
            {row.note ? <small>{row.note}</small> : null}
            {row.copy ? <CopyButton text={row.copy} label={`${row.key} ${row.copy}`} /> : null}
          </Prop>
        ))}
        <Prop k="Started">{fmtDate(record.started_at ?? record.created_at)}</Prop>
        {seconds !== null ? <Prop k="Duration">{fmtDuration(seconds)}</Prop> : null}
        {commit ? (
          <Prop k="Commit">
            <span className="mono" title={git ? `${git.ref} — ${git.text}` : undefined}>
              {commit}
            </span>
          </Prop>
        ) : null}
        {record.parent ? (
          <Prop k="Parent">
            <AppLink className="lnk mono" href={hrefs.run(record.parent)}>
              {shortId(record.parent)}
            </AppLink>
            {record.kind === "infer" ? <span className="tag">infer</span> : null}
          </Prop>
        ) : null}
        {sweep ? (
          <Prop k="Sweep">
            {sweep.href ? (
              <AppLink className="lnk" href={sweep.href}>
                {sweep.id}
              </AppLink>
            ) : (
              <span title={sweep.why ?? undefined}>{sweep.id}</span>
            )}
          </Prop>
        ) : null}
        {cost ? (
          <Prop k="Cost">
            <span title={cost.note}>{cost.value}</span>
          </Prop>
        ) : null}
        {usage ? <Prop k="Usage">{`${fmtCount(usage.tokens_in)} in · ${fmtCount(usage.tokens_out)} out · ${usage.calls} calls`}</Prop> : null}
      </div>
      <div className="pgroup">
        <div className="ph4">
          Config
          {varying.length > 0 ? (
            <span className="muted" title="Values that differ between this task's configs; the run is named by them">
              tinted = varies in task
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        {config.length > 0 ? (
          config.map((row) => (
            <Prop key={row.key} k={row.key}>
              {row.varies ? <span className="chg">{row.value}</span> : row.value}
            </Prop>
          ))
        ) : (
          <p className="muted">No params</p>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="pgroup">
        <div className="ph4">Tags</div>
        <TagEditor runId={ctx.runId} tags={record.tags} served={detail.served !== false} />
      </div>
      <div className="pgroup">
        <div className="ph4">Notes</div>
        <Notes runId={ctx.runId} notes={detail.notes} />
      </div>
      <div className="pgroup ids mono">{`run ${record.run_id}${folder && folder !== record.run_id ? ` · ${folder}` : ""}`}</div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/ChartsTab.tsx
/** Run Charts tab (spec 4.3): every step metric, sectioned by prefix, this run in colour and its seeds grey. */
import { PanelSection } from "../chrome/PanelSection";
import { metricSections, stepMetrics } from "./curves";
import { MetricPanels, useRunCurves } from "./MetricPanels";
import type { RunContext } from "./runContext";

export function ChartsTab({ ctx }: { ctx: RunContext }) {
  const names = stepMetrics(ctx.detail.metric_names);
  const curves = useRunCurves(ctx, names);
  if (names.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rmain">
        <p className="muted">No step metrics logged</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="rmain">
      <p className="muted">
        {ctx.identity.siblings.length > 0 ? "This run in colour, the other seeds of its config in grey." : "This run's step metrics."}
      </p>
      {metricSections(names).map((section) => (
        <PanelSection key={section.title} title={section.title} count={section.names.length}>
          <MetricPanels ctx={ctx} metrics={section.names} height={180} curves={curves} />
        </PanelSection>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/FilesTab.tsx
/** Run Files tab (spec 4.3): command, code, every recorded file, data, checkpoints. */
import { shellJoin } from "../pages/components/format";
import { CheckpointTable } from "../pages/components/TrainingDetails";
import { gitLine } from "../pages/components/WhereList";
import { FileList } from "./FileList";
import { allFiles, codeRows, dataRows, filesHost } from "./files";
import type { RunContext } from "./runContext";

export function FilesTab({ ctx }: { ctx: RunContext }) {
  const { record, detail } = ctx;
  const git = gitLine(record.git);
  const cmd = shellJoin(record.command);
  const tmpl = shellJoin(record.command_template);
  const training = (ctx.kind?.kind ?? ctx.taskRuns?.kind) === "training";
  return (
    <div className="rmain">
      <section aria-label="Command">
        <h3>Command</h3>
        <pre className="cmd mono">{cmd}</pre>
        {tmpl !== cmd ? (
          <p className="muted">
            template <code>{tmpl}</code>
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {git ? (
          <p className="gitline" title={git.untracked.length ? git.untracked.join("\n") : undefined}>
            <b className="mono">{git.ref}</b> <span className={git.state}>{git.text}</span>
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </section>
      <section aria-label="Code">
        <h3>Code</h3>
        <FileList rows={codeRows(detail)} />
      </section>
      <section aria-label="Run files">
        <h3>
          Files <span className="muted">{`on ${filesHost(detail)}`}</span>
        </h3>
        <FileList rows={allFiles(detail)} />
      </section>
      {record.datasets.length > 0 ? (
        <section aria-label="Data">
          <h3>Data</h3>
          <FileList rows={dataRows(record)} />
        </section>
      ) : null}
      {training ? (
        <section aria-label="Checkpoints">
          <h3>Checkpoints</h3>
          <CheckpointTable artifacts={record.artifacts} />
        </section>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/pages/components/LogView.tsx (whole file)
/** A run log tail (the run page's Logs tab; failures link here with `?tab=logs&log=stderr`). */
import { useRunLogs } from "../../api/queries";
import type { LogStream } from "../../run/runContext";
import { fmtBytes } from "./format";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "./QueryState";

export function LogView({ runId, stream }: { runId: string; stream: LogStream }) {
  const log = useRunLogs(runId, stream);
  return (
    <section aria-label={stream} className="logview">
      <h3>
        {stream}
        {log.data ? <span className="muted">{fmtBytes(log.data.size)}</span> : null}
      </h3>
      {log.error ? <ErrorBox error={log.error} /> : log.data ? <pre className="log">{log.data.text.trimEnd() || "empty"}</pre> : <Loading />}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/LogsTab.tsx
/** Run Logs tab: stdout, stderr or the supervisor log, chosen by `?log=`. */
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { LogView } from "../pages/components/LogView";
import { LOG_STREAMS, type RunContext } from "./runContext";

export function LogsTab({ ctx }: { ctx: RunContext }) {
  const stream = ctx.log ?? "stdout";
  return (
    <div className="rmain">
      <nav className="seg" aria-label="Log stream">
        {LOG_STREAMS.map((s) => (
          <AppLink
            key={s}
            className={s === stream ? "on" : undefined}
            aria-current={s === stream ? "true" : undefined}
            href={hrefs.run(ctx.runId, { tab: "logs", log: s })}
          >
            {s}
          </AppLink>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <LogView runId={ctx.runId} stream={stream} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/run/ExamplesTab.tsx
/** Run Examples tab: pick another config to compare example by example on the Examples page. */
import { fmtScoreUnit } from "../pages/components/format";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { type RunContext, exampleTargets } from "./runContext";

export function ExamplesTab({ ctx }: { ctx: RunContext }) {
  const data = ctx.taskRuns;
  if (!ctx.record.task || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="rmain">
        <p className="muted">Examples compare runs of one task; this run has no task.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const others = exampleTargets(data, ctx.runId);
  return (
    <div className="rmain">
      <section aria-label="Compare examples">
        <h3>Compare examples with</h3>
        {others.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="muted">No other scored config in this task</p>
        ) : (
          <table className="t">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th aria-label="Colour" />
                <th>Config</th>
                <th className="num">{data.primary}</th>
                <th aria-label="Open" />
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {others.map((o) => (
                <tr key={o.runId} aria-label={o.name}>
                  <td>
                    <span className="sw" style={{ background: o.color }} />
                  </td>
                  <td>{o.name}</td>
                  <td className="num">{fmtScoreUnit(o.primary, data.unit)}</td>
                  <td>
                    <AppLink className="btn sm" href={hrefs.examples(o.runId, ctx.runId)}>
                      Open
                    </AppLink>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
});
```

```ts
// ui/src/home/homeModel.ts
/** Home's numbers and rows (spec 4.1), from `GET /overview` and `GET /hosts`. Pure. */
import type { FailureRow, HostRow, OverviewSummary, RecentRun, RunRecord, RunStatus } from "../api/models";
import { parseTime, primaryMetricName } from "../pages/components/format";
import { fmtMoney } from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { runTitle } from "../run/RunName";

export interface Kpi {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  status?: RunStatus;
  title?: string;
}

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

/** Midnight UTC of `now` (the UI shows times in UTC). */
export function utcDayStart(now: number): number {
  return Math.floor(now / DAY_MS) * DAY_MS;
}

/** GPUs of connected hosts held by an hx run or another process, of all their GPUs. */
export function gpusBusy(hosts: readonly HostRow[]): { busy: number; total: number } {
  let busy = 0;
  let total = 0;
  for (const h of hosts) {
    if (h.state.state !== "connected") continue;
    for (const g of h.gpus) {
      total += 1;
      if (g.run_id !== null || g.external) busy += 1;
    }
  }
  return { busy, total };
}

export function statusStrip(summary: OverviewSummary, hosts: readonly HostRow[], now: number): Kpi[] {
  const running = summary.running.filter((r) => r.status === "running");
  const count = (key: string, fallback: number): number => summary.counts[key] ?? fallback;
  const today = utcDayStart(now);
  const gpus = gpusBusy(hosts);
  const usd = summary.cost_today_usd ?? hosts.reduce((a, h) => a + h.cost_today_usd, 0);
  return [
    { label: "projects with live runs", value: String(new Set(running.map((r) => r.project)).size) },
    { label: "running", value: String(count("running", running.length)), status: "running" },
    { label: "queued", value: String(count("queued", summary.running.length - running.length)), status: "queued" },
    { label: "failed today", value: String(summary.failures.filter((f) => parseTime(f.created_at) >= today).length), status: "failed" },
    { label: "lost", value: String(count("lost", 0)), status: "lost", title: "lost in the last 24 h" },
    { label: "GPUs busy", value: gpus.total > 0 ? `${gpus.busy} / ${gpus.total}` : "—" },
    { label: "spent today", value: fmtMoney(usd) },
  ];
}

/** A store with no run at all (first open of a fresh install). */
export function isEmptyHome(summary: OverviewSummary): boolean {
  return (
    summary.running.length === 0 &&
    summary.failures.length === 0 &&
    (summary.recent ?? summary.timeline).length === 0 &&
    summary.projects.every((p) => p.runs === 0)
  );
}

/** The run view name from the hub, else the record's name or hypothesis clause with the seed. */
export function runLabel(summary: OverviewSummary, record: Pick<RunRecord, "run_id" | "hypothesis" | "seed" | "name">): string {
  return summary.names?.[record.run_id] ?? runTitle(null, record).display;
}

export interface TaskRow {
  project: string;
  task: string;
  kind: string;
  metric: string;
  arrow: "↑" | "↓";
  higherIsBetter: boolean;
  best: number | null;
  unit: string;
  delta: number | null;
  improved: boolean;
  history: number[];
  runs: number;
  running: number;
  queued: number;
}

export function taskRows(summary: OverviewSummary): TaskRow[] {
  return summary.projects
    .filter((p) => Boolean(p.task))
    .map((p) => {
      const hib = p.higher_is_better ?? true;
      const ago = p.best_7d_ago ?? null;
      const delta = p.best !== null && ago !== null ? p.best - ago : null;
      const active = summary.running.filter((r) => r.project === p.project && r.task === p.task);
      return {
        project: p.project,
        task: p.task,
        kind: p.kind.replace(/_/g, " "),
        metric: primaryMetricName(p.primary ?? "") || "—",
        arrow: hib ? "↑" : "↓",
        higherIsBetter: hib,
        best: p.best,
        unit: p.unit,
        delta,
        improved: delta !== null && (hib ? delta > 0 : delta < 0),
        history: p.best_history ?? [],
        runs: p.runs,
        running: p.running ?? active.filter((r) => r.status === "running").length,
        queued: p.queued ?? active.filter((r) => r.status === "queued").length,
      };
    });
}

/** Failures with the same label and exit code, in first-seen order (rows come newest first). */
export function groupFailures(failures: FailureRow[]): FailureRow[][] {
  const groups = new Map<string, FailureRow[]>();
  for (const f of failures) {
    const key = JSON.stringify([f.label, f.exit_code]);
    const group = groups.get(key);
    if (group) group.push(f);
    else groups.set(key, [f]);
  }
  return [...groups.values()];
}

/** `failed · exit 137`, `lost · host gone`, `finished`. */
export function reasonText(status: RunStatus, exitCode: number | null, reason: string | null): string {
  if (status === "failed") return exitCode !== null ? `failed · exit ${exitCode}` : "failed";
  if (status === "lost") return reason ? `lost · ${reason}` : "lost";
  return status;
}

export interface RecentRow {
  runId: string;
  at: string;
  name: string;
  project: string;
  task: string | null;
  status: RunStatus;
  reason: string;
  score: number | null;
  deltaBest: number | null;
  by: string;
  hypothesis: string;
  /** stderr path of a failed run (Open stderr, copy). */
  stderr: string | null;
  retried: boolean;
  /** Failures folded into this row (×N). */
  count: number;
}

/** An older hub sends no `recent`: newest unarchived, non-queued timeline items instead. */
function fromTimeline(summary: OverviewSummary): RecentRun[] {
  return [...summary.timeline]
    .reverse()
    .filter((t) => t.status !== "queued" && !t.archived)
    .map((t) => ({
      run_id: t.run_id,
      project: t.project,
      task: t.task,
      name: t.label,
      status: t.status,
      end_reason: null,
      exit_code: null,
      created_at: t.created_at,
      created_by: t.created_by,
      hypothesis: "",
      primary: null,
      delta_best: null,
    }));
}

export function recentRows(summary: OverviewSummary, max = 12): RecentRow[] {
  const failures = new Map(summary.failures.map((f) => [f.run_id, f]));
  const names = summary.names ?? {};
  const rows: RecentRow[] = (summary.recent ?? fromTimeline(summary)).slice(0, max).map((r) => {
    const f = failures.get(r.run_id);
    return {
      runId: r.run_id,
      at: r.created_at,
      name: names[r.run_id] ?? r.name,
      project: r.project,
      task: r.task,
      status: r.status,
      reason: reasonText(r.status, r.exit_code ?? f?.exit_code ?? null, r.end_reason),
      score: r.primary,
      deltaBest: r.delta_best,
      by: r.created_by,
      hypothesis: r.hypothesis,
      stderr: f?.stderr_path ?? null,
      retried: f?.retried_ok ?? false,
      count: 1,
    };
  });
  const shown = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.runId));
  for (const group of groupFailures(summary.failures)) {
    const f = group[0];
    if (!f || group.some((g) => shown.has(g.run_id))) continue;
    rows.push({
      runId: f.run_id,
      at: f.created_at,
      name: names[f.run_id] ?? f.label,
      project: "",
      task: null,
      status: "failed",
      reason: reasonText("failed", f.exit_code, null),
      score: null,
      deltaBest: null,
      by: "",
      hypothesis: "",
      stderr: f.stderr_path,
      retried: group.every((g) => g.retried_ok),
      count: group.length,
    });
  }
  return rows.sort((a, b) => parseTime(b.at) - parseTime(a.at));
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/hosts/GpuCells.tsx
/** One cell per GPU, filled by utilisation (mockup .gpus); hx-run cells link to the run. */
import type { HostRow, RunRecord } from "../api/models";
import { fmtClock, isAgent } from "../pages/components/format";
import { type GpuCell, cellTitle } from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import "./hosts.css";

export function GpuCells({ host, runs }: { host: HostRow; runs?: ReadonlyMap<string, RunRecord> }) {
  if (host.slurm) return <span className="muted">{`${host.slurm.running} running · ${host.slurm.pending} pending`}</span>;
  if (host.gpus.length === 0) return <span className="muted">no GPU</span>;
  const stale = host.state.state === "stale";
  const asOf = stale ? fmtClock(host.state.since) : null;
  return (
    <span className={stale ? "gpus stale" : "gpus"} role="list" aria-label={`GPUs on ${host.name}`}>
      {[...host.gpus]
        .sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index)
        .map((g) => {
          const run = g.run_id ? runs?.get(g.run_id) : undefined;
          const cell: GpuCell = {
            kind: g.run_id ? (run ? (isAgent(run.created_by) ? "agent" : "human") : "run") : g.external ? "other" : "free",
            index: g.index,
            span: 1,
            runId: g.run_id,
            utils: [g.util],
            memUsedMb: g.mem_used_mb,
          };
          const cls = `gpu ${g.run_id ? "run" : g.external ? "ext" : "free"}`;
          const fill = <i style={{ height: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, g.util))}%` }} />;
          const title = cellTitle(host.name, cell, run, asOf);
          return g.run_id ? (
            <AppLink key={g.index} role="listitem" data-gpu={g.index} className={cls} title={title} href={hrefs.run(g.run_id)}>
              {fill}
            </AppLink>
          ) : (
            <span key={g.index} role="listitem" data-gpu={g.index} className={cls} title={title}>
              {fill}
            </span>
          );
        })}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
] as const;

] as const;

export function EmptyHome() {

}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/home/HomePage.tsx
/**
 * Home (spec 4.1): status strip; Running now; Hosts; Tasks with best over time; Recent runs
 * with failures and "Open stderr". No identity swatches (colour is task-scoped); the
 * status icon carries the state. Replaces the Overview page.
 */
import { Fragment } from "react";
import type { HostRow, OverviewSummary, RunRecord } from "../api/models";
import { useHosts, useOverview } from "../api/queries";
import { Sparkline } from "../charts/Sparkline";
import { Avatar } from "../chrome/Avatar";
import { Launcher } from "../chrome/Launcher";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { GpuCells } from "../hosts/GpuCells";
import { CopyButton } from "../pages/components/CopyButton";
import { fmtClock, fmtDate, fmtDelta, fmtScore, fmtScoreUnit, parseTime } from "../pages/components/format";
import { fmtMoney, gpuSpec, hostRowForRun, longStale, staleBannerHours, useNow } from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { fmtWait } from "../pages/components/remote";
import { EmptyHome } from "./EmptyHome";
import { type RecentRow, type TaskRow, isEmptyHome, recentRows, runLabel, statusStrip, taskRows, utcDayStart } from "./homeModel";
import "./home.css";

function when(iso: string, now: number): string {
  return parseTime(iso) >= utcDayStart(now) ? fmtClock(iso) : fmtDate(iso);
}

function RunningTable({ summary, hosts }: { summary: OverviewSummary; hosts: readonly HostRow[] }) {
  const running = summary.running.filter((r) => r.status === "running");
  if (running.length === 0) return <p className="muted">Nothing running</p>;
  return (
    <div className="tblwrap">
      <table className="t">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Run</th>
            <th>Task</th>
            <th>Progress</th>
            <th className="num">Latest</th>
            <th>Host</th>
            <th>Launcher</th>
            <th className="num">ETA</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {running.map((r) => {
            const p = summary.progress?.[r.run_id];
            const row = hostRowForRun(r, hosts);
            const state = row?.state.state === "stale" ? "stale" : "running";
            const name = runLabel(summary, r);
            const pct = p?.progress !== null && p?.progress !== undefined ? Math.round(p.progress * 100) : null;
            return (
              <tr key={r.run_id}>
                <td className="nm">
                  <span className={`st ${state}`}>
                    <StatusIcon status={state} />
                    <AppLink href={hrefs.run(r.run_id)}>{name}</AppLink>
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="ink2">{r.task ? <AppLink href={hrefs.task(r.project, r.task)}>{r.task}</AppLink> : r.project}</td>
                <td>
                  {pct !== null ? (
                    <>
                      <span className="prog" role="progressbar" aria-label={`${name} progress`} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={pct}>
                        <i style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
                      </span>
                      <span className="muted">{` ${pct}%`}</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="muted">—</span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td className="num" title={p?.metric ?? undefined}>
                  {p?.value !== null && p?.value !== undefined ? fmtScore(p.value) : "—"}
                </td>
                <td>{row?.name ?? r.host}</td>
                <td>
                  <Launcher by={r.created_by} />
                </td>
                <td className="num muted">{p?.eta_seconds !== null && p?.eta_seconds !== undefined ? fmtWait(p.eta_seconds) : "—"}</td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

function HostRows({ hosts, runs }: { hosts: readonly HostRow[]; runs: ReadonlyMap<string, RunRecord> }) {
  if (hosts.length === 0) return <p className="muted">No hosts</p>;
  return (
    <div className="tblwrap">
      {hosts.map((h) => (
        <div key={h.name} className="hostrow">
          <div>
            <AppLink className="nm" href={hrefs.hosts()}>
              {h.name}
            </AppLink>
            <div className="muted">{h.name === "local" ? "hub" : `${h.kind}${gpuSpec(h.gpus) ? ` · ${gpuSpec(h.gpus)}` : ""}`}</div>
          </div>
          <GpuCells host={h} runs={runs} />
          <div className="num">{h.cost_today_usd > 0 ? fmtMoney(h.cost_today_usd) : "—"}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function TasksTable({ rows }: { rows: TaskRow[] }) {
  if (rows.length === 0) return <p className="muted">No tasks</p>;
  return (
    <div className="tblwrap">
      <table className="t">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Task</th>
            <th>Project</th>
            <th>Kind</th>
            <th>Primary</th>
            <th className="num">Best</th>
            <th className="num">7-day Δ</th>
            <th>Best over time</th>
            <th className="num">Runs</th>
            <th>Now</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((t) => (
            <tr key={`${t.project}/${t.task}`}>
              <td className="nm">
                <AppLink href={hrefs.task(t.project, t.task)}>{t.task}</AppLink>
              </td>
              <td className="ink2">
                <span className="proj">
                  <Avatar name={t.project} small />
                  {t.project}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td className="muted">{t.kind}</td>
              <td className="ink2">{`${t.metric} ${t.arrow}`}</td>
              <td className="num best">{fmtScoreUnit(t.best, t.unit)}</td>
              <td className={`num ${t.delta === null || t.delta === 0 ? "muted" : t.improved ? "delta-up" : "delta-dn"}`}>
                {t.delta === null || t.delta === 0 ? "—" : fmtDelta(t.delta)}
              </td>
              <td>{t.history.length >= 2 ? <Sparkline values={t.history} width={90} height={22} higherIsBetter={t.higherIsBetter} /> : null}</td>
              <td className="num">{t.runs}</td>
              <td>
                {t.running > 0 ? (
                  <span className="st running">
                    <StatusIcon status="running" />
                    {`${t.running} running`}
                  </span>
                ) : t.queued > 0 ? (
                  <span className="st queued">
                    <StatusIcon status="queued" />
                    {`${t.queued} queued`}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="muted">idle</span>
                )}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

function RecentTable({ rows, now }: { rows: RecentRow[]; now: number }) {
  if (rows.length === 0) return <p className="muted">No finished runs yet</p>;
  return (
    <div className="tblwrap">
      <table className="t">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Time</th>
            <th>Run</th>
            <th>Task</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th className="num">Score</th>
            <th className="num">Δ best</th>
            <th>Launcher</th>
            <th>Hypothesis</th>
            <th aria-label="Actions" />
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <tr key={r.runId}>
              <td className="muted" title={r.at}>
                {when(r.at, now)}
              </td>
              <td className="nm">
                <AppLink href={hrefs.run(r.runId)}>{r.name}</AppLink>
              </td>
              <td className="ink2">{r.task ? <AppLink href={hrefs.task(r.project, r.task)}>{r.task}</AppLink> : null}</td>
              <td>
                <span className={`st ${r.status}`}>
                  <StatusIcon status={r.status} />
                  {r.count > 1 ? `${r.reason} ×${r.count}` : r.reason}
                </span>
                {r.retried ? <small className="muted"> · retry ok</small> : null}
              </td>
              <td className="num">{r.score === null ? "" : fmtScore(r.score)}</td>
              <td className="num muted">{r.deltaBest === null ? "" : fmtDelta(r.deltaBest)}</td>
              <td>{r.by ? <Launcher by={r.by} /> : null}</td>
              <td className="hyp ink2" title={r.hypothesis}>
                {r.hypothesis}
              </td>
              <td>
                {r.stderr ? (
                  <span className="fail-act">
                    <AppLink className="btn sm" href={hrefs.run(r.runId, { tab: "logs", log: "stderr" })}>
                      Open stderr
                    </AppLink>
                    <CopyButton text={r.stderr} label="stderr path" />
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function HomePage() {
  const overview = useOverview();
  const hosts = useHosts();
  const now = useNow();
  if (overview.error) {
    return (
      <div className="home">
        <ErrorBox error={overview.error} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!overview.data) {
    return (
      <div className="home">
        <Loading />
      </div>
    );
  }
  const summary = overview.data;
  if (isEmptyHome(summary)) return <EmptyHome />;
  const rows = hosts.error ? [] : (hosts.data ?? []);
  const hours = staleBannerHours(rows);
  const gone = longStale(rows.filter((r) => r.name !== "local"), now, hours);
  const runs = new Map(summary.running.map((r) => [r.run_id, r]));
  const running = summary.running.filter((r) => r.status === "running");
  const queued = summary.running.length - running.length;
  return (
    <div className="home">
      <div className="kpis">
        {statusStrip(summary, rows, now).map((k) => (
          <div key={k.label} className="kpi" title={k.title}>
            <div className="v">{k.value}</div>
            <div className="l">
              {k.status ? (
                <span className={`st ${k.status}`}>
                  <StatusIcon status={k.status} />
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {k.label}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {gone.length > 0 ? (
        <p className="hosts-banner" role="status" title={`No answer for more than ${hours} h. Its runs stay stale, not lost: only the host marks a run lost.`}>
          {gone.map((h, i) => (
            <Fragment key={h.name}>
              {i > 0 ? ", " : null}
              <b>{h.name}</b>
              {` unreachable ${h.age}`}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="two">
        <section aria-labelledby="home-running">
          <h2 id="home-running">
            Running now <span className="n">{`${running.length} runs`}</span>
            {queued > 0 ? <AppLink href={hrefs.queue()}>{`${queued} queued`}</AppLink> : null}
          </h2>
          <RunningTable summary={summary} hosts={rows} />
        </section>
        <section aria-labelledby="home-hosts">
          <h2 id="home-hosts">
            Hosts <span className="n">GPU use, live</span>
          </h2>
          {hosts.error ? <ErrorBox error={hosts.error} /> : <HostRows hosts={rows} runs={runs} />}
        </section>
      </div>
      <section aria-labelledby="home-tasks">
        <h2 id="home-tasks">
          Tasks <span className="n">best score per task, last 7 days</span>
        </h2>
        <TasksTable rows={taskRows(summary)} />
      </section>
      <section aria-labelledby="home-recent">
        <h2 id="home-recent">
          Recent runs <span className="n">all projects</span>
        </h2>
        <RecentTable rows={recentRows(summary)} now={now} />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// ui/src/hosts/queueModel.ts
/** The Queue page's groups: queued runs by the host that serves their environment (spec 4.4). */
import type { HostRow, RunRecord } from "../api/models";
import { hostRowForRun } from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { type QueueRow, queueRows } from "../pages/components/QueuePanel";

export interface QueueGroup {
  key: string;
  host: string;
  row: HostRow | null;
  rows: (QueueRow & { record: RunRecord })[];
}

export function queueGroups(runs: readonly RunRecord[], hosts: readonly HostRow[] | undefined, now: number): QueueGroup[] {
  const byEnv = new Map<string, RunRecord[]>();
  for (const r of runs) byEnv.set(r.environment_id, [...(byEnv.get(r.environment_id) ?? []), r]);
  const groups: QueueGroup[] = [];
  for (const [env, list] of byEnv) {
    const first = list[0];
    if (!first) continue;
    const row = hostRowForRun(first, hosts);
    const records = new Map(list.map((r) => [r.run_id, r]));
    const rows = queueRows(list, env, now).flatMap((q) => {
      const record = records.get(q.runId);
      return record ? [{ ...q, record }] : [];
    });
    groups.push({ key: env, host: row?.name ?? first.host, row, rows });
  }
  return groups.sort((a, b) => Number(b.host === "local") - Number(a.host === "local") || a.host.localeCompare(b.host));
}
```

```tsx
// ui/src/hosts/HostsPage.tsx
/** Hosts (spec 4.4): every host with its state, version, GPU cells, queue, rate and cost; connect actions. */
import { Fragment } from "react";
import { api } from "../api/client";
import type { HostRow, HostState } from "../api/models";
import { HOST_EVENT_INVALIDATES, useHosts, useHubEnvironment } from "../api/queries";
import {
  HostVersion, LOCAL_HOST, StateGlyph, fmtMoney, gpuSpec, hostStateTitle, longStale, remoteRows, staleBannerHours, stateWord, useNow,
} from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { useAction } from "../pages/components/useAction";
import { GpuCells } from "./GpuCells";
import "./hosts.css";

function HostLine({ row, hub, now }: { row: HostRow; hub: string | null; now: number }) {
  const connect = useAction<HostState>({ send: (_: void, opts) => api.connectHost(row.name, opts), invalidate: HOST_EVENT_INVALIDATES });
  const disconnect = useAction<HostState>({ send: (_: void, opts) => api.disconnectHost(row.name, opts), invalidate: HOST_EVENT_INVALIDATES });
  const st = row.state.state;
  const local = row.name === LOCAL_HOST;
  const rate = row.usd_per_gpu_hour ?? null;
  const error = connect.error ?? disconnect.error;
  return (
    <tr aria-label={row.name} className={st === "stale" ? "stale" : undefined}>
      <th scope="row">
        <b>{row.name}</b> <span className="tag">{local ? "hub" : row.kind}</span>
        <div className="muted" title={row.projects.join(", ")}>
          {gpuSpec(row.gpus) || "·"}
        </div>
      </th>
      <td>
        <span className="st" title={hostStateTitle(row)}>
          <StateGlyph state={st} />
          {stateWord(row, now)}
        </span>
        <div className="muted">
          <HostVersion host={row.name} version={row.state.hx_version ?? null} hub={hub} />
        </div>
      </td>
      <td>
        <GpuCells host={row} />
      </td>
      <td className="num">{row.queue > 0 ? <AppLink href={hrefs.queue()}>{row.queue}</AppLink> : 0}</td>
      <td className="num" title={rate !== null ? "$/GPU-h from environments.yaml" : "No rate set"}>
        {rate !== null ? `$${rate.toFixed(2)}` : "·"}
      </td>
      <td className="num" title="GPU and API cost of runs today">
        {row.cost_today_usd > 0 ? fmtMoney(row.cost_today_usd) : "·"}
      </td>
      <td className="act">
        {local ? null : st === "connected" ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn sm" disabled={disconnect.pending} onClick={() => disconnect.run()} title={`Stop talking to ${row.name}; its runs keep going`}>
            Disconnect
          </button>
        ) : st === "connecting" || st === "bootstrapping" ? (
          <button type="button" className="btn sm" disabled>
            Connecting
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button type="button" className="btn sm" disabled={connect.pending} onClick={() => connect.run()} title={`Try ${row.name} again now`}>
            {st === "disabled" ? "Connect" : "Reconnect"}
          </button>
        )}
        {error ? <ErrorBox error={error} /> : null}
      </td>
    </tr>
  );
}

export function HostsPage() {
  const hosts = useHosts();
  const env = useHubEnvironment();
  const now = useNow();
  const reload = useAction({ send: (_: void, opts) => api.reloadHosts(opts), invalidate: HOST_EVENT_INVALIDATES });
  const hub = typeof env.data?.hx_version === "string" ? env.data.hx_version : null;
  const rows = hosts.data ?? [];
  const hours = staleBannerHours(rows);
  const gone = longStale(remoteRows(rows), now, hours);
  const usd = rows.reduce((a, h) => a + h.cost_today_usd, 0);
  return (
    <div className="hosts-page">
      <header className="ph">
        <h1>Hosts</h1>
        <div className="facts">
          <span>{`${rows.length} hosts`}</span>
          {hub ? <span>{`hub hx ${hub}`}</span> : null}
          <span>{`${fmtMoney(usd)} today`}</span>
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="btn sm" disabled={reload.pending} onClick={() => reload.run()} title="Read environments.yaml again (after hx hosts add, map or rm)">
          Reload
        </button>
      </header>
      {gone.length > 0 ? (
        <p className="hosts-banner" role="status" title={`No answer for more than ${hours} h. Its runs stay stale, not lost: only the host marks a run lost.`}>
          {gone.map((h, i) => (
            <Fragment key={h.name}>
              {i > 0 ? ", " : null}
              <b>{h.name}</b>
              {` unreachable ${h.age}`}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {reload.error ? <ErrorBox error={reload.error} /> : null}
      {hosts.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={hosts.error} />
      ) : !hosts.data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : (
        <div className="tblwrap">
          <table className="t hosts-t">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Host</th>
                <th>State</th>
                <th>GPUs</th>
                <th className="num">Queue</th>
```

```tsx
// ui/src/hosts/QueuePage.tsx
/** Queue (spec 4.4): every queued run, grouped by host, in queue order, with a confirmed Stop. */
import { api } from "../api/client";
import { REMOTE_RUN_INVALIDATES, useAllRuns, useHosts } from "../api/queries";
import { Launcher } from "../chrome/Launcher";
import { StatusIcon } from "../chrome/StatusIcon";
import { DASH } from "../pages/components/format";
import { useNow } from "../pages/components/HostsPanel";
import { AppLink, hrefs } from "../pages/components/links";
import { ErrorBox, Loading } from "../pages/components/QueryState";
import { useAction } from "../pages/components/useAction";
import { useArmed } from "../run/useArmed";
import { GpuCells } from "./GpuCells";
import { type QueueGroup, queueGroups } from "./queueModel";
import "./hosts.css";

function QueueLine({ row }: { row: QueueGroup["rows"][number] }) {
  const stop = useAction({ send: (_: void, opts) => api.cancelQueuedRun(row.runId, opts), invalidate: REMOTE_RUN_INVALIDATES });
  const { armed, arm, disarm } = useArmed([row.runId]);
  const r = row.record;
  return (
    <tr>
      <td className="num">{row.position ?? DASH}</td>
      <td className="nm">
        <AppLink href={hrefs.run(row.runId)}>{r.name ?? row.label}</AppLink>
      </td>
      <td className="ink2">{r.task ? <AppLink href={hrefs.task(r.project, r.task)}>{r.task}</AppLink> : r.project}</td>
      <td>
        <Launcher by={row.createdBy} />
      </td>
      <td className="num">{row.gpus}</td>
      <td className="num">{row.waiting}</td>
      <td>
        <span className="st queued">
          <StatusIcon status="queued" />
          queued
        </span>
      </td>
      <td className="act">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="btn sm"
          disabled={stop.pending}
          onClick={() => {
            if (armed) {
              disarm();
              stop.run();
            } else arm();
          }}
          onBlur={disarm}
          title={armed ? "Click again to remove it from the queue" : "Remove from the queue"}
        >
          {armed ? "Stop ✓?" : "Stop"}
        </button>
        {stop.error ? <ErrorBox error={stop.error} /> : null}
      </td>
    </tr>
  );
}

export function QueuePage() {
  const queued = useAllRuns({ status: "queued" });
  const hosts = useHosts();
  const now = useNow(10_000);
  const groups = queued.data ? queueGroups(queued.data.runs, hosts.data, now) : [];
  const total = groups.reduce((a, g) => a + g.rows.length, 0);
  return (
    <div className="hosts-page">
      <header className="ph">
        <h1>Queue</h1>
        <div className="facts">
          <span>{`${total} queued on ${groups.length} hosts`}</span>
          {queued.data && !queued.data.complete ? <span>{`first ${queued.data.runs.length}`}</span> : null}
        </div>
      </header>
      {queued.error ? (
        <ErrorBox error={queued.error} />
      ) : !queued.data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : groups.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="muted">Nothing queued</p>
      ) : (
        groups.map((g) => (
          <section key={g.key} aria-label={g.host} className="qgroup">
            <h2>
              {g.host} <span className="n">{`${g.rows.length} waiting`}</span>
            </h2>
            {g.row ? <GpuCells host={g.row} /> : null}
            <div className="tblwrap">
              <table className="t">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th className="num">Pos</th>
                    <th>Run</th>
                    <th>Task</th>
                    <th>Launcher</th>
                    <th className="num">GPUs</th>
                    <th className="num">Waiting</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                    <th aria-label="Actions" />
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {g.rows.map((row) => (
                    <QueueLine key={row.runId} row={row} />
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>
        ))
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

(`runs?status=queued&limit=1000` is what `fetchAllRuns({status: "queued"})` sends first; the

```ts
/** Run display names from every task-runs list already in the query cache (no extra request). */
export function cachedRunNames(entries: readonly (readonly [unknown, TaskRuns | undefined])[]): Map<string, string> {
  const out = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const [, data] of entries) for (const run of data?.runs ?? []) out.set(run.run_id, run.name);
  return out;
}

/** A run's palette title: its display name, else its own name, else its hypothesis clause, with the seed. */
export function runCommandTitle(r: RunRecord, names?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): string {
  const known = names?.get(r.run_id) ?? r.name?.trim();
  if (known) return known;
  return withSeed(r.hypothesis ? firstClause(r.hypothesis, r.run_id, 60) : `run ${shortId(r.run_id)}`, r.seed);
}
```

### Review focus for this part (each has a test in the owning task)

1. A run with no task (every remote fixture has `task: null`): grey swatch, hypothesis-clause name, no Compare, no task requests — R2 `RunPage.test.tsx` "a run without a task".
2. An archived run's page: the task runs are read with `archived=true` so the run keeps its colour and siblings — R2 "an archived run reads … archived=true".
3. An eval run with dozens of score keys: eight tiles and an "All N scores" button, never a 54-tile wall — R3 "more than eight scores".
4. A rename the server refuses (422) or a name over 80 characters / with a newline: the old name comes back with the reason, nothing is sent for a local refusal — R1 "a refused name goes back", "too long a name is refused".
5. Home against a hub without the overview additions (no `recent`/`names`/`progress`/trend fields), and a store with zero runs: fallbacks from `timeline`/hypothesis, and the empty home — R6 `homeModel.test.ts` "an old backend falls back", "isEmptyHome".
