- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

In `src/hypothex/demo.py` (if `Context.open`, `index.list_runs` or `store.read_scores`
have other names in this codebase, use the existing names in both the test and here):

```python
DEMO_EXTRAS: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {"eval_matrix": ("eval-matrix", "multi-dataset")}
"""Demo projects that are not one of the five task kinds (always seeded by ``hx demo``)."""

_EVAL_DATASETS = ("test-a", "test-b", "holdout")
_EVAL_MODELS = ("model-x", "model-y")
# db version -> (top10 base, tags, archived); later versions are better, "b" re-runs supersede.
_EVAL_DBS: tuple[tuple[str, float, tuple[str, ...], bool], ...] = (
    ("v1", 1.06, ("rescore",), False),
    ("v2", 1.40, ("rescore", "superseded"), False),
    ("v2b", 1.40, ("rescore",), False),
    ("v3", 1.52, ("rescore", "superseded"), False),
    ("v3b", 1.53, ("rescore", "final"), False),
    ("v4", 1.57, ("rescore", "final"), False),
    ("v0", 0.91, ("rescore",), True),
)


def _seed_eval_matrix(sd: _Seeder) -> None:
    """
    Seed ``eval-matrix/multi-dataset``: one eval per database version.

    Every run reports ``reported/<dataset>.<model>.<metric>`` for three datasets, two
    models and three metrics (``top10``, ``max``, ``n``), the shape the v5 Compare
    panel and score-key sections are built for.

    Parameters
    ----------
    sd : _Seeder
        Target home.
    """
    project, task = DEMO_EXTRAS["eval_matrix"]
    dataset = {"version": "v1", "path": "data/items.jsonl", "splits": {"test": "data/items.jsonl"}}
    repo = sd.project(
        _task_config(
            project,
            task,
            kind="generic",
            dataset=dataset,
            metrics={"reported": {"version": "v1", "fn": "demo_metrics:accuracy"}},
            primary="reported/test-a.model-x.top10",
            description="Re-score saved predictions against each database version.",
            score_keys="{dataset}.{model}.{metric}",
        ),
        {"data/items.jsonl": _jsonl({"id": f"item-{i}"} for i in range(40))},
    )
    draw = _mulberry32(11)
    for i, (db, base, tags, archived) in enumerate(_EVAL_DBS):
        record, _ = sd.start(
            _RunSpec(
                project=project,
                task=task,
                repo=repo,
                hypothesis=f"Re-score the test sets with database {db}.",
                command_template=["python", "rescore.py", "--db", db],
                params={"db": db},
                seed=None,
                created_at=sd.at(f"2026-09-27T0{i}:10:00Z"),
                created_by="agent:rescorer",
                host="laptop",
                commit=_GEN_NEW,
                key=f"eval-{db}",
                tags=list(tags),
                archived=archived,
            )
        )
        scores: list[tuple[str, str, str, float]] = []
        for d_i, ds in enumerate(_EVAL_DATASETS):
            for m_i, model in enumerate(_EVAL_MODELS):
                top10 = _fixed(base - 0.18 * d_i - 0.07 * m_i + 0.02 * _gauss(draw), 4)
                scores.append(("reported", "v1", f"{ds}.{model}.top10", top10))
                scores.append(("reported", "v1", f"{ds}.{model}.max", _fixed(top10 * 2.6, 3)))
                scores.append(("reported", "v1", f"{ds}.{model}.n", float(124 + 3 * d_i)))
        sd.finish(
            record,
            status=RunStatus.FINISHED,
            ended_at=record.created_at + timedelta(minutes=4),
            exit_code=0,
            scores=scores,
        )
```

```ts
// ui/e2e/pages.spec.ts
import { demoTask, expect, expectTheme, getJson, test, type OverviewLite } from "./fixtures";
import { KINDS } from "./paths";

interface TaskRunsLite {
  primary: string;
  runs: { run_id: string; name: string; tags: string[]; archived: boolean }[];
  groups: { group_id: string; name: string }[];
  score_keys: string[];
  metric_names: string[];
}

test("home lists running work, tasks and recent runs", async ({ page, request, theme }) => {
  const summary = await getJson<OverviewLite>(request, "/api/v1/overview");
  await page.goto("/");
  await expectTheme(page, theme);
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Tasks" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Recent runs" })).toBeVisible();
  for (const row of summary.projects) {
    await expect(page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Projects" }).getByText(row.project).first()).toBeVisible();
  }
});

for (const kind of [...KINDS, "eval_matrix"] as const) {
  test(`task ${kind}: sidebar names every group and charts render`, async ({ page, request, theme }) => {
    const { project, task } = demoTask(kind);
    const data = await getJson<TaskRunsLite>(request, `/api/v1/tasks/${project}/${task}/runs`);
    await page.goto(`/t/${project}/${task}`);
    await expectTheme(page, theme);
    const sidebar = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Runs" });
    for (const group of data.groups.slice(0, 8)) {
      await expect(sidebar.getByText(group.name, { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
    }
    // no hash labels as names
    await expect(sidebar.getByText(/@[0-9a-f]{7}|@nogit/)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Scores" })).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole("tab", { name: /^Runs/ }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("table")).toBeVisible();
  });
}

test("run page shows scores, rank strip and properties", async ({ page, request, theme }) => {
  const { project, task } = demoTask("training");
  const data = await getJson<TaskRunsLite>(request, `/api/v1/tasks/${project}/${task}/runs`);
  const run = data.runs.find((r) => !r.archived)!;
  await page.goto(`/r/${run.run_id}`);
  await expectTheme(page, theme);
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toContainText(run.name);
  await expect(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Scores" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Where it ranks")).toBeVisible();
  const props = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Properties" });
  for (const label of ["Status", "Launcher", "Host", "Started", "Commit"]) {
    await expect(props.getByText(label, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  }
  await page.getByRole("tab", { name: "Logs" }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/tab=logs/);
});
```

```ts
// ui/e2e/live.spec.ts (append)
test("renaming a run updates the run page, the task sidebar and the API", async ({ page, request }) => {
  const { project, task } = demoTask("generic");
  const data = await getJson<{ runs: { run_id: string; name: string; archived: boolean }[] }>(
    request, `/api/v1/tasks/${project}/${task}/runs`);
  const run = data.runs.find((r) => !r.archived)!;
  await page.goto(`/r/${run.run_id}`);
  await page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 }).getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }).click();
  const input = page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Run name" });
  await input.fill("svm, tuned C");
  await input.press("Enter");
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toContainText("svm, tuned C");
  const after = await getJson<{ runs: { run_id: string; name: string; renamed: boolean }[] }>(
    request, `/api/v1/tasks/${project}/${task}/runs`);
  expect(after.runs.find((r) => r.run_id === run.run_id)).toMatchObject({ name: "svm, tuned C", renamed: true });
  await page.goto(`/t/${project}/${task}?group=run`);
  await expect(page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Runs" }).getByText("svm, tuned C")).toBeVisible();
  // reset restores the derived name
  await page.goto(`/r/${run.run_id}`);
  await page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 }).getByRole("button", { name: "Rename" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reset name" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toContainText(run.name);
});
```

```ts
// ui/e2e/interactions.spec.ts
import { demoTask, expect, test } from "./fixtures";

test("hiding a config removes its line from every chart", async ({ page }) => {
  const { project, task } = demoTask("training");
  await page.goto(`/t/${project}/${task}`);
  const sidebar = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Runs" });
  const firstEye = sidebar.getByRole("button", { name: /^(Hide|Show) / }).first();
  const id = await firstEye.getAttribute("data-identity");
  const lines = page.locator(`[data-series="${id}"]`);
  const before = await lines.count();
  expect(before).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  await firstEye.click();
  await expect(firstEye).toHaveAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
  await expect(lines).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/hide=/);
});

test("compare panel: rows are datasets, columns are runs, one dataset always stays", async ({ page }) => {
  const { project, task } = demoTask("eval_matrix");
  await page.goto(`/t/${project}/${task}`);
  const panel = page.getByRole("region", { name: /Compare/ });
  const table = panel.getByRole("table");
  await expect(table.getByRole("rowheader", { name: "test-a" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(table.getByRole("columnheader", { name: /db v4/ })).toBeVisible();
  // superseded runs are hidden by default
  await expect(table.getByRole("columnheader", { name: /db v3$/ })).toHaveCount(0);
  await panel.getByRole("checkbox", { name: "holdout" }).click();
  await expect(table.getByRole("rowheader", { name: "holdout" })).toBeVisible();
  for (const name of ["test-a", "test-b", "holdout"]) {
    const chip = panel.getByRole("checkbox", { name });
    if ((await chip.getAttribute("aria-checked")) === "true") await chip.click();
  }
  await expect(panel.getByRole("checkbox", { checked: true })).not.toHaveCount(0);
  await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Bars" }).click();
  await expect(panel.locator("svg [data-series]").first()).toBeVisible();
});

test("keyboard: rows open on Enter, the eye toggles without navigating", async ({ page }) => {
  const { project, task } = demoTask("generic");
  await page.goto(`/t/${project}/${task}`);
  const eye = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Runs" }).getByRole("button", { name: /^(Hide|Show) / }).first();
  await eye.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/t/${project}/${task}`));
  const row = page.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Runs" }).getByRole("link").first();
  await row.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/r\//);
});
```

### Task X4: Playwright — layout and constant text size

**Files:**
- Modify: `ui/e2e/layout-geometry.ts` (`LAYOUT_WIDTHS = [1280, 1440, 2000] as const`,
  screenshots at 1280 and 2000), `ui/e2e/chart-layout.spec.ts` (rewrite)

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the spec**

```ts
// ui/e2e/chart-layout.spec.ts
import { checkLayout, LAYOUT_WIDTHS } from "./layout-geometry";
import { demoTask, expect, test } from "./fixtures";

const SCREENS = [
  { name: "home", url: () => "/" },
  { name: "task-training", url: () => { const t = demoTask("training"); return `/t/${t.project}/${t.task}`; } },
  { name: "task-eval", url: () => { const t = demoTask("eval_matrix"); return `/t/${t.project}/${t.task}`; } },
  { name: "runs-table", url: () => { const t = demoTask("training"); return `/t/${t.project}/${t.task}?tab=runs`; } },
];

for (const screen of SCREENS) {
  test(`${screen.name}: no overflow at ${LAYOUT_WIDTHS.join("/")}`, async ({ page }, info) => {
    await page.goto(screen.url());
    for (const width of LAYOUT_WIDTHS) {
      await checkLayout(page, info, screen.name, width, ["[data-panel]", "table", "nav", "aside"]);
    }
  });
}

test("chart text does not grow with the window", async ({ page }) => {
  const t = demoTask("training");
  await page.goto(`/t/${t.project}/${t.task}`);
  const sizes: number[] = [];
  for (const width of LAYOUT_WIDTHS) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 1000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(250);
    const px = await page.locator("[data-panel] svg text").first().evaluate((el) => {
      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return box.height;
    });
    sizes.push(px);
  }
  expect(Math.max(...sizes) - Math.min(...sizes)).toBeLessThan(1.5);
});
```

`data-panel` on every `chrome/Panel` root is part of this task's contract.

```ts
// ui/scripts/screenshots.ts — usage: HX_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7777 bun scripts/screenshots.ts
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";

const base = process.env.HX_URL ?? "http://127.0.0.1:7777";
const out = new URL("../../docs/_static/ui/", import.meta.url).pathname;
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
const runs = (await (await fetch(`${base}/api/v1/tasks/rxn-forward/uspto-forward-top1/runs`)).json()) as { runs: { run_id: string; status: string }[] };
const run = runs.runs.find((r) => r.status === "finished")!;
const pages: Record<string, string> = {
  home: "/",
  task: "/t/rxn-forward/uspto-forward-top1",
  eval: "/t/eval-matrix/multi-dataset",
  runs: "/t/rxn-forward/uspto-forward-top1?tab=runs",
  run: `/r/${run.run_id}`,
  sweep: "/t/rxn-forward/uspto-forward-top1?tab=sweeps",
};
const browser = await chromium.launch();
for (const theme of ["light", "dark"] as const) {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, colorScheme: theme });
  for (const [name, path] of Object.entries(pages)) {
    await page.goto(base + path, { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    await page.screenshot({ path: `${out}${name}-${theme}.png` });
  }
  await page.close();
}
await browser.close();
```

  Run it against `HYPOTHEX_HOME=/tmp/hx-shots uv run hx demo --with-hosts && uv run hx serve --port 7777 --no-auth`

  `docs/ui.rst` with `.. image::` and the task screenshot in `README.md`.
